label: D
question: Which of the following statements concerning 소멸시효 is correct? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.)
A: A claim for damages arising from 채무불이행 does not extinguish together with the original claim even if the original claim is extinguished by 시효.
B: The claim concerning 공사 by a person who has undertaken a 도급 contract, to which the 3-year 단기소멸시효 applies, means only the claim for the 공사대금, and the contractor’s 저당권설정청구권, as a claim 부수되는 to that work, does not fall under a claim concerning the work of a person who has undertaken a contract.
C: A junior secured interest holder is a person who directly benefits from the extinction of the secured claim under the senior secured interest, and therefore may invoke the completion of extinctive prescription concerning the 선순위담보권의 피담보채권.
D: In a lawsuit seeking performance of the procedure for cancellation registration of mortgage establishment registration, brought by a real guarantor on the ground of the nonexistence or extinction of the secured debt, even if the creditor, who is also the mortgagee, prevails by seeking a judgment dismissing the claim and asserting the existence of the secured claim, the creditor’s 위 응소행위 does not constitute a ‘judicial claim,’ which is a ground for interruption of prescription with respect to the secured claim.
E: Where a creditor attaches or provisionally attaches the debtor’s claim against a third-party obligor, 채무자의 제3채무자에 대한 채권에 대해 확정적 시효중단의 효력이 발생한다.

label: C
question:
A, who operates a moneylending business, lent B a total of KRW 300 million in three transactions as shown in the table below.
Date of Loan Principal Interest Principal Repayment Due Date
2018. 1. 1. KRW 100 million 1% per month (payable on the last day of each month) 2018. 12. 31.
2019. 1. 1. KRW 100 million 1% per month (payable on the last day of each month) 2019. 12. 31.
2020. 7. 1. KRW 100 million 1% per month (payable on the last day of each month) 2021. 6. 30.
Because B has made no repayment whatsoever of the above 채무, A intends to file a lawsuit on 2024. 1. 12. seeking payment of the 원금 of each loan and the 이자 or 지연손해금 thereon up to 2023. 12. 31. If B is expected to raise a defense of 소멸시효, what is the maximum amount of the claim that A can have upheld in the lawsuit? However, late payment damages on accrued interest or late payment damages are not claimed, and it is assumed that the last day of the period is not a Saturday or a public holiday. If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.
A: KRW 470,000,000, which is 4억 7,400만 원
C: KRW 284,000,000, that is 2억 8,400만 원
D: KRW 272,000,000, that is 2억 7,200만 원

label: C
question: A and B are spouses and have minor children C and D subject to their 공동친권. Of the explanations concerning this, which is 옳은가? (Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the 판례.)
A: If 甲, despite being contrary to 乙’s 의사, performed a juristic act representing 丙 in the joint names of 乙 and 甲, that legal act is 무효 regardless of whether the other party acted in good faith.
B: If 丙 entered into a credit card use contract with credit card company 戊 without 甲 and 乙’s consent and obtained a card, and 戊 paid the price for the goods purchased from 己 using that card, then after 甲 and 乙 rescinded the credit card use contract with 戊, but did not rescind the sales contract with 己 and 丙 consumed all of the purchased goods, 丙 does not bear an obligation to return unjust enrichment to 戊.
C: If, at the time of the juristic act, C merely told the other party that he was just a 성년자 and did not actively use 속임수, C may 취소 the above juristic act.
D: After A's death, B, in order to secure the debt of a stock company of which B is the representative director, established a mortgage over the co-owned property of B and C in the capacity of C's legal representative without appointing a special agent, and such act is an 이해상반행위 and therefore 무효이다.
E: After 甲's death, even if 乙, as the legal representative of 丙 and 丁, agrees to 협의분할 the inherited property so that all of it becomes 丁's 단독소유, such division by agreement is lawful.

label: C
question: A and B entered into a 조합계약 under the Civil Act to conduct a business related to artificial intelligence. Due to personal circumstances, B withdrew from the 조합. Which of the following statements concerning this are correct? If there is a dispute, follow the 판례. ㄱ. A partner’s 임의 탈퇴 is a kind of 해지 of the 조합계약 and must be effected by a manifestation of intention to the other 조합원; however, such manifestation of intention may also be made 묵시적으로. ㄴ. Because B withdrew, the 조합관계 terminated, and as a result the 조합 is naturally dissolved or 청산된다. ㄷ. Partnership property belonging to the 합유 of A and B, after B’s withdrawal, belongs to A’s 단독소유. ㄹ. B may demand from A an accounting of the 조합재산 due to withdrawal, and such accounting must be based on the condition of the 조합재산 at the time of B’s withdrawal. ㅁ. Unless there are 특별한 사정, such as a separate agreement regarding the method of calculating the 지분, when calculating B’s share, A bears the burden of proving the condition of the 조합재산.
A: ㄱ, ㄴ
B: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ
C: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㄹ
D: ㄷ, ㄹ, ㅁ
E: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ, ㅁ

label: C
question: B, having been granted authority by A to sell X land owned by A, entered into a sales contract with C concerning X land. 이에 관한 설명 중 which of the following is incorrect? (각 지문은 independent하며, 다툼이 있는 경우 follow the precedents.)
A: 丙이 甲에게 채무의 이행을 청구하였으나 甲은 乙에게 대리권을 수여한 바가 없으므로 자신은 채무를 이행할 의무가 없다고 주장하는 경우, 乙에게 X 토지의 매도를 위한 대리권이 있다는 점은 丙이 증명하여야 한다.
B: If 乙 received the balance from the buyer 丙, then, absent 특별한 사정, 丙’s 잔금지급채무 is extinguished even if 乙 did not 전달 the balance to 甲.
C: If C was deceived by 제3자 D, and entered into the 매매계약 with B, C may 취소 the sales contract on the ground of a manifestation of intent induced by 사기 only when B learned of D’s 기망 conduct.
D: If A 주장한다 that the above sales contract was concluded at a price markedly lower than market value and is void as an unfair 법률행위, the 궁박 requirement is determined based on A, and the 경솔·무경험 requirement is determined based on B.
E: Even if adult guardianship is commenced for A after A granted 대리권 to B, B’s 대리권 does not 소멸하지 않는다.

label: D
question: Which of the following statements concerning 점유취득시효 are correct? Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the 판례. ㄱ. If X land is in a 구분소유적 공유관계 between 乙 and 丙, 甲, who has completed 취득시효 with respect to 乙’s specific 구분소유 부분, may demand 이행 of the 소유권이전등기절차 on the ground of completion of 취득시효 not only against 乙 but also against 丙, who is unrelated to 乙’s specific 구분소유 부분, with respect to each 공유지분 in that land portion. ㄴ. Where a person who has lawfully and validly completed 등기 and acquired 소유권 of real property possesses his own real property, unless 특별한 사정 exist, such possession cannot be said to be the 점유 that forms the basis of 취득시효. ㄷ. If 甲, who has created a 양도담보 over X land, has possessed X land 평온하고 공연하게 with 소유의 의사 for 20 years, since acquisition of 소유권 by 취득시효 is an 원시취득, 甲 may seek 말소 of the 소유권이전등기 made for 담보목적 on the ground of 점유취득시효. ㄹ. If 甲, the 시효취득자 of X land, assigns to 丙 the right to claim 소유권이전등기 arising from completion of 취득시효, notification by 甲 to 乙, the 등기명의인, of that assignment gives rise to 대항력 against 乙.
A: ㄱ, ㄷ
B: ㄴ, ㄹ
C: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ
D: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ
E: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ

label: C
question: Which of the following explanations concerning 법률행위의 부관 is not correct? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.)
A: Even if there is an intent to make the 발생 or 소멸 of a juristic act's effect depend on whether a future uncertain fact occurs, if that intent is not externally 표시되지 않으면, it cannot become a condition as an ancillary clause of the 법률행위.
B: The burden of proving that a certain juristic act falls under a 정지조건부 법률행위 lies with the person who seeks to 주장 that the 법률효과 arising from that juristic act has not occurred.
C: ‘when the fulfillment of a condition has been hindered’ means a situation where, in light of 사회통념, the condition would have been fulfilled if there had been no obstructing act by one party, but it was not fulfilled because of that obstruction, and this includes even cases where the possibility of the condition’s fulfillment was 현저히 낮았던 경우 even if there had been no such obstructing act.
D: If, after completing the registration of a transfer of ownership of real property due to a gift subject to a resolutory condition, the 해제조건 is fulfilled, ownership reverts to the donor. In such a case, acts of disposition made by the donee before the condition is fulfilled are 무효 to the extent that they limit the effect of the condition’s fulfillment; however, if that condition has not been 등기되지 않았다면, the donee may not assert such 무효 against a third party who acquired rights through the disposition act.
E: If the parties have designated the time when an uncertain fact 발생 as the time for performance, then the 이행기한 should be deemed to have arrived not only when that fact occurs, but also when the occurrence of that fact has become impossible.

label: D
question: Which of the following statements concerning a physician’s 설명의무 are incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) ㄱ. A physician’s 설명의무 for obtaining the patient’s 승낙 to surgery, etc. cannot be exempted solely because the risk of 후유증 or 부작용 arising from the medical act is 희소; if such 후유증 or 부작용 are risks that typically arise from the relevant 치료행위 or are serious and irreversible, they remain subject to explanation despite the slight likelihood of occurrence. ㄴ. The burden of proof regarding a physician’s violation of the 설명의무 lies with the patient side, absent 특별한 사정. ㄷ. A physician’s 설명의무 must be performed with sufficient 시간적 여유 before the medical act is carried out. ㄹ. Even if the patient is a 미성년자 and has 의사결정능력, it is difficult to regard the patient as having 자기결정권 even with respect to medical acts that expose the patient’s own body to 위험; accordingly, in principle, a physician does not bear a duty to explain medical acts to a minor patient.
A: ㄱ, ㄴ
B: ㄱ, ㄷ
C: ㄴ, ㄷ
D: ㄴ, ㄹ
E: ㄷ, ㄹ

label: B
question: Among the explanations concerning 흠 있는 의사표시, which one is correct? (Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the 판례.)
A: In a non-genuine declaration of intent, 진의 means the matter that the declarant genuinely wishes in his or her mind, so if, at the time the declarant made a declaration of intent to make a gift under 강박, the declarant’s true thought was latent in his or her mind that property would be forcibly taken away, then that gift declaration of intent lacks the internal effect-intent to produce a gift and thus constitutes a 비진의 의사표시.
B: Where an act of 출연 by written instrument is made for the establishment of a foundation juristic person, even if the 법인 is established and the contributed property becomes 기본재산, the act of contribution may be 취소 on the ground that it is a declaration of intent based on 착오.
C: In a real estate sale contract, if both the parties, 甲 and 乙, intended A 토지 to be the object of the contract, but made a mistake as to the lot number and other details of that object and indicated the object as B 토지 in the contract, then under normative interpretation the sale contract should first be regarded as having been concluded with respect to B 토지; however, the seller 甲 may cancel the above sale contract on the ground of 착오.
D: After A assigned to C the 임대차보증금반환채권 against B, creditor D of C obtained a 채권압류 및 추심명령 with respect to the above claim, and if the assignment contract for that 임대차보증금반환채권 is a 통정허위표시 and therefore 무효, then because D is merely a person who acquired the 추심권 concerning the above claim, B may assert against D that the above assignment contract is a 통정허위표시 and therefore 무효, regardless of whether D acted in 선의 with respect to the 통정허위표시.
E: If, under the mistaken belief that if a restitution lawsuit is brought, the real property would have to be returned without receiving any compensation, one enters into a 매매계약 to sell it, this is merely a mistake as to 동기; therefore, only if there is an agreement to make that motive part of the contents of the 의사표시 may the seller 취소 the above sale contract on the ground of 착오.

label: C
question: Which of the following statements concerning an order for registration of a leasehold right are correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) ㄱ. A tenant who has registered a leasehold right by an order for registration of a leasehold right, where that leasehold right registration was completed before the registration of the first auction commencement order, falls within the class of creditors entitled to distribution even if the tenant does not separately file a demand for distribution. ㄴ. Under the Housing Lease Protection Act, the landlord’s obligation to return the lease deposit is an obligation that must be performed before the tenant’s obligation to cancel the leasehold right registration. ㄷ. Because the Housing Lease Protection Act partially applies mutatis mutandis the procedural provisions on provisional seizure under the Civil Execution Act to judicial proceedings on an application for an order for registration of a leasehold right and to the enforcement, etc. of an order for registration of a leasehold right, leasehold right registration pursuant to an order for registration of a leasehold right prescribed by the Housing Lease Protection Act has the effect of interrupting the statute of limitations, equivalent to seizure, provisional seizure, or provisional disposition, which are grounds for interruption of the statute of limitations.
A: ㄱ
B: ㄴ
C: ㄱ, ㄴ
D: ㄱ, ㄷ
E: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ

label: D
question: Which of the following statements concerning 동시이행 is correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.)
A: In a contract for work, where the contractor fails to properly perform the obligations under the contract and, as a result, causes damage to the employer’s body or property, the contractor’s damages obligation arising from such 확대손해 and the employer’s obligation to pay the 공사대금 are not in a simultaneous performance relationship.
B: An obligation to cancel a transfer registration of ownership in the creditor’s name, or a provisional registration for preservation of the claim therefor, which was completed for the purpose of securing a secured debt, is in a simultaneous performance relationship with repayment of the secured obligation.
C: Where a foreclosure auction for the execution of a mortgage is rendered void and Creditor 甲, who is the mortgagee, exercises, on behalf of Debtor 丙, the right to claim cancellation of the transfer registration of ownership against successful bidder 乙, 甲’s obligation to return the distribution money and 乙’s obligation to cancel the transfer registration of ownership are in a simultaneous performance relationship.
D: An employer who has assumed the contractor’s obligation to pay the construction price to a subcontractor may oppose the subcontractor’s claim for the construction price with a simultaneous performance defense based on the contractor’s right to claim repair of defects against the subcontractor.
E: In a lease of a 상가건물, the tenant’s obligation to return the 임차목적물 and the landlord’s obligation to compensate for damages arising from 방해 of premium recovery are not only based on the same cause, namely the 종료 of the 임대차계약, but even from the perspective of 공평, a connection in 이행 can be recognized.

label: C
question: A had, with his 사실혼 spouse B, an adult child C whom A had 인지, and C has a child D born during 혼인. A, after being treated for a chronic 질병 for a long time, died on 2022. 10. 1. At the time of death, A had a 대여금 채권 against A, real property X, and a 물품대금 채무 to B. Which of the following is incorrect with respect to this? (Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the 판례.)
A: Even if 乙 cared for 甲 during 甲의 illness to the extent of 특별한 부양 beyond the primary support duty required between spouses, 乙 cannot claim a contributory share under ｢민법｣ 제1008조의2 제1항.
B: If C filed an 상속포기 신고 on 2022. 10. 20., and before being notified of the judicial decision that accepts the 상속포기 신고, C collects and receives payment from A for the above 대여금 채권, it is deemed a simple 승인.
C: 丙이 2022. 10. 20. 상속포기 신고를 한 경우, 그때부터 상속포기 신고 수리 심판을 고지받기 전까지는 X 부동산에 대해 선량한 관리자의 주의로 관리할 의무를 진다.
D: B가 2022. 10. 12. 丙을 상대로 X 부동산에 관한 가압류결정을 받아 그 집행으로 같은 달 13. 가압류등기가 마쳐진 후 丙이 2022. 10. 24. 상속포기 신고 수리 심판을 고지받은 경우, B는 그 후 적법하게 진행된 X 부동산에 대한 경매절차에서 가압류채권자로서 배당을 받을 수 있다.
E: If A had a lawful spouse 戊 who had been living separately for a long time, and after A’s death C filed with the Family Court a 적법한 요건을 갖춘 declaration renouncing inheritance, then 戊 becomes the sole heir.

label: E
question: A and B jointly own the X building in 1/2 shares each. The X building was constructed on the Y land owned by C. Which of the following statements is not correct? (Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, the precedents apply.)
A: 甲은 특별한 사정이 없는 한 자신의 지분 범위 내에서만 X 건물의 불법점유자에 대해서 손해배상이나 부당이득의 반환을 청구할 수 있다.
B: 甲이 X 건물을 배타적으로 사용하더라도 乙은 甲에게 X 건물의 인도를 청구할 수 없다.
C: X 건물이 Y 토지 위에 무단으로 건축된 경우, 丙은 X 건물을 단독으로 점유하고 있는 甲을 상대로 甲의 지분 범위 내에서 X 건물의 철거를 청구할 수 있지만, X 건물에서 퇴거할 것을 청구할 수는 없다.
D: 甲과 乙이 X 건물을 일주일씩 교대로 사용하기로 하는 약정을 하였다면, 특별한 사정이 없는 한 그 약정은 乙의 지분을 양도받은 특정승계인 丙丁에게 승계된다.
E: 甲이 X 건물의 보수를 위하여 丁戊과와 보수공사계약을 체결한 경우에 甲이 공사대금을 지급하지 않는다면 丁戊은는 乙에게 지분 범위 내에서 공사대금을 부당이득으로 반환청구할 수 있다.

label: E
question: A entered into a sales contract on 2020. 2. 10. with B concerning X 부동산 owned by B, and on 2020. 3. 10., while paying B the entire 매매대금, simultaneously had the 소유권이전등기 made directly from B to C in C's name pursuant to a 명의신탁약정 between A and his friend C. Which of the following statements based on these facts is incorrect? (Each 지문 is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the 판례.)
A: 甲과 丙 사이의 약정과 그로 인한 丙 명의의 소유권이전등기는 무효이지만 甲은 丙을 상대로 부당이득반환을 원인으로 하여 X 부동산의 소유권이전등기를 구할 수는 없다.
B: 甲이 A와 사이에 X 부동산에 관하여 매매계약을 체결하고 이에 기하여 丙에서 A 앞으로 바로 마쳐 준 소유권이전등기는 특별한 사정이 없는 한 실체관계에 부합하는 등기로서 유효하다.
C: 丙에 대한 금전채권자 B가 자신의 금전채권을 피보전권리로 하여 X 부동산에 대하여 가압류를 신청하여 가압류등기가 마쳐진 경우 B의 가압류는 유효하다.
D: 丙이 임의로 甲과 丙 사이의 약정 사실을 알고 있는 C와 X 부동산에 관하여 ㅛ매매계약을 체결하고 대금을 지급받음과 동시에 C에게 소유권이전등기를 마쳐 준 경우 丙은 甲에게 ｢민법｣ 제750조에 따른 손해배상책임을 질 수 있다.
E: 丙이 임의로 자신의 채권자 D를 위하여 X 부동산에 관하여 D 명의의 근저당권을 설정해 준 경우 丙은 근저당권의 피담보채무액 상당의 이익을 얻었고 그로 인하여 乙은 소유권을 침해당한 손실을 입었으므로, 丙은 乙에 대하여 부당이득반환의무를 부담한다.

label: C
question: Among the explanations concerning 상속, which is not correct? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.)
A: If a predeceased person received a house as a gift from the decedent before the 발생 of the cause for representation, that benefit may be regarded as the 특별수익 of the heir by 대습상속.
B: If a person disqualified from inheritance received a gift from the decedent after the ground for 상속결격 arose, then, absent 특별한 사정, that benefit does not constitute the special benefit of the heir by representation arising from inheritance disqualification.
C: A coheir who received 특별수익 exceeding the value of the statutory 상속분 must 반환 the excess when the 상속재산 is 분할되는 시에.
D: If no agreement is reached among the 공동상속인들, unless there are special circumstances under which the status of the person presiding over ancestral rites cannot be 인정될 수 없는 경우, the eldest among the 피상속인의 직계비속, regardless of sex or whether 적서인지, who is the most recent in degree, becomes the 제사주재자.
E: If the decedent, by an act inter vivos or by will, disposed of his or her 유체·유골 or designated a burial place, the person presiding over ancestral rites cannot be said to bear even a 법률적 duty to be unconditionally bound by such intent of the decedent.

label: E
question: Which of the following correctly combines the statements that are correct (○) and incorrect (×) regarding the 대상청구권? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents) ㄱ. If the 매도인의 소유권이전등기 의무 becomes 이행불능 because the 매매목적물 was 수용, the 소멸시효 of the 대상청구권 runs from the time performance became impossible even if the method and procedure for claiming 수용보상금 were not established until a considerable period later. ㄴ. A obtained a final judgment against B seeking 사해행위취소 and, by 원물반환, cancellation of the 근저당권설정등기, but thereafter the relevant real property was sold to a third party at auction, making B's duty under that final judgment to cancel the 근저당권설정등기 impossible to perform. In this case, A may exercise the 대상청구권 and demand the return of the 배당금 received by B on the basis of that mortgage. ㄷ. Where the 매매목적물 is 수용 before registration of ownership transfer under the sale, the purchaser's claim against the seller seeking a declaration that the 수용보상금청구권 belongs to the purchaser is a claim concerning the 귀속 of a claim, where two or more persons assert that they are 채권자 with respect to one claim, and thus there is a 법률상 이익 in seeking such a declaration.

label: D
question: A은 2023. 2. 1. B에게 A 소유 X real property를 KRW 100,000,000에 sell하기로 contract를 체결하고, contract day에 B로부터 down payment KRW 10,000,000을 received하였다. The written contract provides that the due date for payment of the intermediate payment KRW 30,000,000 is 2023. 5. 1., and the due date for payment of the balance KRW 60,000,000 is 2023. 8. 1., each set as follows, and the contract includes the following content. Article △△ (Rescission of Contract) If the buyer does not pay the intermediate payment on the agreed date, the contract is automatically rescinded. In this case, the buyer may not claim return of the paid down payment. If, due to the seller’s intentional act or negligence, the buyer cannot acquire ownership of X real property and the buyer rescinds the contract, the seller shall return the money received from the buyer by adding interest at 10% per annum from the date of receipt until the time of rescission. Which of the following statements are all correct? (Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) ㄱ. If B failed to pay the intermediate payment to A by 2023. 5. 1., then unless special circumstances exist, the contract is rescinded without a separate demand or expression of intent to rescind, and B may not claim return of the paid down payment. ㄴ. Even if the above contract was rescinded pursuant to Article △△, Paragraph 1, if A and B continued discussions on the premise that the contract remained valid and A urged performance according to the contract without asserting the legal effects of rescission, then unless special circumstances exist, it is appropriate to regard that there was an agreement between A and B to revive the rescinded contract. ㄷ. If B rescinded the above contract pursuant to Article △△, Paragraph 2, and claimed return of the money paid to A and payment of interest thereon, and A delayed performance thereof, then unless special circumstances exist, the delay damages therefrom must be calculated at the rate of 10% per annum. ㄹ. If A and B agreed to rescind the contract irrespective of the above contractual clause, and there was no separate agreement on interest to be added to the money to be returned due to the consensual rescission, then the money paid by B must be returned with interest at 10% per annum from the date of payment.
A: ㄱ, ㄴ
B: ㄱ, ㄷ
C: ㄴ, ㄹ
D: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ
E: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ

label: A
question: Which of the following statements concerning monetary claims and 이에 대한 지체책임 is correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.)
A: If the creditor of a loan for consumption, through intent or negligence, receives interest exceeding the maximum interest rate under the ｢이자제한법｣, and if the excess portion is appropriated to the principal so that the principal is fully extinguished and yet an amount remains, then, absent special circumstances, tort liability arises for the creditor with respect to that portion.
B: If an order of assignment for a part of a monetary claim becomes final and conclusive, a set-off by a third-party debtor, who holds a counterclaim against the seizure debtor with respect to that claim, must be exercised in accordance with the respective proportions of the amount of the claim subject to 전부명령 and the amount not subject to 전부명령, relative to the total amount of the claim.
C: Unless there is 별도의 agreement concerning the overdue interest rate on a surety obligation, the agreed overdue interest rate for the principal obligation applies to the 보증채무.
D: Where the performance time is set as an uncertain due date, the debtor becomes liable for 이행지체 from the time the due date arrives.
E: If damage arises due to the tort of the 피보증인, the identity guarantor bears 지체책임 with respect to the 신원보증채무 from the time of the 피보증인’s 불법행위.

label: B
question: A entered into a construction contract with B, a construction contractor, in order to newly construct Building Y on A’s land X. In order to enable B to obtain a loan from C using land X as security and to expend the construction costs, A established on land X a mortgage, with C as the mortgagee and B as the debtor, and B used the money borrowed from C as the construction price. During the progress of the construction, D, a creditor of B, obtained an order of seizure and assignment for part of B’s claim for the construction price against A, and the order became final as it stood. Thereafter, even though the construction was completed, B was unable to repay the loan to C, so A, by subrogation for B, paid C the principal of the loan and the overdue interest. Among the following explanations, which are all correct? If there is a dispute, follow the precedents. ㄱ. When the 전부명령 was served on A, retroactively, a divisible claim is established between D and B with respect to the portion of the claim that was 전부된 and the portion of the claim that was not 전부된. ㄴ. B’s obligation to deliver Y building is in a concurrent-performance relationship with A’s debt to pay the construction price, but B’s obligation to cancel the mortgage on X land is not an obligation having an inherent quid pro quo relationship under the above construction contract, so an 이행상 견련관계 with A’s debt to pay the construction price cannot be recognized. ㄷ. B’s 구상금채무 arising from A’s 대위변제 is, as a transformed form of B’s obligation to cancel the mortgage on X land, in a concurrent-performance relationship with A’s debt to pay the construction price within the extent of the equal amount. ㄹ. If, in response to D’s 전부금청구, A raises a set-off defense using A’s 구상금채권 against B, A cannot oppose D by set-off based on the above 구상금채권 because A’s active claim, namely A’s 구상금채권 against B, arose after D’s 압류명령 was served on A.
A: ㄱ, ㄴ
B: ㄱ, ㄷ
C: ㄴ, ㄹ
D: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ
E: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㄹ

label: D
question: On 2020. 8. 11., A entered into a loan contract with B, and in order to secure A’s claim against B, A established a mortgage with a maximum secured amount of KRW 1.2 billion on land X owned by B, and C and D, at B’s request, entered into a joint surety contract with A. When B failed to repay the above debt, A filed an application for a voluntary auction based on the above mortgage over land X on 2023. 1. 23., and at the time of the auction application A’s claim against B amounted to KRW 1.2 billion. During the auction proceedings, C repaid KRW 400 million to A and D repaid KRW 200 million to A, and accordingly received a registration of transfer of part of the mortgage from A. After filing the auction application, A additionally lent KRW 300 million to B on 2023. 5. 12., and in the auction proceedings E purchased land X for KRW 900 million and paid the purchase price in full on 2023. 8. 18. Which combination of amounts to be distributed to A, C, and D in the above auction proceedings is correct? Interest, delayed damages, and execution costs are not considered. If there is a dispute, follow the precedents. The amounts in the following choices mean, in order, the respective amounts for A, C, and D.
A: 3억 원, 4억 원, and 2억 원
B: KRW 4억 5,000만 원, KRW 3억 원, and KRW 1억 5,000만 원
C: KRW 540 million, KRW 240 million, and KRW 120 million are 5억 4,000만 원, 2억 4,000만 원, and 1억 2,000만 원 respectively.
D: Please provide the English-Korean parallel sentence pair you want code-switched.
E: KRW 900 million, 0원, and 0원

label: E
question: Which of the following statements concerning 채권의 소멸 are correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.) ㄱ. During the 임대차 존속, if the 소멸시효 for the 차임채권 has expired, the lessor may not set it off against the 임대차보증금 반환채무 by using it as the 자동채권, but under the 유추적용 of ｢민법｣ 제495조, the overdue 차임 may be deducted from the 임대차보증금. ㄴ. Even where, due to special circumstances such as there being no risk of impairing the worker's 경제생활 안정을 해할 염려가 없는 경우, the employer may set off against the worker's 임금채권 by using the employer's 부당이득반환청구권 arising from overpaid 임금, such set-off by the employer is permitted only with respect to the portion exceeding 2분의 1 of the 임금채권. ㄷ. Where the 채권양수인 set off the 양수채권, as the 자동채권, against an existing 채권 that the debtor had against the 양수인, even if the 변제기 for both claims had already arrived before the 채권양도, the effect of the 상계 retroacts not to the 변제기 but to the time when the 대항요건 for the 채권양도 were satisfied. ㄹ. If the 소멸시효 for the 대여금채권 that the lessor held against the lessee expired during the 임대차 존속, the lessor may not set off the lessee's 유익비상환채권 against the lessor by using the above claim as the 자동채권.
A: ㄱ, ㄹ
B: ㄴ, ㄷ
C: ㄷ, ㄹ
D: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ
E: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ

label: C
question: Which of the following correctly combines the statements that are true (○) and false (×) regarding 다수당사자 채권관계? (이자와 지연손해금은 고려하지 않음. 다툼이 있는 경우 판례에 의함) ㄱ. If one of the 연대채무자 is released from part of the debt, and the remaining debt that that 연대채무자 must pay exceeds the 부담부분, then the other 연대채무자 must bear the entire debt. ㄴ. In a 중첩적 채무인수, the 채무자 and the 인수인 are, in principle, in a 부진정연대채무관계. ㄷ. If a 채권자 files an 경매신청 against real property owned by one of the 연대채무자 and, within 6 months thereafter, brings a 재판상 청구 against another 연대채무자, then the 소멸시효 of the claim against that other 연대채무자 is interrupted as of the 경매신청 time, and the interrupted 시효 begins anew from the termination of the above 경매절차. ㄹ. 甲, 乙, and 丙 caused 丁 damage of 9 million won through 공동불법행위. Internally, 甲 was without 과실, and the degree of 과실 of 乙 and 丙 was equal. If 甲 compensated 丁 for the full 9 million won, 甲 may demand performance of the 구상채무 of 9 million won against 乙.

label: D
question: Which of the following statements regarding 부양의무 are correct? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.) ㄱ. Because the duty of support between spouses is intended to make it possible to maintain the spouses’ 공동생활, if the marriage has 사실상 파탄되어 the spouses are living separately while filing divorce actions against each other, then unless there are 특별한 사정, the duty of support between the spouses should be deemed 소멸 even before the divorce is finalized. ㄴ. With respect to past 부양료 among spouses, unless there are 특별한 사정, the person entitled to support may claim payment only for the period after the obligor fell into 이행지체 by failing to perform the duty of support despite a demand for performance of that duty. ㄷ. If one spouse refuses 동거 without 정당한 이유, then unless there are 특별한 사정 such as the other spouse’s claim for cohabitation constituting 권리의 남용, that spouse cannot claim payment of 부양료 from the other party. ㄹ. The right of one spouse who has raised the child alone to seek payment of 과거 양육비 from the other spouse does not run under 소멸시효 until, through an agreement of the parties or a family court 심판, etc., it has become a 구체적인 지급청구권.
A: ㄱ, ㄴ
B: ㄱ, ㄷ
C: ㄴ, ㄹ
D: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ
E: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ

label: A
question: A and B entered into a contract under which B would purchase land X owned by A, and they agreed that the purchase price would be paid simultaneously with delivery of land X and completion of the registration of ownership transfer. C provided a joint and several suretyship for B’s obligation to pay the purchase price to A under the above sales contract. Which of the following statements are incorrect? If there is a dispute, follow the precedents. ㄱ. After B pays A the full purchase price, if B assigns the claim for registration of ownership transfer to D and B notifies A thereof, D may directly demand A’s performance of the registration procedure for ownership transfer. ㄴ. A assigned to D the claim for the purchase price against B while explaining the content of the above contract and the fact that the ownership transfer registration for land X had not yet been completed, and on the same day B gave assent to the assignment of claim without reservation of objection. Thereafter, if D demands B to pay the assigned amount, B cannot refuse D’s demand on the ground that A had not tendered performance of the duty to register ownership transfer. ㄷ. Even if A assigned the claim for the purchase price against B to D and notified B thereof by an instrument bearing a fixed date, if A later assigned the claim against B again to E, then after A and D rescinded by agreement the assignment contract between them and D notified B of the rescission by agreement, E acquires the claim for the purchase price against B absent special circumstances. ㄹ. If A assigns the claim for the purchase price against B to D and notifies B thereof, then absent special circumstances not only the claim against B but also the claim against C is transferred to D together. ㅁ. Although A and B agreed in the sales contract not to assign the claim, A assigned the claim for the purchase price to D, who knew of such agreement, and notified B thereof, and thereafter D again assigned the claim for the purchase price to E, who did not know of the agreement between A and B, and notified B thereof, B cannot assert against E the existence of the special agreement prohibiting assignment of claims.
A: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ
B: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ
C: ㄴ, ㄹ, ㅁ
D: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ
E: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㄹ, ㅁ

label: C
question: A has, against 乙, a matured loan claim in the amount of KRW 200 million (A 채권), and 乙, who is in a 채무초과 state, has, against 丙, a matured loan claim in the amount of KRW 200 million (B 채권), and 乙 made a gift of the X real property owned by 乙 to 丁. Which of the following explanations is not correct? (Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the 판례.)
A: A may, in order to preserve the A claim, bring an action by subrogating to 乙 against 丙, seeking that 丙 pay the B claim directly to A, and if, after the judgment became final and conclusive, A’s creditor 戊 obtained an order of seizure and an order of assignment with respect to such claim of A against 丙 for payment, then both the seizure order and the assignment order are void.
B: Where 甲, without seeking payment of Claim A against 乙, brings a creditor’s subrogation action against 丙 seeking payment of Claim B on the basis of A 채권 as the preserved claim, 丙 may contest by asserting that A 채권 was extinguished by 변제, but 丙 may not oppose 甲 by asserting that A 채권 was extinguished by 시효.
C: After 乙 became aware that 甲 had exercised the creditor’s subrogation right against 丙, if during the pendency of the creditor’s subrogation suit an order of seizure and an order of assignment were made with respect to B claim upon the application of 己, another creditor of 乙, then the order of assignment with respect to B claim is 무효 unless 특별한 사정 exist, but the order of seizure is 유효, so 甲’s above creditor’s subrogation suit against 丙 is 기각된다.
D: Where 甲 has, pursuant to a 사해행위취소소송, a 가액배상채권 against 丁, it is not permissible for 丁 to assert 상계 against 甲 on the ground that 丁 has a 채권 against 乙 and thereby refuse to pay the 안분액 corresponding to 丁’s own 채권 out of the 총채권액.
E: If 甲, using A claim as the preserved claim, filed an action for revocation of a fraudulent act against 丁 within the preclusive period and then, after the preclusive period had expired, changed the preserved claim to a claim for return of unjust enrichment against 乙, this does not constitute an exchange amendment of the action, so the above action for revocation of a fraudulent act is lawful.

label: E
question: A granted a jeonse right over building X, which A owns, to B. Which of the following statements are incorrect? Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the precedents. ㄱ. After B granted a mortgage over the jeonse right for B’s creditor C, if A lent money to B without setting a maturity date, and after the term of the jeonse right expired C attached B’s claim for return of the jeonse deposit by way of real subrogation, A may assert setoff against C by using the loan claim and the claim for return of the jeonse deposit. ㄴ. If B granted a mortgage over the jeonse right for B’s creditor C, and after the term of the jeonse right expired B’s general creditor D provisionally attached the claim for return of the jeonse deposit, and then C obtained an attachment and an order of transfer over B’s claim for return of the jeonse deposit by way of real subrogation, C cannot demand payment of the jeonse deposit from A. ㄷ. B’s jeonse right was established to secure a claim for return of a lease deposit under a lease agreement. If B granted a mortgage over the jeonse right for B’s creditor C while knowing this circumstance, A may assert against C, who exercises the right of real subrogation, a defense of deduction of overdue rent under the lease agreement. ㄹ. After the term expired, if B assigned the claim for return of the jeonse deposit together with the jeonse right and made supplementary registration in the name of transferee E, the priority between E and the creditor who attached the claim for return of the jeonse deposit and obtained an order of transfer is determined according to whether the time of the supplementary registration precedes or follows the time of attachment.
A: ㄱ, ㄴ
B: ㄱ, ㄹ
C: ㄴ, ㄹ
D: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ
E: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ

label: A
question: A는 2015. 2. 1. B에게 1억 원을 loan하면서 due date를 2016. 1. 31.로 정하였는데, B은 그 loan을 전혀 repaid하지 않은 상태에서 2021. 4. 1. 자신의 only asset인 약 3억 원 상당의 X land를 C에게 sold하고, the next day ownership transfer registration을 completed해 주었다. A는 20232. 2. 21. C를 defendant로 하여 아래와 같은 relief claim을 제기하였고, court of first instance는 아래 operative part와 같은 judgment를 rendered하였다. [Prayer for Relief] 1. Defendant와 B 사이에 X land에 관하여 2021. 4. 1. concluded된 sales contract을 revoke한다. 2. Defendant는 B에게 제1항 기재 land에 관하여 Seoul Central District Court Registry Office 2021. 4. 2. received No. 1234로 마친 ownership transfer registration의 cancellation registration procedure를 comply하라. 3. litigation costs는 Defendant가 bear한다. 4. paragraph 2는 provisional execution할 수 있다.  [Operative Part] 1. Defendant와 B 사이에 X land에 관하여 2021. 4. 1. concluded된 sales contract을 100,000,000 won의 limit within에서 revoke한다. 2. Defendant는 Plaintiff에게 100,000,000 won을 pay하라. 3. Plaintiff의 remaining claim은 dismiss한다. 4. litigation costs는 Defendant가 bear한다. 5. Paragraph 2는 provisional execution할 수 있다.  이에 관한 설명 중 all correct한 것을 모두 고른 것은? (X land의 market value 변동은 없다고 가정하고, interest와 delay damages는 not considered. 각 statement는 independent하며, if there is a dispute, precedents에 따른다) ㄱ. 만약 X land에 관하여 2020. 3. 15.에 established된 mortgage right(secured debt amount 100,000,000 won)가 2021. 5. 1.에 extinguished되었다면 court가 claim amendment 없이 order paragraphs 1 and 2와 같은 judgment를 rendered한 것은 proper하다. ㄴ. court가 order paragraph 5와 같이 provisional execution을 declared한 것은 proper하다. ㄷ. 만약 A가 order paragraph 2와 같이 100,000,000 won payment를 seek하는 것으로 claim을 amend하면서 ｢Act on Special Cases Concerning Expedition, etc. of Legal Proceedings｣에 따라 연 12% rate의 delay damages를 claimed하였다면, court는 order paragraph 2에서 연 12% rate의 delay damages를 order하는 judgment를 rendered할 수 있다. ㄹ. 만약 A가 bank이고 C가 A의 loan claim에 대한 extinctive prescription defense를 raised하였다면, court는 A의 claim을 in its entirety dismiss하는 judgment를 rendered했을 것이다. ㅁ. C가 A에 대하여 가지는 monetary claim을 enforcement claim으로 하여 order paragraph 2의 monetary compensation claim에 대하여 받은 attachment and assignment order는 void이다.
A: ㄱ, ㄹ
B: ㄱ, ㅁ
C: ㄴ, ㄷ
D: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㄹ
E: ㄴ, ㄹ, ㅁ

label: D
question: A entered into a 질권설정계약 with C, for the purpose of securing A’s 금전채무 to C, with respect to A’s 임대차보증금반환채권 against B, and notified B of this fact by an instrument bearing a 확정일자. Which of the following is the correct combination of the true statement (○) and the false statement (×)? Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the 판례. ㄱ. If A establishes a 질권 in favor of C with respect to a lease deposit return claim secured by a 저당권, and the 추가등기 of the 질권 does not separately state the claim’s 지연손해금, then this is not included in the scope of the 피담보채권 under the 저당권부 질권. ㄴ. Even if B, without C’s consent, set off a claim against A against the 임대차보증금반환채권 and thereby extinguished it, C may still directly demand 변제 of the debt from B. ㄷ. If, with respect to A’s 임대차보증금반환채권, an 압류 and 전부명령 was issued upon the application of D, A’s 일반채권자, and if C had satisfied the 대항요건 by an instrument bearing a 확정일자 before the day on which the order was served on B, then B may not oppose C on the ground that B paid D. ㄹ. If, after A had granted a 질권 to C, a 저당권 was established on real property owned by B in order to secure A’s 임대차보증금반환채권, unless C made an additional등기 of the 질권 in the 등기 of the above 저당권, the effect of the 질권 does not extend to the 저당권.

label: E
question: Which of the following is the correct combination of the statements that are correct (○) and incorrect (×) regarding statutory superficies for X land? (Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow precedent) ㄱ. After A set up a mortgage in B’s name with respect to A’s owned X land, A constructed a Y building on X land with B’s consent. If the mortgage is enforced and C acquires ownership of X land, A acquires a statutory superficies under Article 366 of the Civil Act. ㄴ. After C, A’s creditor, provisionally attached the Y building owned by A on X land owned by B, B acquired ownership of the Y building. If principal seizure and compulsory auction proceedings based on the above provisional attachment proceed and D acquires ownership of the Y building, D acquires a customary superficies. ㄷ. A, after completing a provisional registration in B’s name in order to secure a claim against B with respect to X land owned by A, thereafter constructed a Y building on X land. If B later completes the principal registration based on the above provisional registration, A does not acquire a customary superficies. ㄹ. Where A and B co-owned X land and Y building in equal 1/2 shares, and A donated his co-ownership share in the Y building to C, C acquires a customary superficies.

label: E
question: Which of the following explanations concerning the 채권자취소권 is incorrect? (Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow 판례.)
A: Where real property ownership has been transferred by a 사해행위, and after that a third party acquires rights such as a 저당권 or 지상권 over the real property, the creditor may claim against the 수익자 avoidance of the 사해행위 and performance of the procedure for 소유권이전등기 to the debtor.
B: 甲이 2023. 7.경 자신의 유일한 재산인 X 부동산을 배우자인 乙에게 명의신탁하였는데, 甲이 위 명의신탁약정의 해지를 전제로 X 부동산을 丙에게 매도하고, 甲, 乙, 丙 간의 합의하에 乙에게서 곧바로 丙 앞으로 소유권이전등기를 마쳐 준 경우, 甲과 丙 사이의 위 매매는 甲의 일반채권자들을 해하는 사해행위에 해당할 수 있다.
C: An act by which a debtor, with respect to real property that is his only asset, newly enters into a 매매예약 in order to extend the 제척기간 when the expiration of the 제척기간 for the right to 완결 the reservation under the 매매예약 is imminent may constitute a 사해행위 subject to the creditor's 취소권.
D: Where, after a 사해행위 has occurred, a creditor, knowing that there is a 취소원인, assigns the 피보전채권 to be preserved, and the 양수인 exercises the creditor's 채권자취소권 to preserve that claim, whether the 제척기간 has elapsed should be determined based on the day on which the 양도인 of that claim became aware of the 취소원인.
E: 乙이 2023. 7.경 친구인 甲과 체결한 명의신탁약정에 따라 명의신탁 사실을 알지 못하는 X 부동산의 소유자 丙과 X 부동산에 대한 매매계약을 체결하고 乙 명의로 소유권이전등기가 경료된 후 채무초과 상태에 있는 甲이 실질적인 당사자가 되어 X 부동산을 제3자에게 매도하였다면, 甲의 매도행위는 甲의 일반채권자에 대한 사해행위가 된다.

label: C
question: Which of the following statements regarding 친자관계 is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.)
A: Even if a 조정 or 재판상 화해 is concluded that includes a statement confirming there is no 친생자관계 between the parties, it has no 효력.
B: Even a relative prescribed in Article 777 of the Civil Act is recognized as having standing as a plaintiff in an action to confirm the existence or nonexistence of a natural parent-child relationship only when that person qualifies as an interested party prescribed in Article 865 of the Civil Act.
C: Where the co-heirs 乙 and 丙 of the decedent 甲, who was female, have already divided or disposed of the inherited property, and it is clearly revealed by a final judgment confirming the existence of a natural parent-child relationship that 丁 is 甲’s child, the proviso to Article 860 of the Civil Act concerning the limitation on the retroactive effect of 인지 does not apply, and therefore 丁 cannot deny the validity of the division or disposition made by 乙 and 丙.
D: Where a child born through artificial insemination is born between a husband and wife who are living a normal marital life, the child born through artificial insemination is presumed to be the husband’s child, and if the husband later retracts his consent to the artificial insemination and files an action to disavow paternity, such action is not permitted.
E: A gender correction must not be denied merely because a transgender person has a minor child, without making a substantive determination by considering various circumstances for balancing legal interests so as to harmonize the protection of the transgender person’s fundamental rights with the protection and welfare of the minor child.

label: E
question: A, who operates a 가구 manufacturing business, received 목재 worth 10,000,000 won from B, a 원자재 supplier, and delivered to B the following 약속어음. Which of the following statements is incorrect? If there is a dispute, follow the 판례. <FRONT> Promissory Note To A Amount: 10,000,000 won I will pay the above amount to you or your 지시인 against this promissory note. Due date: 2023. 12. 5. Date of issue: 2023. 5. 1. Place of payment: 105, Sunae-dong, Bundang-gu, Seongnam-si Issuer: C (Jonghyeon Sofa) Place of payment: Hyochang Bank Co., Ltd., Sunae-dong Branch <BACK> Please pay the amount stated on the front to B or B's 지시인. 거절증서 작성을 면제함. 2023. 6. 20. Address: 123, Hadan 1-dong, Saha-gu, Busan Name: A (Gyeongjin Furniture)
A: Unless there are special circumstances, 甲 is presumed to have delivered the promissory note to 乙 for payment to 乙.
B: 甲 may, in principle, raise a 동시이행항변 that he will pay against the 어음 when 乙 demands payment of the 목재대금; however, if the rights under the 어음 have been extinguished by 시효완성 and 甲 faces no risk of 이중지급 and also cannot exercise 권리 against the other 어음상 채무자, the right to assert the 동시이행항변권 is denied.
C: B may first exercise the 어음채권, and only when satisfaction cannot be obtained thereby may B exercise the 목재대금채권 against A.
D: If 乙 did not take the necessary 조치 to interrupt the statute of limitations, and the 소멸시효 for the rights under the note has been completed, then if 甲, after receiving the note back, can obtain satisfaction of his own 원인채권 against 丙 by exercising that claim, 甲 cannot exercise a 손해배상청구권 against 乙.
E: If C issued the above 어음 to A for 지급 of the 가구대금, and thereafter the furniture 매매계약 was 해제되었다면, C may 이를 이유로 assert this against B's 어음금 청구.

label: E
question: B created a joint mortgage (공동저당권) on B-owned X land with market value KRW 120,000,000 and on Y land owned by the real guarantor C with market value KRW 80,000,000 in order to secure B’s debt of KRW 100,000,000 to A. D acquired a second mortgage right on X land with secured claim KRW 10,000,000, and E acquired a second mortgage right on Y land with secured claim KRW 40,000,000. Which of the following correctly combines the true statements (○) and the false statements (×) concerning this matter? Do not consider interest, delay damages, or execution costs, each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the precedents ㄱ. If X land is first sold by auction and A receives the full distribution from the sale proceeds KRW 100,000,000, then when Y land is sold by auction, D can receive KRW 10,000,000 from the sale proceeds of Y land KRW 80,000,000 ㄴ. If Y land is first sold by auction and the entire sale proceeds KRW 80,000,000 are distributed to A, then B may assert against E by setting off the matured loan claim of KRW 50,000,000 that B holds against C against the reimbursement claim that C acquired against B ㄷ. If B sells X land to F and completes the registration of transfer of ownership, and thereafter B’s general creditor A claim amount KRW 100,000,000 has the above sale contract rescinded as a fraudulent act and must provide value compensation, then if there is no change in the market values of X land and Y land, the scope of value compensation is KRW 20,000,000

label: B
question: Which of the following statements regarding the legal relationship between A, who operates an inn, and B, the inn’s 투숙객, are correct? If there is a dispute, follow the 판례. ㄱ. The 숙박계약 concluded between A and B constitutes a type of 임대차계약 for temporary use of a 객실. ㄴ. In order for an 임치관계 to be established between A and B, there must be an express or implied 합의 between them that A will assume a 채무 to keep the 목적물 within his 지배영역. ㄷ. Even if A has not taken the item in 임치 from B, A is liable to 배상 손해 when an item carried into the 시설 is lost or damaged due to A’s own 과실 or that of his 사용인. ㄹ. If A controls entry to the inn’s 부설주차장 or, without confirming the fact of 주차, merely provides a 주차의 장소, then even if B parked the vehicle in the parking lot and entrusted the vehicle’s 보관 by leaving the vehicle key at the inn, an 임치의 합의 between A and B cannot be 인정된다. ㅁ. If B dies due to a 화재 at the inn, C, B’s 배우자, may claim from A 위자료 for his or her own 정신적 고통 on the ground of A’s 채무불이행 under the 숙박계약 with B.
A: ㄱ, ㅁ
B: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ
C: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ
D: ㄷ, ㄹ, ㅁ
E: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ

label: C
question: Company A는 B company와 호텔에 관한 영업을 양도하는 contract를 체결하였다. Although B 회사 did not assume A 회사의 채무, it neither registered that it was not liable for A 회사의 채무 nor notified A 회사의 creditors to that effect. After the business transfer, B 회사 carried on the same hotel business while continuing to use unchanged the business establishment name “△△제주” that A 회사 had used. Which statement concerning this is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.)
A: If a business is 포괄적으로 transferred, then, unless otherwise stipulated, the employment relationship between A회사 and its employees is also 원칙적으로 comprehensively succeeded to by B회사 as a general rule.
B: Even when the designation 계속해서 used by Company B is not the trade name itself but an 옥호 or business sign, Company B shall, unless 특별한 사정 exists, bear the debt by analogical application of Commercial Act Article 42(상호를 속용한 양수인의 책임) paragraph 1.
C: Company B’s 변제책임 with respect to 제3자의 채권 arising from Company A’s 영업 is extinguished when 2 years have elapsed after the 영업양도.
D: Notwithstanding the business transfer, with respect to A회사 채권자 who know that there was no 채무인수, B회사의 책임 does not arise, and B bears the 주장·증명책임 as to the fact that the creditor acted in 악의.
E: If Company A’s creditor, around the time of the business transfer, did not know that there was no 채무인수, then, unless special circumstances exist, Company B’s 변제책임 arises under 상법 제42조 제1항, and even if the creditor later comes to know that there was no 채무인수, the already-arisen 변제책임 of Company B is not 소멸하는 것은 아니다.

label: C
question: Which of the following explanations concerning 가등기담보 is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.)
A: Under the Act on Security by Provisional Registration, etc. (hereinafter referred to as the “Provisional Registration Security Act”), where an order to commence compulsory auction has been issued with respect to real property for which a security provisional registration has been completed, if the application for auction was made before payment of the liquidation amount (or, where there is no liquidation amount, before the liquidation period has elapsed), the holder of the security provisional registration may not demand the principal registration pursuant to that provisional registration.
B: Where, in violation of the 청산절차 under the Provisional Registration Security Act, a principal registration based on a 담보가등기 has been made, if, in the 경매절차 conducted with respect to the 담보목적 부동산, the purchaser acquired 소유권 by buying the real property without knowing that the 본등기 was 무효, the 채무자 may no longer pay the entire amount of the 피담보채무액 to the 채권자 and request cancellation of that 본등기.
C: Where a 가등기 has been made to secure both an obligation to repay borrowed money arising from a 금전소비대차 contract and an obligation arising from another cause, and the latter obligation has been extinguished by 변제 or another cause so that only the obligation to repay borrowed money arising from the 금전소비대차 remains, the 가등기담보법 does not apply to that 가등기담보.
D: Where a principal registration completed without going through the 청산절차 under the Provisional Registration Security Act is void, if the debtor has concluded a lease contract with the creditor concerning the real property subject to security and has paid rent to the creditor, such rent shall, unless 특별한 사정 exist, be deemed to have been appropriated to the satisfaction of the 피담보채무.
E: In the private execution of a security right by provisional registration, 담보권실행 in a way that lets the creditor receive the principal registration and the delivery of the secured property before payment of the 청산금, or in a way that does not recognize the 청산기간 or the relationship of 동시이행, is not permitted under the 가등기담보법.

label: B
question: B established a 근저당권 with a 채권최고액 of KRW 100,000,000 on X land owned by debtor B, in order to secure a debt arising from continuing goods transactions with A. B's friend C also established a 근저당권 with a 채권최고액 of KRW 100,000,000 on Y building owned by C to secure B's above debt. Thereafter, with respect to X land, D acquired a second-ranking 저당권 with a 피담보채권 of KRW 80,000,000. After the goods transaction ended due to B's default, Y building was first 경매 upon A's application, and at that time A's 물품대금채권 was KRW 110,000,000 principal KRW 100,000,000 and 지연손해금 KRW 10,000,000 and the 매각대금 of KRW 80,000,000 was distributed in full to A applied to 지연손해금 KRW 10,000,000 and principal KRW 70,000,000. Thereafter, X land was 경매 upon A's application, and at that time A's 채권 was KRW 35,000,000 principal KRW 30,000,000 and 지연손해금 KRW 5,000,000 and the 매각대금 was KRW 75,000,000. Which of the following statements concerning this are all correct? 집행비용은 고려하지 않음 각 지문은 독립적이며 다툼이 있는 경우 판례에 의함 ㄱ. If the 근저당권 on X land and Y building constitutes a 공동근저당권, A may receive a 배당 of KRW 20,000,000 from the 경매대금 of X land. ㄴ. If the 근저당권 on X land and Y building is a 근저당권 that 누적적으로 secures the 피담보채권, A may receive a 배당 of KRW 35,000,000 from the 경매대금 of X land. ㄷ. If the 근저당권 on X land and Y building is a 근저당권 that 누적적으로 secures the 피담보채권, D may receive a 배당 of KRW 40,000,000 from the 경매대금 of X land.
A: ㄴ
B: ㄱ, ㄴ
C: ㄱ, ㄷ
D: ㄴ, ㄷ
E: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ

label: A
question: Which of the following statements concerning a possessory lien are correct? If there is a dispute, follow the precedents. ㄱ. The 불가분성 of a possessory lien, under which the lienholder may exercise the right over the entire 유치물 until payment of the entire 채권 is received, also applies even where the subject matter is divisible or consists of several 물건. ㄴ. Where a lienholder who acquired a 유치권 over several 필지 of land with one 채권 as the 피담보채권 violates the duty of a 선량한 관리자의 주의 with respect to some of those parcels, the 유치권 소멸청구 may, absent special circumstances, be made only with respect to the parcel on which the violation occurred. ㄷ. Where a person whose 점유 of a thing has been 침탈당한 exercises the right to claim 손해배상 arising from the extinguishment of the 유치권, which is the 본권, that person must exercise it within 1 year from the day the 점유 was 침탈당한 날. ㄹ. In auction proceedings for real property owned by a debtor over which a 근저당권 has been created, if no 유치권 was asserted, and the real property was sold and title was transferred to the 매수인, thereby extinguishing the 근저당권, and thereafter there is a person who claims that he or she had a 유치권 even before the 압류, the creditor, as the 근저당권자, has a 법률상 이익 in seeking confirmation of the nonexistence of the 유치권. ㅁ. Where there is a 특약 excluding a 유치권, no 유치권 arises even if all other 법정요건 are satisfied; however, a person who purchased the 유치물 in the 경매절차 is not a party to the above agreement and therefore cannot assert the effect of the above agreement.
A: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ
B: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㅁ
C: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅁ
D: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ
E: ㄷ, ㄹ, ㅁ

label: B
question: A entered into an insurance contract with Insurance Company A, using his father 乙 as the insured and 乙’s death as the insured event. Which of the following statements are correct? [‘written form’ includes the electronic documents prescribed in Commercial Act Article 731(1) (보험계약 on the life of another), and if there is a dispute, follow the precedents] ㄱ. The Commercial Act rule that, in an insurance contract with another person’s death as the insured event, that person’s written consent must be obtained at the time the contract is concluded is a 강행규정. ㄴ. 乙’s consent must be given individually in writing with respect to the insurance contract, and comprehensive, implied, or presumed consent alone is insufficient. ㄷ. The time by which 乙 must express consent in writing is by the time the insurance contract is concluded. ㄹ. A, who concluded an insurance contract with 乙’s death as the insured event without 乙’s written consent and then claims invalidity on his own, is, absent special circumstances, exercising rights in violation of the principle of 신의성실 or 금반언의 원칙. ㅁ. If 乙’s written consent is absent, the insurance contract is void, but if 乙 ratifies it, the insurance contract may become valid.
A: ㄱ, ㄷ
B: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ
C: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ
D: ㄷ, ㄹ, ㅁ
E: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ, ㅁ

label: D
question: A entered into a fire insurance contract with A보험회사, naming B as the insured, with respect to the bakery owned by his father B, without B의 위임. Although a fire had previously occurred at the bakery, at the time of the insurance contract A entered in the 청약서의 질문표, regarding whether a fire had occurred, “No fire has occurred,” and A보험회사 was not negligent in believing this. Among the following explanations, which is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.)
A: At the time of concluding the 화재보험계약, A must 고지하여야 한다 to A Insurance Company that he had not been 위임을 받지 아니하였음 by B.
B: Whether a fire had occurred at the bakery is presumed to be an important 사실 subject to the 고지의무.
C: Even if it is not a question item stated in the application form, it is not necessarily excluded from the scope of the 고지의무.
D: Even if a fire occurs at the bakery after the fire insurance contract is concluded, A Insurance Company may terminate the fire insurance contract on the ground of 甲's 고지의무 위반 only where there is a causal relationship between 甲's breach of the duty of disclosure and the fire.
E: If 甲, by intent or gross negligence, stated that there had been no 화재 발생, A회사는 may terminate the contract only within 1 month from the day it learned of that fact and within 3 years from the day the 화재보험계약 was concluded.

label: A
question: A, B, and C were directors of 비상장주식회사 Company A, and D was its 감사. A had acquired shares representing 60% of the total issued shares of Company A and completed 명의개서, and was a major shareholder, while B was the 대표이사 of Company A. The articles of incorporation of Company A provide that the 보수 of directors and auditors shall be determined by resolution of the 주주총회, but B, without a resolution of the 주주총회, paid a special 성과급 to C in accordance with A's instructions. Which of the following statements concerning this matter are correct? If there is a dispute, follow the 판례. ㄱ. The special 성과급 paid to C is included in a director's 보수 as consideration paid for the performance of a director's duties. ㄴ. Even if the special 성과급 paid to C was paid pursuant to A's instructions, unless there are special circumstances, it cannot be regarded as the equivalent of a resolution of the 주주총회 regarding the payment of the special 성과급. ㄷ. Even if B, who was facing retirement due to loss of 경영권, etc., established a 퇴직금 payment provision that was excessively excessive and markedly departed from a reasonable level in order to receive as much 퇴직금 as possible and caused a resolution of the 주주총회 to be adopted despite the opposition of minority shareholders through the exercise of influence by using his position, the resolution is valid, and B may exercise a claim for payment of 퇴직금 on the basis of that 퇴직금 payment provision. ㄹ. If A, after acquiring all of the total issued shares of Company A and completing the 명의개서, prepared the minutes of the 주주총회 as if there had been a resolution of the 주주총회 concerning the special 성과급 provision, then even if no actual 주주총회 was held, unless there are special circumstances, it may be regarded as having had a resolution of the 주주총회 concerning that provision. ㅁ. The 보수 of an 감사 may be determined only by a provision of the articles of incorporation and cannot be determined by resolution of the 주주총회, so Company A cannot pay 보수 to D by resolution of the 주주총회 notwithstanding the provision of the articles of incorporation.
A: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ
B: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㄹ
C: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅁ
D: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㅁ
E: ㄴ, ㄹ, ㅁ

label: A
question: Which of the following statements concerning 상법상 companies is not correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.)
A: Even in a limited company, if the members’ meeting resolves to 구체적으로 specify the remuneration amount of a particular director, and if the members’ meeting thereafter resolves to 감액 that remuneration amount, the relevant director’s remuneration shall, unless there are 특별한 사정, be reduced in accordance with that resolution.
B: When a person intends to establish a 유한책임회사, a 주식회사, or a 유한회사, an application may be made for provisional registration of the 상호 at the registry office having jurisdiction over the location of the 본점.
C: In a limited partnership, a general partner who has been adjudged to have lost the authority to execute business must, in order to regain the authority to execute business or the authority to represent the partnership, be newly granted such authority under the articles of incorporation or with the consent of all partners, as provided in 합자회사에서 업무집행권한의 상실을 선고받은 무한책임사원이 다시 업무집행권이나 대표권을 갖기 위해서는 정관이나 총사원의 동의로 새로 그러한 권한을 부여받아야 한다.
D: In a general partnership, whether there was 고의·과실 in respect of an improper registration shall be determined on the basis of the 대표사원.
E: A limited liability company는 its equity interests의 전부 또는 일부를 acquire할 수 없고, and where it acquires such equity interests, 그 지분은 the time of acquisition에 extinguished된다.

label: D
question: A는 B의 자금 융통을 위하여 promissory note를 B에게 issued하였고, B는 C에 대한 price debt의 변제를 위하여 위 note를 C에게 endorsed and transferred하였다. 이에 관한 설명 중 which is not correct? (If there is a dispute, 판례에 의함)
A: If B, having satisfied the 요건 under the Bills of Exchange and Promissory Notes Act, claims payment of the 어음금 from A, A may raise the 융통어음 defense and oppose it.
B: If C, having satisfied the requirements under the 어음법, claims payment of the note amount from A, A may not raise the 융통어음 defense, even if C knew that it was a 융통어음.
C: Even if 丙 acquired the note by an endorsement after maturity, 甲 may not raise the 융통어음 defense
D: If 乙, after achieving the purpose of 자금 융통, recovered the note from 丙 but did not return the note to 甲, cancelled his own endorsement, and then used it again with 丁, a third party, 甲 may assert against 丁 the defense of 재사용 of the 융통어음, even if 丁 did not know without 과실 that the note was an 융통어음 and that it was being used again after having already been used and having fulfilled its purpose.
E: If the maturity date of the note that B delivered to C is later than the due date for payment of the price debt, then, absent 특별한 사정, C should be deemed to have intended to defer payment of the antecedent debt to B.

label: E
question: A is a non-listed stock company. Its directors are 甲, 乙, and 丙, and among them 甲 is the representative director, while 乙 and 丙 are outside directors. On the shareholder register, out of A company’s total issued shares, 丁 holds 0.8% of the shares and 戊 holds 3% of the shares. 甲 violated 법령 in the course of share cancellation for a reduction of stated capital, and as a result A company suffered 손해. Thereafter, A company’s board of directors prepared a 합병계약서 in order to merge with B company and convened a 주주총회 for approval of the agreement. In response, shareholder 戊 opposes the merger and seeks to exercise the 주식매수청구권. Which of the following statements is not correct? (Do not consider 간이합병 or 소규모합병; if there is a dispute, follow 판례.)
A: Company A may 청구 for compensation for the damage against A even before a judgment that invalidates the reduction of stated capital becomes final and binding, and A is liable for 지체책임 from the time the claim is received.
B: If Company A does not 추궁하지 않는 the liability of 甲, D may, together with 戊, request A회사 to file an action to pursue 甲’s 책임.
C: If 乙 and 丙, despite there being grounds to suspect that 甲’s 주식소각 act was unlawful, negligently breached their 감시의무 and thereby left it unattended, they are liable to 배상 for the damage suffered by A회사 as a result.
D: In order for E to demand the purchase of shares, E must notify Company A in writing of an intention to oppose the resolution approving the merger agreement before the general meeting of shareholders for approval of the merger agreement.
E: Even if E exercises the 주식매수청구권 and receives the 주식매수대금 from Company A, E may still exercise the 회계장부열람권 against Company A within 2 months from the expiration of the 매수청구기간.

label: C
question: A Company, a 비상장주식회사, has a quorum provision in its articles of incorporation stating that “the election of directors shall be by the attendance of shareholders holding shares representing a majority of the total issued shares and by the affirmative vote of a majority of the voting rights of the shareholders present.” However, there is no separate provision on 집중투표. Shareholder 甲, who holds shares equal to 5% of the total issued shares excluding non-voting shares as recorded in A Company’s shareholder register, seeks to elect 丁 as a director when the terms of directors 乙 and 丙 expire. Which of the following statements is incorrect? If there is a dispute, the precedents shall govern.
A: A may make a shareholder proposal to a director, in writing or by electronic document, 6 weeks before the date of the shareholders’ meeting in order to propose ‘이사 선임안’ as an agenda item of the shareholders’ meeting and ‘丁을 이사로 선임하는 안’ as a resolution item of the shareholders’ meeting.
B: If A Company makes the proposed 의안 submitted by 甲 into an 의안 of the 주주총회, when 甲 makes a 청구, A Company must give 甲 an opportunity to 설명 that 의안 at the 주주총회
C: Since the director who received A’s proposal must make it an item to be considered at the shareholders’ meeting unless the proposal violates 법령, it must be made an item to be considered at the shareholders’ meeting even if the proposal violates 정관.
D: If A회사가 convenes a shareholders’ meeting to elect 2 persons among 乙, 丙, and 丁 as directors, 甲 may demand of A회사, by written document or electronic document, up to 7 days before the date of the shareholders’ meeting, that the directors be elected by the method of 집중투표.
E: Even when 2 directors are elected by the method of 집중투표 at A Company’s 주주총회, the 의사정족수 prescribed in the 정관 must still be 충족되어야 한다.

label: C
question: Which of the following correctly combines the statements that are true (○) and false (×) concerning the acquisition of minority shares by a controlling shareholder under 상법 제360조의24(지배주주의 매도청구권)? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.) ㄱ. A controlling shareholder may, where necessary to achieve the company’s 경영상 목적, obtain prior approval of the general meeting of shareholders and demand that the minority shareholder sell the shares it holds. ㄴ. The minority shareholder’s shares are deemed to have been transferred to the controlling shareholder when the controlling shareholder’s 매도청구 is approved at the general meeting of shareholders. ㄷ. When exercising the 매도청구권, the controlling shareholder may exercise that right with respect to only part of the shares held by the minority shareholder. ㄹ. A minority shareholder who has received a 매도청구 from the controlling shareholder shall sell the shares to the controlling shareholder within 2 months from the date of receipt of the demand. ㅁ. In determining whether a parent company falls under the controlling shareholder of a subsidiary, the subsidiary’s 자기주식 are included in the total number of issued shares and are added to the shares of the subsidiary held by the parent company.

label: C
question: An unlisted stock company, A Company, has in its articles of incorporation a provision that “10억 원 이상의 보증채무를 부담하는 계약은 이사회 결의를 거쳐야 한다.” A was elected as a director at A Company’s 주주총회, and thereafter was selected as 대표이사 by the 이사회 and completed registration. Representative director A concluded two surety contracts with D Company in the name of A Company, without a board resolution, with respect to B Company’s debt to D Company of 1억 원 and C Company’s debt to D Company of 20억 원. Thereafter, a shareholder of A Company filed a lawsuit seeking the 취소 of the shareholders’ resolution appointing A as director, prevailed, and the judgment became final and conclusive. Among the following explanations, which is incorrect? If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.
A: Acts performed by 甲 as representative director before the judgment cancelling the shareholders’ resolution appointing 甲 as 이사 became final and conclusive are acts performed by a person without 대표권.
B: If D Company knew at the time of concluding the surety contract, or was grossly negligent in not knowing, that 甲 had no representative authority, then under Article 395 of the Commercial Act (표현대표이사의 행위와 회사의 책임), A Company cannot be held liable under the surety contract for B Company’s debt.
C: If D Company, without negligence, believed that 甲 had authority to represent A Company, then even if D Company knew at the time of concluding the surety contract that 甲 was entering into the surety contract for the purpose of promoting B Company’s interests, regardless of A Company’s 영리 목적, if the conclusion of the surety contract is an act within the scope of 대표권, A Company bears a 보증채무 of 100 million won.
D: If A회사가 concluded the surety contract with D회사 for C회사’s debt, and D회사가, through 중대한 과실, did not know that there had been no 이사회 결의 of A회사, then A회사는 does not bear a 보증채무 of 2 billion won.
E: The registration of director A’s appointment as director, completed by Representative Director A, who was appointed as a director pursuant to the shareholders’ resolution to be annulled, constitutes a 부실등기 under Article 39 of the Commercial Act.

label: D
question: Which of the following statements regarding 비상장주식회사의 이익배당 is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.)
A: Dividend distribution is determined by 주주총회 결의, however, where, pursuant to 상법 제449조의2(재무제표 등의 승인에 대한 특칙) 제1항, the financial statements are approved by the 이사회, it is determined by 이사회 결의.
B: If the articles of incorporation impose on the company a duty to pay dividends and specifically set the payment conditions or the method for calculating the dividend amount, so that the amount to be distributed to each individual shareholder is uniquely determined, and there is no provision allowing the representative director or the board of directors to decide differently, according to business judgment, whether dividends are paid, when they are paid, or how much is paid, then, exceptionally, when the payment conditions prescribed in the articles are satisfied, a shareholder may be recognized as having a specific and definite dividend payment claim right
C: The company may distribute profits by newly issued shares pursuant to a resolution of the shareholders’ meeting; however, a share dividend may not exceed an amount equivalent to one-half of the total amount of profit dividends, 즉 주주총회 결의에 의하여 이익의 배당을 새로이 발행하는 주식으로써 할 수 있으나, 주식에 의한 배당은 이익배당총액의 2분의 1에 상당하는 금액을 초과하지 못한다.
D: Where a company, within the limit of 배당가능 이익, distributes profits in violation of the 주주평등의 원칙, the company채권자 may demand that the distributed 이익 be returned to the company
E: A company that has established one closing period per year may provide in its articles of incorporation that, only once during the business year, by resolution of the board of directors, 일정한 날을 지정하고 그날의 주주에게 이익을 배당할 수 있다.

label: D
question: A listed stock company, A회사, entered into a joint and several suretyship agreement with 乙 for a debt that director 甲 borrowed in his personal capacity from 乙. If that joint and several suretyship agreement constitutes 금지된 신용공여 under Commercial Act Article 542-9(주요주주 등 이해관계자와의 거래) paragraph (1), which statement below is correct? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례)
A: The relevant 연대보증계약 is effective if, in advance, the board of directors discloses the 중요 사실 concerning the transaction and approves it.
B: The Commercial Act does not provide a 형사처벌 provision concerning the person who entered into the relevant joint and several suretyship agreement.
C: If, instead of director A, A Company had entered into a joint and several suretyship agreement with 乙, with prior approval of the board of directors, in respect of the debt of A Company’s auditor 甲, A Company cannot assert the invalidity of the joint and several suretyship agreement against 乙.
D: If 乙 did not know that the relevant 연대보증계약 was a prohibited 신용공여 under the 상법, and there was no 중과실 in 乙's failure to know it, A Company cannot assert the 무효 of the relevant 연대보증계약 against 乙.
E: Even if 乙 was grossly negligent in failing to know that the relevant 연대보증계약 was a prohibited 신용공여 under the 상법, if the board of directors of A Company 추인 this transaction, A Company cannot assert the 무효 of the relevant 연대보증계약 against 乙.

label: E
question: In unlisted company A, 甲 was the Representative Director, and 乙 and 丙 were shareholders. On 2021. 5. 1., Company A issued only to 丙, who was personally acquainted with 甲, a detachable bond with stock acquisition rights, in which only the stock acquisition rights were transferable, regardless of whether Company A’s 경영 목적 was achieved. On 2023. 6. 1., 甲, in order to increase his influence over his own company, acquired from 丙 all of the stock acquisition rights attached to the bond with stock acquisition rights, and by that date no action for invalidation of the issuance of the bond with stock acquisition rights had been filed. Thereafter, 甲 exercised all of the stock acquisition rights at one time, and new shares were issued on 2023. 8. 1. Which of the following statements regarding this is correct? If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.
A: The aggregate issue price of the shares to be issued by the exercise of the stock acquisition rights attached to each 신주인수권부사채 may exceed the amount of each 신주인수권부사채.
B: Before 2023. 8. 1., when new shares were issued as a result of the exercise of the stock acquisition rights, B may at any time 주장 the invalidity of the issuance of the bond with stock acquisition rights.
C: B may, fearing the disadvantage arising from the issuance of the bond with stock acquisition rights carried out under A’s initiative, file on 2023. 9. 1. an action for 유지 of the issuance of new shares
D: B may file on 2023. 10. 1. an action for 신주발행무효 by asserting that the 발행 of the bond with stock acquisition rights is 무효 or by making arguments premised thereon.
E: B may file on 2023. 12. 1. an action for invalidation of new share issuance by analogy to the inherent 무효 사유 in the exercise of the stock acquisition rights or the issuance of new shares thereunder.

label: C
question: Which of the following statements concerning the court of jurisdiction for a suit brought against 乙 under the following agreement is not correct? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.) <약정서> 채권자: 甲 (750101-1234567) Seoul, Seocho-gu, Seocho-ro 125, 305-dong 1301-ho (서초동, OO아파트), 채무자: 乙 (850201-2345678) Seoul, Songpa-gu, Baekjegobun-ro 211, 203-dong 901-ho (삼전동, XX아파트), 甲 and 乙 agree as follows. Terms of the agreement: 1. 乙 shall pay 100,000,000 won to 甲 by 2023. 10. 30. 2. 乙 shall perform the ownership transfer registration procedure, on the ground of donation as of 2023. 10. 1., with respect to 300㎡ of land at 145 Ohyeon-ro, Gangbuk-gu, Seoul, to 甲 by 2023. 10. 30. 2023. 10. 1. 甲 ㊞ 乙 ㊞
A: A may file a 소 seeking performance of both Item 1 and Item 2 of the agreement in the court having jurisdiction over 乙의 주소지
B: A may file a 소 seeking performance of Item 1 only of the agreement in the court having jurisdiction over A's 주소지.
C: A may file a 소 seeking 이행 of Item 2 only of the 약정 in the court having jurisdiction over A's 주소지.
D: If A and B lawfully enter into a 관할합의, and A lawfully assigns to C the 위 1억 원 채권 that A has against B under Item 1 above, then if C files an action seeking payment of the 양수금, C is bound by the 관할합의 between A and B.
E: Even if 甲 files an action seeking performance of 약정 사항 제1항 in a court lacking 관할권, jurisdiction will arise in that court if 乙 does not assert lack of 관할권 and argues on the 본안.

label: C
question: Which of the following combinations correctly matches the statements concerning the effect of interruption of the statute of limitations by a lawsuit filing, with the true statements marked (○) and the false statements marked (×)? If there is a dispute, follow the precedents ㄱ. After 甲 assigned to 丙 a claim for the price of goods of KRW 50,000,000 against 乙, if 甲’s claim was dismissed in a lawsuit for payment of the goods price filed against 乙 before the opposability requirements were satisfied, on the ground, among other things, that 乙 acknowledged the effect of the assignment, then if the assignee 丙 filed an action for payment of the assigned amount against 乙 within 6 months thereafter, the statute of limitations was interrupted at the time 甲 filed the action ㄴ. Even if, in an action for a loan claim filed by plaintiff 甲 against defendant 乙, 甲, not knowing that 乙 had died, designated 乙 as the defendant, and a judgment in favor of the claim that overlooked 乙’s death became final, if plaintiff 甲 thereafter filed again an action for payment of the loan against 乙’s heir 丙 within 6 months, the statute of limitations of the above loan claim was interrupted at the time plaintiff 甲 filed the action against defendant 乙 ㄷ. Where a plaintiff who transferred the right that was the subject matter of the action withdrew from the litigation with the defendant’s consent pursuant to the court’s decision on succession to the litigation, and thereafter the effect of the transfer of the right that was the subject matter of the action by the assuming intervenor was denied and a judgment dismissing the claim or dismissing the action against the assuming intervenor became final, if the withdrawn plaintiff again made the same judicial claim as before withdrawal within 6 months from the date of finality of the above judgment, the effect of interruption of the statute of limitations caused by the judicial claim filed by the plaintiff before withdrawal remains intact ㄹ.
