Where, in the complaint, only part of the claim that was made the subject of the action was claimed and an intention to expand the amount claimed later depending on the progress of the litigation was indicated, but the amount claimed was not actually expanded until the conclusion of the relevant litigation, the effect of interruption of the statute of limitations due to the judicial claim does not arise with respect to the remaining portion not claimed however, unless there are special circumstances, the creditor may interrupt the statute of limitations for that remaining portion by making a judicial claim within 6 months from the time the relevant litigation ended

label: A
question: Which of the following statements concerning 민사소송상 신의칙 is not correct? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.)
A: Whether the court will issue a 화해권고결정 is an act to be taken ex officio by considering the parties’ interests and all other circumstances, but even though the very existence of the 청구권 is clear, if the court renders a judgment dismissing the plaintiff’s claim on the ground of a 신의칙 violation, it is unlawful if an amicable resolution was not attempted before that judgment.
B: During the pendency of a 의료과오소송, an act by the physician side of 진료기록을 변조하는 행위 constitutes a 증명방해행위 contrary to the principle of 당사자 간 공평 or 신의칙, unless a 상당하고도 합리적인 reason for the alteration is presented.
C: Where the court of first instance at the first 변론준비기일 accepted an improper 당사자표시정정신청 and the defendant expressly consented thereto, and a 본안판결 was rendered in both the first instance and the appellate instance, the defendant’s later assertion that the above 표시정정신청 was 부적법하다고 주장하는 것은 인정되지 아니한다.
D: Since what is contrary to the principle of 신의칙 in civil procedure violates mandatory provisions, the court may 직권으로 determine it even if there is no party’s 주장.
E: Where the court, with respect to the plaintiff’s abuse of the right of action 소권 (including the right of appeal 항소권), by repeatedly filing an action in which it is manifest that the claim is without merit 이유 없음이 명백한, dismisses the action 소를 각하 by judgment 판결 without oral argument 변론 없이, the presiding judge 재판장은 may, ex officio 직권으로, order service by publication 공시송달 on the defendant 피고에 대하여.

label: B
question: Which of the following statements concerning 소송요건 is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.)
A: During an action seeking performance of the procedure for cancellation registration of a mortgage creation registration, if the mortgage creation registration is cancelled on the ground of sale in an auction procedure, there is no longer a legal interest in seeking the cancellation of the mortgage creation registration.
B: Where the expiration of the statute of limitations 기간 for a claim by a final and conclusive judgment is imminent, a 재소 for the interruption of prescription has the benefit of suit, and in such case the 후소 court must again 심리 whether all 요건 for asserting the 확정된 right are satisfied.
C: If the Plaintiff had an interest in seeking a declaration of the Defendant’s 손해배상채무 부존재확인 and sought that declaration in the 본소, even if the Defendant later filed a 반소 seeking 이행 of that 손해배상채무, that circumstance alone does not mean the 확인의 이익 for the principal claim has 소멸 and that the 본소 has become 부적법하다.
D: Even if there is a dispute over a specific right or legal relation, if the parties agreed not to institute an action, a suit brought in violation thereof lacks the interest in judicial protection, 즉 권리보호의 이익이 없다.
E: The res judicata effect of a 소각하 judgment extends to the defect in the 소송요건 determined in that judgment.

label: A
question: Which of the following statements regarding 송달 is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.)
A: If a party was in custody during the pendency of the litigation, and the court served a copy of the judgment by 공시송달 pursuant to the presiding judge’s order at the party’s address, etc., without serving the copy of the judgment on the prison warden, then this has a defect in that it fails to satisfy the requirements for 공시송달, and it is 무효.
B: Where a party who received a 기일통지서 by 공시송달 did not submit an answer or preparatory brief, etc., and did not appear at the relevant 변론기일, that party is not deemed to have 자백한 the 상대방의 주장사실.
C: Where multiple litigation representatives conduct 소송 for the same party, the court must serve a copy of the judgment on each of the multiple 소송대리인; however, in this case, the effect of service of a copy of the judgment on the party arises when it is first served on one of the litigation representatives, and the appeal period is also calculated from the time the copy of the judgment is first served on one of the 소송대리인.
D: Service by mail is permitted where personal delivery on the addressee is impossible, as is 보충송달 or 유치송달, or where the party, etc. has not fulfilled the duty to report a change of 송달장소 and the place of service cannot otherwise be ascertained from the materials appearing in the record alone.
E: Where there is a conflict of interest or opposing interests between the principal and the person who receives service on the principal’s behalf, that is, the principal’s office worker, employee, or cohabitant who has the intelligence to distinguish right from wrong, if there is such 이해의 대립 or 상반된 이해관계 with respect to the litigation in question, the recipient agent’s receiving service of litigation documents on behalf of the principal is contrary to the principle of 쌍방대리금지, and therefore substitute service cannot be effected on that 수령대행인.

label: E
question: Which of the following statements regarding 중복된 소제기의 금지 is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.)
A: Of the two victims of the same traffic accident, 甲, during the pendency of an action for payment of insurance proceeds concerning 甲’s own damages, filed against insurer A company by subrogating the insured 丙, who was the tortfeasor, 乙 separately files against the same A company an action for payment of insurance proceeds concerning 乙’s own damages by subrogating the same 丙; such action does not constitute 중복된 소제기.
B: Even when a 채권자대위소송(전소) is 계속 중 before the court, if another creditor of the same 채무자 brings a later 소(후소) based on the creditor's 대위권 with respect to the same 소송물, if the prior action is 취하되거나 각하되면 by the conclusion of oral argument in the later action, the later action does not constitute 중복된 소제기.
C: If, during the pendency of an action to set aside a fraudulent act brought by creditor 甲, another creditor 乙 brings an action to set aside the same 사해행위, it does not constitute a 중복된 소제기.
D: An action for performance of a debt brought by a creditor against a debt assumer (전소) and an action for declaratory judgment of nonexistence of the original debtor’s debt against the creditor brought by the debt assumer (후소) are 서로 different in their relief sought and cause of action, so even if the 후소 is brought during the pendency of the 전소, it does not constitute a duplicate filing.
E: A settlement concluded in litigation proceedings that were continued despite being a duplicate filing and were overlooked as such is 당연무효 ab initio.

label: B
question: Which of the following statements concerning 종중 and other associations without legal personality is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.)
A: A clan association is a naturally arising group of descendants, and for its formation it is not necessary that it use a specific name and have written clan association rules, or that it have an organizational structure such as a continuously appointed representative.
B: An individual who is both a member and a representative of an association without legal personality may, upon a 사원총회의 결의, become a party in his or her own name in a lawsuit concerning 총유재산의 보존행위.
C: In a case where a clan association is a party, whether the clan association’s representative has lawful 대표권 is a matter concerning litigation requirements and thus is subject to the court’s 직권조사사항, so if the submitted materials already show circumstances that may cast doubt on the lawfulness of that authority, the court has a duty to investigate it even if the opposing party does not specifically point it out and dispute it.
D: Even where there is no provision in the articles of incorporation or bylaws of a 법인 아닌 사단 regarding the management and 처분 of 총유물, a disposition act of such property performed by its 대표자 without going through a resolution of the 사원 총회 is 무효이다.
E: A procedural act performed by a 종중 representative who lacks lawful representative status becomes effective retroactively from the time of the act if the representative who later lawfully acquires that status 그 소송행위를 추인하면, and such 추인 may also be made at the stage of 상고심.

label: E
question: Which of the following statements concerning 상계 and the setoff defense is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.)
A: Where the principal obligor has previously waived the defense against the claim for security provision to the entrusted surety, the entrusted surety may set off its debt to the principal obligor by using the prior reimbursement claim as the active claim.
B: Where the defendant가 setoff defense로 2개 이상의 counterclaims를 주장하였는데, the court recognized only one of those counterclaims and rejected the setoff defense as to the remainder on the ground that the remaining counterclaims did not exist, the scope of res judicata with respect to the determination that the counterclaims do not exist cannot exceed the balance of the passive claim after setoff has been completed.
C: In calculating the debtor’s 손해배상책임 arising from a tort or 채무불이행, where it is necessary to 제한 the debtor’s 책임 in order to achieve equitable allocation of 손해부담, if the debtor raises an 상계항변 with a 반대채권 held against the creditor, the setoff must be made against the 손해배상액 after the 책임제한.
D: A third-party debtor who has a 반대채권 that was eligible for 상계 against the debtor before service on the third-party debtor of an order of 채권압류 및 전부명령 may, after service of that order, assert 상계 against the 전부채권자.
E: In the court of first instance of the earlier-filed action, a defendant who submitted an 상계항변 and thereby received a determination on the merits by the first-instance judgment, but later withdrew the 상계항변 in the appellate court, is not permitted under the principle of 재소금지 to separately bring a suit based on a claim identical to that 자동채권. About 상계 and 상계항변, which statement is not correct (if there is a dispute, follow 판례)

label: D
question: Which of the following statements concerning the creditor’s revocation right and a lawsuit to revoke a fraudulent act are correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents) ㄱ. The requirement of 사해성 must be satisfied not only at the time of the disposition act but also at the close of oral argument in the first-instance trial of the fraudulent act revocation lawsuit. ㄴ. In exercising the creditor’s revocation right, the burden of proving the lapse of the 제척기간 rests with the opposing party in the fraudulent act revocation lawsuit. ㄷ. Where a creditor exercises by subrogation the debtor’s creditor’s revocation right, whether the 제소기간 has been observed shall be determined with reference to that creditor. ㄹ. Where one creditor has obtained a final and binding judgment in a claim for revocation of a fraudulent act and restoration to the original condition, and has completed the restoration of property or value based on that judgment, a claim for revocation of the fraudulent act and restoration to the original condition brought by another creditor concerning the same fraudulent act lacks an interest in legal protection to the extent it overlaps therewith.
A: ㄱ, ㄴ
B: ㄱ, ㄹ
C: ㄴ, ㄷ
D: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ
E: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㄹ

label: D
question: Which of the following statements concerning 판결의 편취 is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)
A: Where the plaintiff 허위로 기재한 the defendant’s address so that a copy of the complaint and the authenticated copy of the judgment in favor of the plaintiff are served by 공시송달, the defendant may obtain 구제 by filing an appeal with 추후보완 or an action for 재심 after the appeal period has elapsed.
B: Where the Plaintiff falsifies the Defendant’s address so that a copy of the complaint and an authenticated copy of a judgment in favor of the Plaintiff rendered without oral argument are sent to that address and received by a third party other than the Defendant, thereby being treated as 송달된 것으로 처리된 경우, the Defendant may obtain 구제받을 수 있다 by filing an appeal.
C: Compulsory execution based on a fraudulently procured final and conclusive judgment shall be deemed to constitute a tort only in cases where the judgment was rendered in a state in which the parties' fundamental procedural rights were fundamentally 침해되었거나 where grounds for retrial exist in the final and conclusive judgment 등, and where it is manifestly contrary to justice to respect the effect of the final and conclusive judgment, so that it cannot be 묵과할 수 없는 경우로 한정하여야 한다.
D: With respect to a creditor who, despite having received repayment of part of a loan, concealed that fact and filed a lawsuit for the entire amount of the loan, obtained a final and conclusive judgment in his favor, and then received the judgment amount through 강제집행, the debtor may seek 부당이득반환 on the ground that the amount corresponding to the partially repaid sum constitutes enrichment without 법률상 원인, without going through 재심절차, etc.
E: If compulsory execution based on a fraudulently procured final judgment constitutes 권리남용, the defendant in that judgment, namely the execution debtor, may seek 배제 of the execution by means of an action for 청구이의.

label: E
question: 13th Korean Bar Examination, Civil Law Multiple-Choice Question 63. Which of the following statements concerning 지명채권양도 are correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.) ㄱ. If notice of 채권양도 by an instrument bearing a 확정일자 and an order of 채권가압류 are simultaneously delivered to the 제3채무자, the third-party obligor may make a 변제공탁 on the ground that the creditor cannot be identified, by analogy to a case where the 송달의 선후 is unclear. ㄴ. If the assignee of the claim is the ‘양도되는 채권의 채무자,’ and after the 채권양도 an order of 가압류 sought by a creditor of the assignor with respect to the assigned claim is served on the assignee, who is the 제3채무자, the above 가압류결정 is valid if there was no notice of 채권양도 by an instrument bearing a 확정일자 or 승낙 concerning the above assignment. ㄷ. If the 채권양수인 files an application to intervene claiming to be a 승계인 during the pendency of the litigation, whether succession to the status of creditor occurred during the 소송계속 is determined based on the time when the 대항요건 for setting up the assignment of claim against third parties were satisfied. ㄹ. If the Plaintiff, while seeking a 금전지급청구 based on the 채권자대위권, changed the action into a 양수금청구 by subsequently acquiring by assignment the claim subject to subrogation itself, the effect of 시효중단 arising from the original creditor’s subrogation action does not cease.
A: ㄴ
B: ㄱ, ㄷ
C: ㄷ, ㄹ
D: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ
E: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㄹ

label: B
question: Which of the following are all cases falling under 고유필수적 공동소송? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.) ㄱ. An action brought against 甲, 乙, and 丙 seeking performance of the procedure for 소유권이전등기, on the ground of 명의신탁 해지, with respect to real property for which the registration of transfer of ownership has been made in the form of 합유 by 甲, 乙, and 丙 ㄴ. An action brought by 甲, 乙, and 丙, as 토지 공유자, against 丁, the owner of adjacent land, seeking 경계의 확정 ㄷ. Where 甲 and 乙, as 동업자, deposit money that each contributed separately for a specific purpose other than their partnership under 공동명의, and open the deposit under 공동명의 for the purpose of monitoring so that neither 甲 nor 乙 alone can withdraw it before achieving that purpose, an action by 甲 and 乙 against the bank seeking 예금반환청구 ㄹ. An action brought by 甲 and 乙, among the 공동상속인 甲, 乙, and 丙, as plaintiffs against 丙, seeking a declaration that certain property is 상속재산임 ㅁ. An action seeking 공유물의 철거, brought against 甲, 乙, and 丙, who are the 소유자 of the co-owned property
A: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ
B: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ
C: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅁ
D: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ
E: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ, ㅁ

label: E
question: A company’s shareholders A and B filed a lawsuit against Company A seeking a judgment confirming the nullity of the shareholders’ meeting resolution that elected director 丁 at Company A’s shareholders’ meeting. Among the following explanations, which are correct? If there is a dispute, follow the precedents. ㄱ. If a judgment confirming the nullity of a shareholders’ meeting resolution becomes final and binding, its effect also extends to third parties other than the parties, so third parties cannot contest it either, so as a rule Company A cannot admit the claim in the above lawsuit, but even if such a 청구인낙 is made, the effect of the 인낙조서 also extends to third parties because of 대세적 효력 and the demands of legal stability. ㄴ. If shareholder 丙 properly intervened as a 공동소송참가 during the pendency of the first instance litigation, the appeal period for the plaintiffs against the first instance judgment runs separately from the time a certified copy of the judgment is served on 甲, 乙, and 丙 respectively, but the judgment does not become final and binding until the appeal period expires as to all of 甲, 乙, and 丙. ㄷ. If only 甲 appeals from the first instance judgment in which the plaintiffs lost, the finality of the judgment is blocked with respect to both 甲 and 乙, the entire case is transferred to the appellate court, and it becomes the 심판범위 of the appellate trial. ㄹ. In the above lawsuit, the person authorized to represent Company A is the person currently registered as the 대표이사 and performing those duties, and the same applies even if that 대표이사 is a director appointed by the resolution that is the subject of the above nullity-confirmation claim.
A: ㄱ
B: ㄴ, ㄷ
C: ㄴ, ㄹ
D: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㄹ
E: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ

label: D
question: Which of the following explanations regarding judicial 화해 and mediation is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.)
A: Unless there are grounds in the 제소전 화해조서 equivalent to grounds for the 당연무효 of a final and conclusive judgment, even if its contents violate 강행법규, that 화해조서 cannot be deemed void.
B: Where the settlement record contains a lapse-of-effect clause stating, “This compromise in this case shall be void if the actual owner of the real property involved in this case raises an objection,” 그 조건이 성취되면 the effect of the compromise is extinguished.
C: A mediation clause to the effect that “the judgment subject to retrial and the first-instance judgment shall each be 취소된다” is inherently void, because the 조정조항 saying “재심대상판결 및 제1심 판결을 각 취소한다” is 당연무효이다.
D: In the mediation procedure for partition of co-owned property at the court before which the action is pending, if the co-owners reach an agreement on 현물분할 of the co-owned land and the agreed matters are entered in the 조서, the 공유관계 is extinguished immediately, and the effect arises that new 법률관계 are created for each co-owner in accordance with that agreement.
E: Where there has been a final and conclusive 화해권고결정, rendered in a prior action between the same parties, concerning the 존부 of the 법률관계 disputed in the litigation, a party's contrary 주장은 인정되지 아니한다.

label: A
question: Which of the following statements concerning ｢민사소송법｣상 보조참가 is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.)
A: Under the Civil Procedure Act, with respect to an application for 보조참가, the court seised of the case must decide whether to permit 참가 or not, regardless of whether any party has filed an 이의신청.
B: In an ordinary lawsuit, even if the party being supported withdraws the action without the quasi-joint intervenor’s consent, it is valid, but in a retrial action, even if the supported party withdraws the retrial action, it has no effect unless the quasi-joint intervenor consents.
C: In quasi-joint intervention, because among the procedural acts of the supported party in 공동소송적 보조참가 those that are unfavorable to the 보조참가인 are ineffective, if the intervenor files an 상소, the supported party cannot withdraw the appeal or waive the appeal.
D: If an intervenor who has not filed an appeal submits a written statement after the expiration of the time limit for the party being supported to file a statement of reasons for final appeal, and 주장 matters that were not asserted in the statement of reasons for final appeal lawfully submitted by the supported party, this cannot be regarded as an assertion of grounds for final appeal submitted within the lawful time limit.
E: If a third party has purchased land from the Defendant but has not yet completed registration, and the Plaintiff has placed a provisional attachment on real property under the Defendant’s name and then files a loan claim action against the Defendant, the third party, on the ground that the Plaintiff’s sued-upon claim is a fictitious claim and that the Defendant intends to let the Plaintiff prevail by admitting the asserted facts, cannot intervene as a 공동소송적 보조참가 on the Defendant’s side in that loan claim lawsuit.

label: B
question: Which of the following statements concerning the 선정당사자제도 is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.)
A: Unless there is an agreement limiting the effect to a certain instance at the time of the selection of the selected party, 선정당사자의 선정행위의 효력은 the litigation’s 종료에 이르기까지 계속된다.
B: Although a person who is in a relationship with a number of persons such that he or she could be a 공동소송인, but who does not share the principal 공격방어방법 and thus has no 공동의 이해관계, is selected as a 선정당사자, and the court overlooks the defect in such 선정당사자 자격 and a judgment against that person becomes final and conclusive, this constitutes a ground for 재심 under the ｢민사소송법｣.
C: A selected party, as a party who has received 포괄적인 수권 from the persons selecting him or her to conduct the litigation, may perform all 소송행위 for all of the persons selecting him or her unless otherwise agreed.
D: Where the common interest is extinguished because the suit as to the part concerning the 선정당사자 본인 is withdrawn or the 판결 becomes final and conclusive, the 선정당사자는 as a matter of course loses that 자격.
E: Under the Civil Procedure Act, among several parties who have been selected, if there is a person who has died or lost his or her qualification, the remaining selected party conducts litigation acts for all

label: D
question: Which of the following statements concerning a provisional disposition suspending the performance of duties of a director of a stock company and appointing an acting director are correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) ㄱ. Where there is a provisional disposition with a director of a stock company as the respondent, suspending that director’s 직무집행 and appointing an acting director, the provisional disposition order merely suspends the director’s performance of duties and does not deprive the director of 지위 or 자격. ㄴ. A provisional disposition suspending the performance of duties of a director of a stock company and appointing an acting director, by its nature, has effect not only between the parties but also in relation to 제3자; therefore, an act done in violation of the provisional disposition is 무효 even in relation to 제3자. ㄷ. If, while an acting representative director has been appointed pursuant to a provisional disposition order deciding to suspend the performance of duties of the 대표이사 and appoint an acting director, the successor to the person whose duties were being performed is newly elected pursuant to a resolution of a general meeting of shareholders lawfully convened, that successor may lawfully represent the 주식회사. ㄹ. If a director elected by a general meeting of shareholders whose validity is disputed regarding the effect of the resolution resigns from the office of director and is again elected as a director at a new general meeting of shareholders, an application for a provisional disposition suspending the performance of duties against that director on the ground that the earlier resolution of the general meeting of shareholders is 무효 cannot be granted.
A: ㄷ
B: ㄱ, ㄴ
C: ㄱ, ㄹ
D: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ
E: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ

label: D
question: Which of the following statements concerning 예비, conspiracy, and attempt are correct? If there is a dispute, follow the 판례. ㄱ. If 甲 participated in 乙's commission of the offense of 강도예비죄 in the form of aiding and abetting, 甲 cannot be punished as an aider and abettor to 강도예비죄. ㄴ. Under the 형법, in order to say that there is an agreement on the execution of a crime for the establishment of 음모죄, it is insufficient merely to externally 표시 or 전달 the resolve to commit a crime; objectively, it must be clearly recognized as 준비행위 for the execution of a specific crime, and 실질적인 위험성 must be 인정되어야 한다. ㄷ. In the case of 중지미수, both the upper and lower limits of the 법정형 are reduced by 2분의 1, whereas in the case of 장애미수, depending on the degree of 위험 발생 to the 법익, the punishment may either not be 감경 or only the lower limit of the 법정형 may be reduced by 2분의 1. ㄹ. Where acts of 예비 or 음모, which are punished before the commencement of 실행, are involved, the concept of 중지미수 cannot be 인정될 수 없으므로, even if the offense is discontinued at the 예비 stage, the provisions on 중지미수 cannot apply. ㅁ. If 甲, recognizing that the victim was in a state of 심신상실 or 항거불능, had 간음 with the victim with the intent to exploit that condition, but from the time of 실행의 착수 the victim was in fact not in a state of 심신상실 or 항거불능, then if, based on the circumstances 甲 recognized at the time of the act, a reasonable person objectively judged that there was a 위험성 that the result of 준강간 would occur, an 불능미수 of 준강간죄 is established.
A: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ
B: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ
C: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㅁ
D: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ, ㅁ
E: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㄹ, ㅁ

label: B
question: Which of the following 설명 concerning 공범 is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, 판례에 의함.)
A: The intent required of a 방조범 toward the 정범, etc. need not mean that the aider and abettor recognizes the specific content of the crime realized by the 정범, and 미필적 인식 or 예견 is sufficient, but this does not conflict with the point that awareness of the 불법성 of the 정범’s 범행, etc. is required.
B: The legal principle that the general provisions of the Criminal Act concerning accomplices cannot be applied to reciprocal offenses applies not only to reciprocal offenses that are necessary accomplice offenses, but also to cases in which, in terms of the statutory elements, the offense is structured so that it can be committed by a single person but is merely carried out in the form of a 대향범.
C: If a person who does not have the status relationship of being engaged in business 공모하여 a person who has such a status relationship and committed the crime of occupational breach of trust, the accomplice without such status relationship must, pursuant to the ｢형법｣ 제33조 단서, be punished by the sentence prescribed for the crime of simple breach of trust.
D: For the formation of co-principal liability, the 공동가공의 의사 required for 공동정범 is insufficient if it merely consists of recognizing another person’s 범행 and tolerating it without preventing it; it must instead consist of becoming 일체가 되어, by common intent, carry out a specific 범죄행위 and, by using another person’s 행위, bring one’s own 의사 into execution.
E: In order for aider and abettor liability to be established, the 방조행위 must be closely related to the realization of the principal offender’s 범죄, so if a person merely assisted an act that is not closely related to the realization of the principal offender’s 범죄, aider and abettor liability does not arise.

label: C
question: Of 甲, who has one of the following <범죄경력>, if 甲 is indicted on 2023. 11. 10. for one or more of the following <범죄사실>, and those <범죄사실> are found true, which of the following statements is incorrect? If there is a dispute, follow the 판례. <범죄경력> Ⓐ On 2023. 4. 10. at Seoul Central District Court, he was sentenced to a 벌금 of 5,000,000 won for 상습절도죄, and that judgment became 확정 on 2023. 4. 18. Ⓑ On 2023. 5. 10. at Seoul Central District Court, he was sentenced to 징역 6월 for 절도죄, and that judgment became 확정 on 2023. 5. 18. <범죄사실> ㉠ Habitually, around 2023. 2. 10. at X 편의점, he took one 휴대전화 owned by 피해자 M and thereby committed 절취 [상습절도]. ㉡ Around 2023. 3. 8. at Y 커피숍, he lied to 피해자 N, saying, “There is a 가상자산 that will be listed on a famous 가상자산 거래소 within a few days, and if you invest money in me, you can obtain a profit of several hundred times or more,” and around 2023. 3. 10. received 10,000,000 won from 피해자 N and thereby defrauded him [사기]. ㉢ Around 2023. 6. 10. at Z 유흥주점, he struck 피해자 O on the 뺨 several times and kicked the victim’s 다리 with his foot, thereby assaulting the victim [폭행].
A: If A, who has a criminal record, is indicted for the ㉠ offense, and it is recognized that the ㉠ criminal fact and the Ⓐ criminal fact were committed by the same 습벽, a 면소판결 under Article 326, item 1, of the Criminal Procedure Act must be rendered.
B: If A, who has a criminal record, is indicted for the ㉠ offense, even if it is recognized that the ㉠ criminal facts and the Ⓑ criminal facts were committed by the same habitual pattern, a judgment of 면소 under Article 326, item 1, of the Criminal Procedure Act cannot be rendered.
C: If A, who has a criminal record, is indicted for the ㉡ offense, it is in a concurrent offenses relationship under the latter part of Article 37 of the Criminal Act with the Ⓐ offense, for which the judgment has become final.

B: Since the victims of the crime of 명예훼손 or the crime of 모욕 include not only natural persons but also ‘법인’ and ‘법인격 없는 단체’, a county, which is a 지방자치단체, may also be a victim of the crime of 명예훼손 or the crime of 모욕.
C: In the so-called 집단표시 insult, where the content of the insult is hard to interpret as being directed at a specific person belonging to that group, and where the criticism by collective designation becomes diluted when it reaches individual members so that it does not rise to the level of affecting each member’s 사회적 평가, it is, as a rule, understood that insult against each individual member is not established.
D: The act of merely 사칭 another person and posting an article on an internet bulletin board by masquerading as if it were written directly by that person does not constitute an act of revealing facts about that person or a statement of facts, and therefore does not constitute the offense of 정보통신망이용촉진및정보보호등에관한법률위반(명예훼손)
E: Under Article 310 of the Criminal Act, for unlawfulness to be excluded, even if there is no proof that the stated fact is true, the actor must have it 진실한 것으로 믿었고 and there must also be 상당한 이유 for such belief.

label: C
question: Which of the following explanations concerning 몰수 and 추징 is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.)
A: If the charged facts are not established, the court’s recognizing unrelated criminal facts and imposing confiscation and collection violates the principle of no accusation and no trial.
B: Even if the bribee received a cashier’s check as a bribe, spent it, and then returned the bribe-giver an amount equal to the cashier’s check, since the 뇌물 itself was not returned, it cannot be 몰수, and the equivalent value must be 추징 from the 수뢰자.
C: Even if it is recognized as having substantially contributed to the commission of the criminal act, a 물건 that was used only in an act before the commencement of the 실행행위 or after the completion of the execution act, and was not used in the execution act itself, cannot be included in the ‘범죄행위에 제공한 물건’ subject to 몰수·추징.
D: Even if 몰수·추징 are related to the facts charged, if the 공소시효 has already been 완성 with respect to those facts charged, 몰수·추징 cannot be imposed.
E: If 甲 received KRW 100 million in connection with the intermediation of matters within the scope of a public official’s duties, but, according to the purpose for which KRW 30 million was received, gave it as a bribe to the relevant public official in connection with the solicitation, then only the remaining KRW 70 million, excluding that amount, may be 몰수 and 추징 from 甲.

label: E
question: Among the explanations concerning 착오, which is correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)
A: Article 16 of the Criminal Act, 법률의 착오, includes not only ignorance of the law, where the actor does not recognize the very existence of the legal norm prohibiting his act, but also the case where, although the act is generally punishable, he mistakenly believes that in his special case it is an act permitted by 법령 and therefore not a crime.
B: If 甲, with intent to kill A, mistakes B, whose appearance resembles A, for A and fires a gun at B, resulting in B’s death, then according to the concrete conformity theory, 甲에게는 an ideal concurrence of attempted murder of A and 과실치사죄 of B is established.
C: Where, in the middle of an act violating the law, there was a time when that act had temporarily been interpreted according to case law as not being subject to punishment, the actor has, in believing that his act would not be punished, 「형법」 제16조의 ‘오인에 정당한 이유’가 있다.
D: If A does not recognize that A is his own father and kills A, such a mistake does not negate the intent to commit 존속살해.
E: Where a person enters a building whose access is controlled by an administrator by obtaining the administrator’s 현실적인 consent and by the ordinary method of entry, even if there is a mistake as to the motive for consent and the administrator would not have consented to the entry had he known the actor’s 실제 purpose of entry, the offense of 건조물침입죄 is not established.

label: C
question: Which of the following correctly combines the statements that are correct (○) and incorrect (×) concerning evidence? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents) ㄱ. To examine a “서면 that is 증거물,” the procedures of reading aloud, notifying the contents, or inspection, which are the methods of examining documentary evidence, and the procedure of presentation, which is the method of examining physical evidence, must be carried out together. ㄴ. A photo of the injured area submitted as evidence of injury is 비진술증거, so the hearsay rule does not apply. ㄷ. Since “진술서 prepared during the investigative process,” which is subject to ｢형사소송법｣ Article 312(5), means one prepared in an investigative office under the involvement of an investigative agency after the investigation has begun, a 진술서 prepared by a suspect at a place other than the investigative office at the request of the investigative agency does not count as a statement prepared during the investigative process. ㄹ. If, after the prosecutor has summoned in advance without special circumstances and interviewed a person whom the prosecutor intends to request and examine as a witness on the trial date, that witness testifies in court to matters unfavorable to the defendant, the witness’s in-court testimony can be found credible only if it is ensured that the prosecutor did not influence the witness’s in-court testimony through 회유 or pressure, or by leading or suggesting answers, etc. during the pre-examination interview process.

label: A
question: Which of the following statements regarding 위법수집증거 is correct? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.)
A: Evidence obtained by an investigative agency through seizure and search, without a warrant, of electronic information that exceeds the scope of the electronic information subject to seizure from an information storage medium voluntarily submitted is inadmissible as 위법수집증거, and even if a seizure and search warrant is later issued or the defendant or defense counsel agrees to use it as evidence, that 위법성 is not cured.
B: When an investigative agency interrogates a suspect and fails to advise the suspect in advance of the 진술거부권, the statement of that suspect is inadmissible even if the 임의성 of the statement is recognized however this means only that it cannot be used as evidence of guilt against the suspect who was not advised of the 진술거부권, and therefore it may be used as evidence of guilt against that suspect's 공범
C: Compulsory urine collection conducted without the suspect's consent for the purpose of collecting criminal evidence is a 수사방법 that causes the suspect physical pain or 장애, gives rise to 수치심 or humiliation, and infringes 인간으로서의 존엄과 가치, and therefore is not permitted even if a seizure and search warrant is lawfully issued by a judge pursuant to Article 215 of the Criminal Procedure Act.
D: Inspections such as opening, sample collection, and component analysis of goods conducted in the customs clearance inspection procedure for import and export goods are for the purpose of proper customs clearance of such goods, and customs officers may conduct these inspections without a seizure and search warrant, but in order for an investigative agency to obtain possession of goods that a customs officer possesses or keeps in the course of duty for customs inspection, a warrant must be obtained in advance or afterward.
E: A work log bearing traces of practice for document forgery can be used, when public and private interests are compared and balanced, as 유죄의 증거 to prove the defendant's 소송사기, but if that work log was by a third party 절취된 and the 피해자 of the litigation fraud acquired it by paying 대가, it cannot be used as evidence of guilt.

label: A
question: Which of the following statements concerning the admissibility of documentary 전문증거 is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.)
A: If a witness, even though the related criminal judgment against him had become final and binding, refused without justifiable reason to testify in court, so that the Defendant could not do cross-examination, then even if the Defendant caused the witness’s refusal to testify, a document recording that witness’s statement at the investigative agency does not fall under Article 314 of the Criminal Procedure Act’s ‘where a statement cannot be made due to any other similar reason,’ and thus has no evidentiary admissibility.
B: In Article 312(1) of the Criminal Procedure Act, the phrase ‘검사가 작성한 피의자신문조서’ means not only the interrogation protocol of the defendant in question but also the interrogation protocol prepared by a prosecutor for another defendant or suspect who is in a 공범관계 with that defendant, and here ‘공범’ also includes a 대향범.
C: A protocol recording the contents of an examination of a suspect or reference person who became the Defendant, conducted by a 세무공무원 in charge of 조세범칙조사, constitutes a statement prepared by a Defendant or by a person other than the Defendant, or a document recording such 진술, and therefore its admissibility as evidence must be determined pursuant to ｢형사소송법｣ 제313조.
D: In an insurance fraud case, a “reply to a request for review of whether inpatient medical treatment was appropriate, etc., from the Health Insurance Review and Assessment Service,” which states the Health Insurance Review and Assessment Service’s opinion on the appropriateness of inpatient medical treatment based on the materials sent to it by the investigative agency, does not constitute a document continuously and mechanically recording the details of office processing, and therefore does not fall under ｢형사소송법｣ 제315조 제3호의 “other documents prepared under particularly trustworthy circumstances.”
E: A protocol in which hearsay statement is recorded is admissible as evidence when it satisfies the requirements of Article 312 or Article 314 of the Criminal Procedure Act and the requirements of Article 316 of the Criminal Procedure Act.

label: E
question: Which of the following statements concerning 상소 is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.)
A: Even though defense counsel indicated an intention to 신문 the Defendant at the 항소심 trial, the presiding judge’s 조치 of not allowing any 피고인신문 by defense counsel constitutes a violation of the laws governing 소송절차 and falls under a ground for 상고이유.
B: In a case where only the Defendant appealed, even if the appellate court recognized some of the criminal facts found by the court of first instance as not guilty and still imposed on the Defendant the same sentence as the court of first instance, this does not violate the principle of 금지 of disadvantageous modification.
C: Where the Defendant did not appeal the first-instance judgment in which guilt was affirmed, or appealed only on the ground of improper sentence, and the prosecutor also appealed only on the ground of improper sentence, but the appellate court accepted the prosecutor’s appeal, reversed the first-instance judgment, and imposed a higher sentence than that judgment, the Defendant cannot assert new grounds such as factual error or violation of laws and regulations as grounds for final appeal
D: Where, with respect to an appellate judgment that acquitted the Defendant of 일부 of the concurrent crimes and convicted the Defendant of some of the concurrent crimes, only the prosecutor filed a final appeal as to the 무죄 portion, when reversing it in the 상고심, only the 무죄 부분 must be reversed.
E: Where, with respect to the first-instance judgment, the defendant filed a 비약적 상고 and the prosecutor filed an appeal, and these were in 경합, the defendant’s 비약적 상고 loses its 효력; therefore, even if the defendant’s 비약적 상고 satisfied all the 적법요건 as an appeal, such as compliance with the appeal period, and even if the defendant had an intention to challenge the first-instance judgment in the appellate trial, effect as an appeal cannot be given to the defendant’s 비약적 상고.

label: A
question: Which of the following statements concerning 압수 and 수색 are incorrect? If there is a dispute, follow 판례. ㄱ. If the person subject to 압수 expressly indicated to the investigative agency that he would not participate in the execution of the 압수 and 수색 warrant, then except in special circumstances, it is permissible not to separately guarantee his defense counsel an opportunity to participate in the execution of the 압수 and 수색 warrant. ㄴ. If the investigative agency selectively seized information related to the alleged crime and then retained the remaining information unrelated thereto without deleting, discarding, or returning it, then as to the portion unrelated to the alleged crime, it has unlawfully seized and searched 전자정보 beyond the scope of electronic information subject to seizure without a warrant, and such illegality cannot be deemed cured merely because a 압수 and 수색 warrant was later issued by a court or because the defendant or defense counsel consented to its use as evidence. ㄷ. The term “information storage medium belonging to the suspect’s 소유 and 관리,” for which the right of participation should be guaranteed not only to the person subject to 압수 who voluntarily submitted the information storage medium but also to a suspect who is not the voluntary submitter, means a case in which the suspect, at the time of the 압수 and 수색 or up to a temporally proximate time, actually controlled and managed the information storage medium and possessed and exercised exclusive authority to manage and dispose of all electronic information within that information storage medium, and did not otherwise transfer or relinquish it to a third party according to his own intent, so that the suspect can be evaluated as the substantive person subject to 압수 with respect to the electronic information stored in that information storage medium. ㄹ. Whether a person qualifies as the substantive person subject to 압수 must be determined on the basis of the externally and objectively recognizable factual condition at the time of the 압수 and 수색; thus, if the suspect or any other third party had in the past been involved in the use of that information storage medium or the creation or use of individual electronic information, or if they are the data subject identified by electronic information created in the course thereof, then they must be treated as the party substantively subjected to 압수 and 수색. ㅁ. If, while voluntarily submitting a mobile phone, the suspect voluntarily provided the investigative agency with the ID and password for accessing cloud services or the like, with the intent of submitting to the investigative agency electronic information stored not in the mobile phone but in remote locations managed by a third party such as the cloud, then the electronic information stored in the cloud or the like may be regarded as having been voluntarily submitted.
A: ㄱ, ㄹ
B: ㄴ, ㄹ
C: ㄹ, ㅁ
D: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ
E: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅁ

label: E
question: Which of the following 설명 concerning 관할 is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.)
A: With respect to a first-instance criminal case, 지방법원 본원 and 지방법원 지원 are separate courts under procedural law and stand in an equal relationship, each sharing a certain territorial jurisdiction area, so unless there are special circumstances from which it may be concluded that first-instance territorial jurisdiction is recognized for 지방법원 본원, it cannot be said that first-instance territorial jurisdiction is naturally recognized for 지방법원 본원 merely because first-instance territorial jurisdiction is recognized for 지방법원 지원.
B: When an appeal of a defendant case within 단독판사 jurisdiction is pending before a panel of a district court branch, the court with jurisdiction over a 치료감호 case requested by the time of the close of oral argument is the High Court, and the court with jurisdiction over the defendant case also becomes the High Court 따라 치료감호사건의 관할을 따라, and if such a 치료감호 case is requested to a district court branch and assigned to the panel handling the appeal of the defendant case, that panel must transfer both the 치료감호사건 and the defendant case to the High Court.
C: Where a case within the jurisdiction of a panel is changed by 공소장변경 into a case within the jurisdiction of a single judge, the panel must 들어가 심판하여야 하고 cannot 재배당할 수는 없다 to a single judge.
D: Territorial jurisdiction is sufficient if it exists at the time of instituting prosecution, and if there has been a violation of jurisdiction, records of the trial proceedings such as the 공판조서 and 증인신문조서 prepared in the court’s 공판절차 that rendered the judgment of jurisdictional violation may be used as evidence if prosecution is brought again for the relevant case.
E: When the same case is pending before 여러 개의 법원 that have the same subject-matter jurisdiction, in principle the court that first received the 공소 shall try the case, and in this case the court that will not conduct a 심판 due to 관할의 경합 shall render a judgment dismissing the 공소, that is, 공소기각의 선고를 하여야 한다.

label: E
question: Which of the following statements concerning 재정신청 is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.)
A: If a request for adjudication is filed, the running of the statute of limitations for prosecution is suspended until the 재정결정 becomes final and conclusive, and the prosecutor who instituted the prosecution by the court’s 공소제기결정 may amend the indictment so long as the 동일성이 of the charges is recognized, but may not withdraw the prosecution.
B: A request for adjudication, 재정신청은 the court renders its decision until may be withdrawn, and the effect of such withdrawal does not extend to other 공동신청권자 who are entitled to request.
C: Where the period for filing a request for adjudication has elapsed, and a supplementary brief for request of adjudication is submitted while adding, as the subject of the request, a criminal complaint fact that was not originally the 대상 of the request for adjudication, the request for adjudication as to the portion added in that supplementary brief is 법률상 방식에 어긋난 것으로서 unlawful.
D: With respect to a case in which a 재정신청 기각결정 has become final and conclusive, prosecution is barred except where other 중요한 증거 is discovered, and here a “case in which a 재정신청 기각결정 has become final and conclusive” means only a case that became the subject of a 재정신청 기각결정 after the court in charge of the 재정신청 actually conducted 심리 and 판단 on the possibility and necessity of instituting 공소제기.
E: If a complainant in prison submitted a request for adjudication within the period for filing a request for adjudication to the warden of the prison or to a person acting on behalf of the warden’s duties, then even if that request for adjudication did not reach the chief prosecutor of the district prosecutor’s office or the chief of the branch office, within the above period, to which the prosecutor who rendered the non-prosecution disposition belongs, it shall be deemed to have been lawfully submitted.

label: E
question: Which of the following statements concerning special criminal procedures are all correct? (Where there is a dispute, precedents apply) ㄱ. Once the chief of a police station has issued a notice disposition for a 범칙행위, since the 범칙자 who pays the 범칙금 in accordance with the notice disposition is given an opportunity to be exempted from 형사소추 and 형사처벌, until the 범칙금 payment period set in the notice disposition expires, the chief of a police station may not, as a matter of principle, request a 즉결심판, and the prosecutor may not institute a 공소 for the same 범칙행위. ㄴ. In 즉결심판절차, a suspect interrogation protocol prepared by a 사법경찰관 in accordance with lawful procedure and method has 증거능력 even if the defendant, who was the suspect, does not admit its contents, corroborating evidence for a 자백 is not required, but the 자백배제법칙 still applies. ㄷ. A 약식명령 becomes effective upon service of the written judgment on the defendant, and even where defense counsel exists, it is not necessarily required that a copy of the 약식명령 be served on defense counsel, so the period for filing a 정식재판 청구 must be calculated from the date the 약식명령 was notified to the defendant. ㄹ. The principle of 형종 상향 금지 prescribed in ｢형사소송법｣ 제457조의2 제1항 applies 그대로 even where a case for which only the defendant requested a 정식재판 and another case are tried together and then punished as 경합범, and the same applies to an 항소 from a first-instance judgment that imposed a 벌금형 in a case where only the defendant requested a 정식재판. ㅁ. Where multiple acts corresponding to the same 죄명 are continuously committed over a certain period under a single and continuing 범의, and the protected 법익 harmed is also the same, so that the offenses are in the relationship of a 포괄일죄, if a 약식명령 has become 확정 with respect to part of such offenses, the 기판력 of the 약식명령 extends, based on the time of issuance of the 약식명령, not only to offenses that constitute part of the 포괄일죄 committed before that time, but also to other offenses in the relationship of 상상적 경합 with them.
A: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅁ
B: ㄴ, ㄹ, ㅁ
C: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ
D: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ, ㅁ
E: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ, ㅁ

label: D
question: Which of the following statements concerning 증거보전 under Article 184 of the Criminal Procedure Act (A) and a petition for 증인신문 under Article 221-2 (B) is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.)
A: A cannot be petitioned before the suspect or defendant has been formally 형사입건 in a criminal case.
B: A matter that constitutes 피의자신문 cannot be petitioned by the A method, and even if the suspect is interrogated by the A method and the contents of that interrogation include a statement concerning another 공범, if that 공범 had not been formally 형사입건 at the time of the interrogation, the effect of 증거보전 concerning that 공범 cannot be recognized.
C: When a judge conducts witness examination under A절차, the prosecutor, suspect, or defense counsel must be notified in advance of the date and place of the witness examination and be given an opportunity to participate in the witness examination; however, even if no opportunity to participate was given, if the defendant and defense counsel agreed that the witness examination record may be used as evidence and, without any special objection, it was lawfully subjected to evidentiary examination, the said witness examination record is admissible.
D: Even where a reference person who made a voluntary 진술 to a prosecutor or judicial police officer is likely to make a statement at the trial date different from the prior 진술, and where that statement is recognized as indispensable to proving the offense, the prosecutor may petition a judge for 증인신문 of that person pursuant to the B procedure only before the first trial date.
E: A witness examination record conducted under the procedures of A and B is 증거능력이 인정된다 pursuant to Article 311 of the Criminal Procedure Act

label: C
question: A, while preparing for a divorce action because of discord with her husband A, who had severe drinking habit and 의처증, asked B, A’s driver, to kill A. At A’s request, B strangled and killed A, who was drunk and asleep. The prosecutor indicted B for murder and A for 살인교사죄, and the court is conducting a 병합심리 of A and B. Which of the following statements are incorrect? If there is a dispute, follow the precedents. ㄱ. If A, in a suspect interrogation by a judicial police officer, admitted the 교사사실 but denies it in court, the suspect interrogation record prepared by the judicial police officer concerning A, in which A denied the contents, may be used as 반대증거 to impeach A’s in-court testimony, insofar as 임의성 is recognized. ㄴ. If W, B’s friend, appears in court and testifies that B told him 자신이 A를 살해하였다, W’s testimony cannot be used as evidence of B’s 유죄 so long as B, the 원진술자, is appearing in court. ㄷ. If both A and B are confessing to the 공소사실, but there is no other evidence corroborating the 자백, A and B must be acquitted. ㄹ. If A confesses in court to instigating the murder of A, A’s statement may be used as evidence of B’s 유죄. ㅁ. Even if the court of first instance, in sentencing A, did not specify the fact that B strangled and killed A, if there are 특별한 사정 showing that A’s right of defense or A’s counsel’s 변호권 was not essentially infringed, it is not a violation of 법령 that affected the judgment.
A: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ
B: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ
C: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㅁ
D: ㄷ, ㄹ, ㅁ
E: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ, ㅁ

label: B
question: Which of the following statements concerning 공판 proceedings are correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.) ㄱ. If the defendant was absent at the first appellate trial date, appeared at the second trial date, but again failed to appear at the third trial date, and the court proceeded with the 공판절차 in the presence only of the defendant’s 변호인 and the prosecutor, closed 변론, and then pronounced a judgment dismissing the defendant’s appeal on the fourth trial date, this is lawful as a measure under 형사소송법 Article 365. ㄴ. In first-instance 공판절차, if the defendant’s 소재 cannot be ascertained for six months from the receipt of a 송달불능보고서 on the defendant, the case may be tried without the defendant’s 진술 in accordance with the Supreme Court Rules; however, in cases punishable by 사형, 무기, or 징역 or 금고 for a term exceeding 10 years, the case may not be tried without the defendant’s 진술. ㄷ. The opportunity to state the 최종의견 need only be given to the defendant or 변호인, so even if the presiding judge, immediately after defense counsel’s 최후변론, designated and notified the date for pronouncement of judgment, thereby closing 변론 and pronouncing judgment without giving the defendant an opportunity to state a 최종의견, this is an act of 재량 within the scope of the presiding judge’s 소송지휘권 and cannot be regarded as a violation of law in the 소송절차. ㄹ. Whether to reopen closed 변론 is, in principle, a matter within the court’s 재량, but if the appellate court did not grant a 변론재개신청 filed by defense counsel appointed after the close of 변론, this corresponds to a case in which there is 위법 due to 심리미진. ㅁ. Whether to admit an 증거신청 is within the court’s 재량, so with respect to the court’s 증거결정 neither 보통항고 nor 즉시항고 may be taken; rather, 이의신청 may be raised only when the 증거결정 violates 법령, and it may also be used as a ground for 상소 only when, as a result, there has been a mistaken finding of 사실 affecting the 판결.
A: ㄴ, ㄹ
B: ㄴ, ㅁ
C: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ
D: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅁ
E: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ, ㅁ

label: A
question: Which of the following statements concerning 공소제기 and 공소장변경 is not correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.)
A: Even if the 공소제기 was instituted without specifying the defendant, if the 피고인 and 변호인 did not raise an objection and proceeded with the trial, the 하자 in the 공소제기 is 치유된다.
B: Even where, because the time, place, means, and object of the offense differ among the 범죄사실, they are recognized as 수개의 범죄사실, those multiple 범죄사실 may be pleaded alternatively or in the alternative.
C: In a comprehensive single offense, when deciding whether to grant leave to amend the indictment, rather than examining for each individual count constituting the 포괄일죄 whether it is identical to the former one, the focus should be on whether the amended facts, viewed as a whole, fall within the 범주 of a comprehensive single offense, that is, whether they may be regarded as a case in which the same kind of offense is repeatedly committed under a single and continuous 범의 and the protected legal interest harmed is also the same.
D: Even where, as a result of a 공소장변경, the case no longer qualifies as a 사건 subject to 국민참여재판, the court must 계속 진행하여야 하며 however, the court may decide that the 당해 사건 be tried by the 지방법원 본원 합의부 without 국민참여재판, and no 불복 lies against such 결정.
E: Even if the defendant was prosecuted for having defrauded money from the victim without any intent or ability to repay, if it is recognized, without going through the amendment of the indictment procedure, that the defendant had the victim introduce a third party, borrowed the same amount of money, and thereby obtained a property benefit by causing the victim to assume a surety obligation for that amount, there can be no illegality.

label: D
question: Entertainer 甲, around 08:00 on 2023. 3. 9., while driving his passenger car, which was covered by 자동차종합보험, on a highway, struck the road’s left curb, and as a result of that impact, suffered an injury requiring 전치 6주 himself and caused an injury requiring 전치 8주 to 乙, who was in the front passenger seat and was in a 사실혼 relationship with him. 甲 and 乙 got out of the passenger car immediately after the accident but soon lost consciousness, and were transported to a hospital in that state. When 乙 regained consciousness, 乙, out of concern that 甲’s entertainment activities might be affected, made a false statement to Police Officer P that 乙 had been driving the above passenger car and caused the traffic accident. Which of the following statements regarding this is correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)
A: Although P sought to investigate whether 乙, who had been found near the driver’s seat and transported to the hospital, had driven under the influence, when 乙 did not regain consciousness, and P received by voluntary submission from Nurse A a portion of the blood that A had drawn from 乙 for treatment purposes and seized it without a warrant, the seizure procedure violates 적법절차.
B: If 乙 was indicted for the crime of violation of the Road Traffic Act (음주운전) and the crime of violation of the Act on Special Cases Concerning the Settlement of Traffic Accidents (치상), and at the first trial date 乙 and 乙’s counsel objected to the blood examination request reply as evidence, but at the third trial date, while 乙 was absent, 乙’s counsel consented to its use as evidence, then the above evidence consent is 효력이 있다.
C: If 乙, after receiving a final judgment of conviction for the crime of violation of the Act on Special Cases Concerning the Settlement of Traffic Accidents (injury), later broke up with 甲 and then petitions for a retrial while submitting as evidence a mobile phone photograph that he had concealed, showing 甲 driving at the time of the above traffic accident, this falls under the 'when clear evidence establishing innocence has been newly discovered' clause in ｢형사소송법｣ Article 420 item 5.
D: Even if the above passenger car was covered by comprehensive automobile insurance, so that 甲 cannot be prosecuted for the crime of violation of the Act on Special Cases Concerning the Settlement of Traffic Accidents (injury), 乙’s act of helping 甲 escape may constitute the crime of 범인도피죄.
E: Even if B’s act of making a false statement to P constitutes 범인도피죄, B is not punishable because, at the time of the offense, B was in a 사실혼 relationship with A.

label: C
question: Party A and A are brothers who do not live together, and A went missing. In around January 2023, Party A, as the court-appointed absentee property administrator for A, received KRW 700 million in expropriation compensation deposited in favor of A. Thereafter, in around March 2023, the court changed the absentee property administrator for A from Party A to B. Nevertheless, Party A neither informed B of the existence of the deposited money nor handed it over. After B learned of these facts in around May 2023, B obtained permission from the court concerning the exercise of the right to file a complaint in around June 2023 and then immediately filed a complaint with the investigative agency against Party A for the offense of violation of the Act on the Aggravated Punishment, etc. of Specific Economic Crimes (Breach of Trust) concerning these facts. Which of the following statements are incorrect? If there is a dispute, follow the precedents ㄱ. While Party A, B, and Party A's older sister C were gathered together and talking, B recorded the conversation among the three persons using the voice-recording function of his mobile phone for the purpose of collecting evidence, and such recording act falls under Article 16(1) of the Protection of Communications Secrets Act and is unlawful. ㄴ. B, as the absentee property administrator for A, having obtained permission from the court concerning the exercise of the right to file a complaint regarding criminal acts against A's property, which was the object of administration, qualifies as a lawful person entitled to file a complaint as A's legal representative. ㄷ. After Judicial Police Officer P, having obtained an arrest warrant for Party A for the offense of violation of the Act on the Aggravated Punishment, etc. of Specific Economic Crimes (Breach of Trust), discovered Party A, who had parked a vehicle in the parking lot in front of his house, and arrested Party A pursuant to the arrest warrant while searching Party A's vehicle, such act is lawful under Article 216(1) No. 2 of the Criminal Procedure Act. ㄹ. If Party A injured Judicial Police Officer P by colliding with him with Party A's vehicle during the arrest process described in item (c), then the offense of special obstruction of the execution of official duties causing injury and the offense of special injury are established against Party A, and the two offenses are in a relation of ideal concurrence. ㅁ. If Party A were A's non-cohabiting son and B's complaint had been filed on December 20, 2023, then the court must, with respect to Party A's offense of violation of the Act on the Aggravated Punishment, etc. of Specific Economic Crimes (Breach of Trust), render a judgment dismissing the public prosecution pursuant to Article 327(2) of the Criminal Procedure Act.
A: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ
B: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㄹ
C: ㄱ, ㄹ, ㅁ
D: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㅁ
E: ㄷ, ㄹ, ㅁ

label: C
question: A owned building X on land owned by B, but after losing a lawsuit for removal of the building filed by B, and after X was demolished, A newly constructed building Y on the said land. B threw more than 30 eggs at the wall of building Y, causing A to incur cleaning expenses of approximately KRW 500,000 to remove the traces of the eggs remaining on building Y. In response to B's above act, A placed a reinforced concrete structure tightly in front of B's vehicle parked near building Y and an excavator crusher tightly behind it, thereby preventing B from operating the vehicle for approximately 17 hours. Meanwhile, B, angry, used red paint to write graffiti on A's excavator crusher: "The owner of the illegal building, get out." A summary order imposing a fine of KRW 1,000,000 was issued with respect to this criminal act. Which of the following statements concerning this is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) ㄱ. A's act of newly constructing building Y without authorization infringed the utility of B's land itself and constitutes the offense of damaging property. ㄴ. B's act of throwing more than 30 eggs at the wall of building Y infringed the utility of that building and constitutes the offense of damaging property. ㄷ. A's act of rendering B's vehicle incapable of being operated for 17 hours infringed the vehicle's inherent utility and constitutes the offense of damaging property. ㄹ. If B, in objection to the above summary order, requested a formal trial without retaining counsel and thereafter failed to appear on two consecutive occasions, the court may conduct evidentiary examination without B's appearance, and in this case B's consent to evidence is deemed pursuant to Article 318(2) of the Criminal Procedure Act. ㅁ. If B, as in item ㄹ above, after consent to evidence was deemed in the formal trial and evidentiary examination was completed, was sentenced to a fine of KRW 1,000,000 and appealed, and if B appeared in the appellate trial and expressed an intention to withdraw or revoke the consent to evidence, the effect of the consent to evidence is lost because the deemed consent to evidence at the first instance was made regardless of B's true intention.
A: ㄱ, ㄴ
B: ㄱ, ㅁ
C: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㅁ
D: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㅁ
E: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ

label: D
question: A public official, 甲, for the purpose of concealing the fact that his wife 乙 had violated the Building Act, recorded in the public document known as the completion inspection report the statement, “The completion inspection was conducted pursuant to the settlement design document,” even though he had not checked the settlement design document. When 甲 was indicted for that conduct and 乙 was requested as a witness, 甲 instigated 乙 to commit perjury, and 乙 then gave false testimony. Which of the following statements is correct? If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.
A: In addition to the crime of making a false official document against A, the crime of dereliction of duty is also established, and the two are in a relation of ideal concurrence, 즉 상상적 경합관계에 해당한다.
B: If the contents of the completion inspection report prepared by 甲 objectively correspond to the 준공 상태 at the construction site, then the crime of 허위공문서작성죄 is not established against 甲.
C: Because 甲’s act of instigating 乙 to commit perjury, like the act of making a false statement concerning his own criminal case, falls within 甲’s exercise of the right of defense, 甲 cannot be punished for the crime of 위증교사.
D: If, during the witness examination of 乙, the prosecutor used leading questions to the direct examination even though 乙 did not show hostility or antipathy, and if 甲 stated at the next trial date regarding the above witness examination record that there were no points to be changed or objected to, then the defect in the 주신문 conducted by leading questions is cured.
E: If perjury is established for 乙's 허위 증언, then even after the criminal trial against 甲 has become final and binding, when 乙 voluntarily 자수 the perjury 사실, the punishment shall be 감경 or 면제한다.

label: A
question: A, while residing with his disabled mother A and having lawfully obtained and used an 장애인사용자동차표지(보호자용), parked his passenger car in a place other than an 장애인전용주차구역 in an apartment parking lot with the placard still displayed, even though because A’s address differed from his, the ‘장애인전용주차구역 주차표지가 있는 장애인사용자동차표지’ had become ineffective, and was caught. Which of the following statements are incorrect? If there is a dispute, follow the precedents. ㄱ. Because 공문서부정행사죄 is a 구체적 위험범, the subject, object, and manner of the offense should be interpreted as strictly as possible so that the punishment scope is limited within a reasonable range. ㄴ. Even if 甲 did not park the passenger car in an 장애인전용주차구역, because 甲 displayed on the passenger car an 장애인사용자동차표지 that 甲 had no authority to use, thereby outwardly indicating it as though it were a vehicle used by a person with disabilities, this constitutes 장애인사용자동차표지 부정행사. ㄷ. If Judge R issued a 약식명령 against 甲 for 공문서부정행사죄, and after service A submitted to the court, on behalf of 甲, a 정식재판청구서 bearing only 甲’s name and lacking a 기명날인 or signature, but a court official accepted it without requesting 보정, the court cannot render a 기각결정 with respect to that 정식재판청구. ㄹ. If apartment resident B, having been summoned as a witness in 甲’s 정식재판, failed to appear because B was due to give birth, the statement protocol prepared by a judicial police officer concerning B, to which 甲 did not consent to its use as evidence, cannot have 증거능력 recognized under 형사소송법 제314조. ㅁ. If Judge R, who issued the 약식명령, participated in the appellate trial proceedings of the 정식재판 against 甲 up to the second 공판 date but was replaced at the third 공판 and did not participate in that judgment, it cannot be said that the judge who participated in the prior trial participated in the trial of the relevant case for which a challenge was filed.
A: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ
B: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ
C: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅁ
D: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ
E: ㄴ, ㄹ, ㅁ

label: C
question: A public official with authority to grant building permits, 甲, under the aid and abetment of the person in charge of practical affairs 乙, received 20,000,000 won in 뇌물 from a building contractor, 丙, in connection with a building permit for a building. Thereafter, 甲 gave 乙 2,000,000 won out of the 20,000,000 won as 사례금, spent 4,000,000 won as 비용 necessary for the building permit, and deposited the remaining 14,000,000 won in a bank. When the building permit was later refused, 丙 demanded the return of the entire amount of the bribe he had given to 甲. 甲 withdrew the 14,000,000 won that had been deposited on the ground that he had given 2,000,000 won to 乙 as 사례금 and spent 4,000,000 won as 비용, and returned only that money to 丙. Which of the following statements concerning this is correct? If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.
A: The gratuity of 2,000,000 won that 甲 gave to 乙 cannot be 추징 from 甲.
B: Since the 4,000,000 won in 필요비 that A expended in connection with the 건축허가 cannot be regarded as having been 실질적으로 취득한 by A, it cannot be 추징할 from A.
C: The 14,000,000 won that A returned to C cannot be 추징 from C.
D: If 丙 is indicted for bribery-giving and a conviction is rendered final, the statute of limitations for prosecution for 甲's offense of bribe-taking is suspended from the time the above 형사사건 against 丙 is indicted until the time it becomes final.
E: If 乙 leaves for the United States for the purpose of evading punishment for 뇌물수수방조죄, the statute of limitations for prosecution for 甲, a co-offender, for the offense of 뇌물수수죄 is also 정지된다 during 乙's period of 도피.

label: B
question: On 2023. 2. 12., 甲 sold to voice-phishing scammer 乙, for KRW 1,000,000, a deposit passbook with no balance for a deposit account opened in his own name at X Bank, one debit card linked to the said account, and one OTP card, without knowing that they would be used in a fraud offense. Thereafter, on 2023. 2. 13., 乙 called A and, while impersonating a prosecutor, said, ‘If you transfer the money to 甲, who is a financial law expert, I will verify any criminal connection and then return it,’ and A, having been deceived thereby, transferred KRW 10,000,000 to the said account around 11:20 on 2023. 2. 14. Then 甲, around 11:50 on the same day, used the debit card linked to the said account, which he had separately made and had in his possession, and arbitrarily withdrew KRW 3,000,000 of that amount. Regarding this, the prosecutor filed an indictment on the ground that 甲, by arbitrarily withdrawing KRW 3,000,000 from the fraud proceeds, embezzled 乙's property primarily and A's property alternatively. However, part of the page seal had been affixed to the reverse side of page 1 of the indictment, but the remaining page seal had not been affixed to the front side of page 2, and there was no page seal from the reverse side of page 2 to the last page. Which of the following statements concerning this is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)
A: After A deposited KRW 10,000,000 into the account in the name of 甲, 甲 is in the position of 보관하는 지위에 있다 for the benefit of A.
B: A's act of arbitrarily withdrawing 3,000,000 won from the 사기피해금 constitutes 횡령죄 against B.
C: If 甲 were an accomplice to 乙's fraud offense, then the act of arbitrarily withdrawing 3,000,000 won from the fraud 피해금 does not constitute the crime of 횡령 against A.
D: Even if the 공소장 lacks the prosecutor’s 간인, so long as the form and 내용 of the indictment are recognized as continuous and its 일체성 is 인정되고, and it is recognized as having been prepared by the same 검사, the 공소장 cannot be regarded as a document without 법적 효력.
E: In the appellate trial concerning 甲, if a judgment of not guilty is rendered on all counts of the indictment and the prosecutor files an appeal therefrom, then if the 예비적 공소사실 part must be reversed in the Supreme Court trial, the 주위적 공소사실 part, which stands in the same체 relationship with it, also inevitably must be reversed together.

label: E
question: Which of the following statements concerning the following case is correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) The Chief of the Tax Office imposed a tax disposition on 甲, who qualifies as a secondary taxpayer under the Framework Act on National Taxes, with respect to B Corporation’s delinquent national taxes hereinafter referred to as “the tax disposition at issue”. The filing period for an administrative lawsuit to assert the illegality of the tax disposition at issue has elapsed. However, one year later, the Constitutional Court, in a constitutional complaint case filed by 乙, decided that the provision of the Framework Act on National Taxes that served as the basis for the tax disposition at issue was unconstitutional hereinafter referred to as “the unconstitutional decision at issue”. The Chief of the Tax Office attached the deposit claim in 甲’s name, on the basis of the National Tax Collection Act, which was validly in force at the time pursuant to the tax disposition at issue, in order to collect the delinquent amount and deficiency amount including additional tax that 甲 had been in arrears with.
A: Since the provision of the ｢국세기본법｣ that served as the basis for the tax disposition at issue was declared 위헌 by the Constitutional Court, the tax disposition at issue is a disposition lacking legal basis and is therefore 당연무효; accordingly, although the 제소기간 has elapsed, bringing an administrative lawsuit seeking confirmation of its 무효 is lawful.
B: The statutory provision that was the subject of the unconstitutional decision is the basis of the tax disposition at issue, and even if the retroactive effect of the unconstitutional decision is 인정되더라도 there is no 우려 of undermining legal stability, so the retroactive effect of the unconstitutional decision also 미친다 to 甲.
C: If before the unconstitutional decision at issue, 甲 had brought an administrative lawsuit seeking revocation of the tax disposition at issue and had already lost with final and conclusive effect, then because the unconstitutional decision at issue constitutes a ground for retrial under ｢헌법재판소법｣ Article 75(7), 甲 may petition for retrial.
D: The defect constituting a ground for revocation in the prior disposition, namely the tax disposition at issue, is succeeded to by the subsequent 체납 처분, namely the 압류처분.
E: If the statutory provision that served as the basis for the imposition of tax is declared 위헌, then, because of the binding force of that unconstitutional decision, it is no longer permitted to commence or continue a new 체납처분 for the enforcement of the tax claim after the unconstitutional decision. A delinquent tax collection disposition made in violation of the effect of such 위헌결정 is, by that reason alone, so seriously and objectively 명백하여 당연무효이다.

label: B
question: Which of the following statements concerning 공무원의 rights and duties is correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.)
A: The State Public Officials Act does not prescribe the ‘근무조건 법정주의’ with respect to public officials’ 보수, etc., so payment of public officials’ remuneration is possible if it has been 계상되어 있으면 in the national budget.
B: Among the provisions of the State Public Officials Act, the part stating that elementary and secondary school teachers who are education public officials may not participate in the formation of or join ‘other political organizations’ is contrary to the principle of 명확성원칙.
C: Unlike military personnel, 군인과 달리 civilian military employees who are not in the status of State public officials, 국가공무원의 지위에 있지 않은 군무원, should not be subject to strict restrictions on freedom of political expression, 정치적 표현의 자유에 대해 엄격한 제한을 받아서는 안 되며, and acts of civilian military employees publicly expressing political opinions, 군무원의 정치적 의견을 공표하는 행위도, also do not need to be strictly restricted 엄격히 제한할 필요가 없다.
D: The ‘집단행위 for purposes other than official duties’ prohibited by the ｢국가공무원법｣ does not mean only ‘collective acts that are contrary to the public interest and that have effects such as neglecting the duty of devotion to duty,’ but means all collective acts undertaken by public officials for any purpose other than official duties, based on the mission of public officials as servants of the entire people.
E: Because of a provision of the former ｢Rules on the Payment of Honorary Retirement Allowances, etc. for Judges and Court Officials｣ that provided that the amount of a judge’s honorary retirement allowance be calculated not only on the basis of the remaining period until mandatory retirement age but also by reflecting the remaining term of office, there is a possibility that a judge may suffer disadvantage as compared with ‘other career public officials’ in whether an honorary retirement allowance is paid and in its amount, etc., and this constitutes 자의적인 discrimination.

label: A
question: Which of the following correctly combines the statements that are correct (○) and incorrect (×) regarding the right to informational self-determination? (If there is a dispute, follow precedents) ㄱ. A statutory provision that designates as a personal information registration subject a person whose conviction for 공중밀집장소 추행죄 has become final, regardless of the gravity of criminal liability, infringes the right to informational self-determination. ㄴ. A statutory provision that requires game business operators to establish a procedure enabling 본인 인증 when a game user registers as a member does not infringe the right to informational self-determination. ㄷ. A statutory provision that requires a person subject to a 보안관찰처분 to report the fact of release within 7 days after release from prison, etc and punishes a violation thereof does not infringe the right to informational self-determination because the inconvenience to the person subject to the disposition is not great and the 7-day reporting period cannot be said to be excessively short. ㄹ. A statutory provision that allows DNA identification information to be entered into and managed in a database until the death of the person subject to collection infringes the right to informational self-determination because it is uniformly applied merely upon the finalization of a conviction for the target offenses, without any consideration of the gravity of the offense, the risk of recidivism, and the like. ㅁ. A statutory provision that requires the public announcement of the violation facts concerning a daycare center that received a suspension of operation, a closure order, or a penalty surcharge because it received subsidies by falsehood or other improper means or misappropriated subsidies does not infringe the right to informational self-determination because it is intended to prevent similar violations by daycare center installers/operators and to ensure the right of guardians of infants and young children to choose a childcare institution.

label: C
question: Which of the following is the correct combination of the statements that are correct (○) and incorrect (×) regarding the right to a trial? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents) ㄱ.
