Even if a statute provides that a lawsuit seeking revocation of a disciplinary disposition by the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court against a judge shall be tried by the Supreme Court as a single-instance trial, this can be deemed reasonable because it is intended to promote the promptness of adjudication in light of the status of a judge and the special nature of disciplinary proceedings against judges, so it cannot be said that the judge’s right to a trial is thereby 침해된다고 볼 수 없다 ㄴ. Since seized articles exist for the benefit of the prosecutor who seeks to prove the facts charged, the act of investigative authorities arbitrarily disposing of articles seized in the course of an arrest of a flagrant offender, but without the defendant’s waiver of ownership, cannot be deemed to infringe the defendant’s right to a 공정한 재판을 받을 권리 ㄷ. Since extradition proceedings are inherently criminal-procedure in nature, and criminal procedure as a trial procedure naturally includes procedures for challenge to a higher court, a statutory provision that places extradition review under the exclusive jurisdiction of the Seoul High Court and does not recognize a procedure for challenge to the Supreme Court infringes the extraditable person’s 재판청구권 ㄹ. Because granting the defendant a right of access to the trial procedure concerning medical treatment and custody is deemed necessary in order to more effectively secure the defendant’s rights, the right of the defendant himself or herself to request 의료감호 is also included within the scope of protection of the right to a trial

label: B
question: Which of the following statements concerning 종교의 자유 is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.)
A: The act of the Commander of the Army Training Center by compelling recruits to attend one of the 개신교, 불교, 천주교, or 원불교 religious events held at the 종교 시설 within the Army Training Center favors a particular religion and thus violates the 정교분리원칙.
B: Since conscientious objection to military service is based on a 간절한 hope and determination for the peaceful coexistence of humankind, a provision of the ｢병역법｣ that compels 병역이행 for conscientious objectors who have not been specially 면제받지 않은 does not restrict the freedom of religion of the relevant 종교인, even when applied to a person who refuses military service on the basis of religious 신앙.
C: The act of the Commissioner of the Statistics Korea, while conducting the face-to-face interview survey of the Population and Housing Census, of requiring respondents through the responsible enumerators to answer the survey items asking whether they have a religion and, if so, what specific 종교명 it is, is one of the 조사 사항 to be used as basic data for 통계 and is not intended to impose 불이익 on the ground that one believes in a particular 종교 or to compel conduct contrary to 종교적 확신.
D: A statutory provision that also imposes a 신고의무 to file a report on the establishment of an elderly care facility operated by a religious organization as part of 구호활동 and punishes violations thereof does not infringe freedom of religion, because in elderly care facilities of a certain size or larger, the degree of harm from safety accidents or 인권침해 may increase, so it is necessary to impose the 신고의무 without exception.
E: A statutory provision that, for a person who has been subjected to a disciplinary confinement measure, prohibits attendance at religious rites or religious events during the disciplinary confinement period, except for religious activities through religious counseling, does not infringe the freedom of religion of the relevant inmate, because such disadvantage cannot be said to be greater than the public interest in maintaining order in detention through compliance with discipline.

label: D
question: Which of the following correctly combines the statements that are correct (○) and incorrect (×) regarding property rights? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents) ㄱ. Article 13(2) of the Constitution provides that “all 국민 shall not be deprived of 재산권 by 소급입법 ...,” and here retroactive legislation refers only to laws with 진정소급효. ㄴ. A 살처분 명령 under the Act on the Prevention of Contagious Animal Diseases should be regarded as exceeding the scope of 사회적 제약 that livestock owners must tolerate, in that it individually and 구체적으로 deprives already formed 재산권. ㄷ. A provision of the Act on Dam Construction and Assistance to Surrounding Areas, etc. that allows 댐사용권 to be 취소 or 변경 cannot be viewed as providing for 수용, 사용, or 제한 under Article 23(3) of the Constitution that requires 보상, insofar as it individually and 구체적으로 deprives or restricts already formed specific 재산권 for the 공익; rather, it should be regarded as a provision that defines both the 내용 and 한계 of 댐사용권, which are exclusive use rights concerning 다목적댐 constructed for 공익적 purposes such as adequate water supply and flood prevention, and that concretizes the 사회적 제약 on 재산권 according to 공익적 demands. ㄹ. Where the business of a 폐기물재생처리신고업자 under the former provisions falls within the category of 폐기물중간처리업 under the amended provisions, an existing 폐기물재생처리신고업자 who is effectively forced to discontinue business due to the supplementary provisions of the former 폐기물관리법, which require obtaining a permit for 폐기물중간처리업 under the amended provisions within 1 year from the date of enforcement of the Act in order to continue business, may receive 보상 under Article 23(3) of the Constitution on the ground of infringement of 재산권.

label: A
question: Which of the following is the correct combination of the statements that are correct (○) and incorrect (×) regarding the 영장주의? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.) ㄱ. A warrant issued by the court ex officio has the character of a 허가장, but a 구속영장 issued upon the request of an investigative agency has the character of a 명령장. ㄴ. A statutory provision that allows the relevant 행정청, when it discovers a game product that has not received 등급분류 or a game product whose content differs from that of a game product that has received 등급분류, to have the relevant public official 수거 and 폐기 it is intended to deal with an urgent situation, and because its 불가피성 and 정당성 are sufficiently recognized, even if collection without a warrant is permitted, it cannot be regarded as violating the 영장주의. ㄷ. A decision by the 법무부장관 prohibiting the departure from the country of a national whose 형사재판 is pending constitutes a 강제처분 directly involving physical 강제력 against the body to which the 영장주의 applies. ㄹ. An act by the 교도소장 of requiring an inmate who is a 마약류사범 to provide urine for a 마약류반응검사 constitutes a 강제처분 against the body and thus violates the 영장주의.

label: D
question: Which of the following is the correct combination of statements that are correct (○) and incorrect (×) regarding the pardon system? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents) ㄱ. The President may, by law, grant 사면, 감형, or 복권, and under the ｢사면법｣, when general 사면, general 감형, or general 복권 is granted, the consent of the National Assembly must be obtained. ㄴ. Under the ｢사면법｣, when the Minister of Justice submits to the President a recommendation for 특별사면, 감형 for a specified person, and 복권, it must undergo review by the 사면심사위원회, and when the President grants 특별사면, 감형 for a specified person, and 복권, the consent of the National Assembly is not required. ㄷ. 복권 shall not be granted to a person whose execution of sentence has not yet been completed or who has not been exempted from execution. ㄹ. Because an individual convict has no subjective right to demand 특별사면 or 감형, there is no constitutional duty to act or statutory duty on the President or the Minister of Justice, etc. to grant 특별사면 to, or commute the sentence of, a convict.

label: E
question: Which of the following explanations concerning the 적법요건 for a 권한쟁의심판 is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.)
A: The chairperson of the Agenda Adjustment Committee under ｢국회법｣ does not fall under a 국가기관 that may file a 권한쟁의심판 as prescribed by the Constitution and ｢헌법재판소법｣, and therefore legal capacity as a party in a 권한쟁의심판 is not recognized.
B: Under the current legal system, which contains no statutory provision permitting ‘제3자 소송담당’ in a 권한쟁의심판, a petition for 권한쟁의심판 filed by National Assembly members alleging that their 동의권 was infringed in the conclusion of a contract that would become a 부담 on the State in addition to the 예산 is improper for lack of 청구인적격.
C: A petition for adjudication on a dispute over authority may be filed only when the respondent’s 처분 or 부작위 has infringed, or presents a significant 위험 of infringing, the petitioner’s 권한 conferred by the Constitution or by law, and here “disposition” means only something of 법적 significance and must be an act that may specifically affect the petitioner’s 법적 지위.
D: As a requirement for the admissibility of a petition for adjudication on a dispute over authority, ‘부작위’ does not mean a mere factual omission, but means failing to act despite the existence of a constitutional or statutory duty to do so.
E: Regardless of whether a state organ’s act counts as the exercise of its 독자적인 권능 conferred on that organ by the Constitution and laws, if such an act is subject to 제한 by another state organ, the possibility that the 권한 referred to in a 권한쟁의심판 may be 침해될 수 있다 can be recognized.

label: C
question: Which of the following statements concerning 직접성, an admissibility requirement for constitutional complaint adjudication, is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.)
A: Since 법령, as a general rule, infringe fundamental rights only through concrete 집행행위 as an intermediary, an individual who has suffered an infringement of fundamental rights is, first of all, required, by the nature of a constitutional complaint, to pursue 구제절차 for the infringement of fundamental rights through the method of 일반 쟁송 by targeting that 집행행위.
B: A provision of the Act on the Performance of Duties by Police Officers that sets out the requirements for using a water cannon, etc. presupposes a concrete enforcement act, namely the police’s 살수행위 at an assembly or demonstration site, and therefore the directness of the infringement of fundamental rights is not recognized.
C: A provision of the Enforcement Rule of the Judicial Scriveners Act that 규정한 that the total number of clerical staff for a judicial scrivener shall not exceed 5 does not directly 발생시키지 않으므로 bring about the effect of dismissing clerical staff, and therefore 기본권 침해의 directness is not recognized.
D: A provision of the ｢Prosecutors Disciplinary Act｣ that prescribes the composition of the members of the Prosecutors Disciplinary Committee does not recognize the 직접성 of the infringement of fundamental rights because that Act contemplates a separate 징계처분.
E: A provision of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Execution of Sentences and the Treatment of Inmates that grants the prison warden discretion to open correspondence does not 인정 directness of the infringement of an inmate’s fundamental rights because it presupposes a concrete enforcement act, such as the prison warden’s act of checking prohibited items.

label: D
question: Among the explanations concerning 신체의 자유, which of the following are all incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.) ㄱ. A 법률조항 that allows 감경 or 면제 of a sentence for a person who has served all or part of the 형 in a foreign country does not infringe 신체의 자유 because it falls within the 입법자의 입법형성권. ㄴ. Unlike 형벌, a 보안처분 is based on the actor's 장래 재범위험성, and because whether to pronounce the 보안처분 is determined by judging 재범위험성 at the 재판시 rather than at the 행위시, even if a certain 보안처분 has a strong 형벌적 성격 and restricts 신체의 자유 to a degree equivalent to 박탈, the 형벌불소급원칙 does not apply. ㄷ. Excluding foreign nationals who are 보호ed under the ｢출입국관리법｣ from the scope of 피수용자 who may file a 구제청구 under the ｢인신보호법｣ deprives them of the opportunity to contest the 적부 of their detention under the ｢인신보호법｣ and thus infringes 신체의 자유. ㄹ. A 법률조항 that says a person who has received a 강제퇴거명령 may be 보호 in a 보호시설 until 송환 becomes possible if immediate removal outside the Republic of Korea is impossible infringes 신체의 자유 because it emphasizes only 행정의 편의성과 획일성. ㅁ. The 변호인과의 접견교통권, in light of the 헌법 규정, is a fundamental right concerning 신체의 자유 limited only to the 피의자 or 피고인 who has been 체포 or 구속, and it cannot be said that those provisions derive a right of 접견교통권 for the 구속피의자 or 피고인 from the 변호인.
A: ㄴ, ㅁ
B: ㄷ, ㄹ, ㅁ
C: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ
D: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ, ㅁ
E: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ, ㅁ

label: C
question: Among the explanations concerning the 행정부, which is 옳은 것? (If there is a 다툼, follow the 판례.)
A: The Prime Minister, upon the President’s order, directs and supervises the heads of each central administrative agency, and when an order or disposition by the head of a central administrative agency is recognized as 위법한 경우, he may suspend or revoke it without obtaining the President’s approval.
B: If the Prime Minister is unable to perform his duties due to 사고, the Deputy Prime Minister who concurrently serves as the Minister of Education shall act in his stead, and then the Deputy Prime Minister who concurrently serves as the Minister of Economy and Finance shall act in his stead in that order, and if both the Prime Minister and the Deputy Prime Ministers are unable to perform their duties due to 사고, then if the President makes a designation, the State Council member who received that designation shall act in his stead, and if there is no designation, the State Council member according to the order prescribed in Article 26(1) of the Government Organization Act shall act in his stead.
C: Even if the President did not undergo 국무회의 심의 in the process of deciding to suspend operations of the Kaesong Industrial Complex, it cannot be said that the decision had a 하자 of violating the procedures prescribed by the Constitution and laws, or that it had a 흠결 of not undergoing procedures necessarily required under the 적법절차원칙.
D: The Constitution establishes the Board of Audit and Inspection under the President in order to conduct 공무원의 직무감찰, etc. The scope of the Board of Audit and Inspection’s authority to inspect duties includes the authority to request 징계 from the appointing authority, and 위법성 is the standard for audit, while 부당성 is not the standard.
E: When the President’s term expires or the office becomes vacant, or when the President-elect dies or loses his qualification by judgment or other reasons, within a certain 기간 a successor shall be elected, and the same applies when the President is unable to perform his duties due to an accident, 즉 사고로 인하여 직무를 수행할 수 없는 경우에도 마찬가지이다.

label: E
question: Which of the following statements regarding ｢행정소송법｣상 legal interest are correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents) ㄱ. The competent administrative agency granted A a 숙박업구조변경허가 so that guest rooms could be installed on the 4th and 5th floors of A’s building, and 甲, who operates an inn about 700m away, filed an action seeking 무효확인 of the disposition granting A that permit on the ground of 침해 of residential peace and the living environment, and in such a case there is 소익 for seeking a declaration of invalidity. ㄴ. Even if 乙’s term of office expired while an action seeking 취소 of the 해임처분 was pending, if the dismissal is revoked and 乙 can claim 보수 for the period from the date of the dismissal disposition until the date of expiration of the term of office, 乙 has 법률상 이익 to seek revocation of the dismissal disposition. ㄷ. Under the relevant 법령 concerning the Act on Promotion of Installation of Waste Disposal Facilities and Support for Nearby Areas, etc, where residents living within 2km from the site boundary line of a waste landfill facility and within 300m from the site boundary line of a waste incineration facility are required to form a 주민지원협의체 and consult on the determination of the 주변영향지역, if 丙, a local resident within that area, files an action seeking 취소 of the 주변영향지역결정처분, 원고적격 is recognized. ㄹ. D received a 영업정지처분, and although the 정지기간 has elapsed, if the disposition criteria set in the form of 시행규칙 provide that a prior 제재적 행정처분 shall be treated as an aggravating factor and that a future 제재적 행정처분 shall be imposed, and those 시행규칙 have a statutory basis and there is a risk of receiving an aggravated 제재처분, then if an action seeking 취소 is filed against the 영업정지처분 whose 정지기간 has already elapsed, there is 법률상 이익 to seek revocation.
A: ㄱ, ㄴ
B: ㄱ, ㄹ
C: ㄴ, ㄷ
D: ㄴ, ㄹ
E: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ

label: A
question: A private individual, 甲, while serving in the military suffered a fall accident and received treatment from military physician 乙, but after being medically discharged from the military, while receiving veterans’ compensation benefits pursuant to statutes, alleged that 甲 suffered a disability due to 乙’s intentional act or gross negligence and filed a claim for damages against the Republic of Korea and 乙. During the pendency of the above proceedings, 甲 applied for a motion to refer the proviso to Article 2(1) of the State Compensation Act, which limits the right of soldiers, etc. to claim state compensation, for constitutional review. Among the following explanations, which correctly combines what is correct (○) and what is incorrect (×)? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents) ㄱ. 甲’s application for a motion to refer for constitutional review is subject to mandatory attorney representation because the party is a private person. ㄴ. The judge in charge of the damages claim lawsuit filed by 甲 must refer the provision of the State Compensation Act to the Constitutional Court for constitutional review even where the judge merely has a simple doubt as to its unconstitutionality. ㄷ. If the motion to refer for constitutional review is dismissed, 甲 cannot file an appeal or re-appeal by way of civil proceedings against the dismissal decision, and cannot file a special appeal either. ㄹ. When the motion to refer for constitutional review is dismissed and 甲 intends to file a constitutional complaint, if 甲 lacks the financial ability to nominate an attorney as representative, 甲 may apply to the Constitutional Court for the appointment of court-appointed counsel.

label: B
question: Which of the following statements concerning 탄핵심판 is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.)
A: To 인정 the interest in impeachment adjudication, it is necessary for the respondent to retain the relevant public office until the time the 탄핵결정 is pronounced.
B: Even if the respondent was lawfully impeached while holding public office at the time of the impeachment motion, if the respondent retires from that office during the pendency of the impeachment trial, this is a ground that bars the continuation of the 심판절차, and therefore a declaration of 심판절차종료 must be made in the 주문.
C: The Constitution expressly states the grounds for impeachment as ‘violation of the Constitution or laws,’ and by assigning jurisdiction over impeachment trials to the Constitutional Court, it defines the impeachment procedure not as a political adjudicative procedure but as a normative 심판절차; accordingly, it reveals that the purpose of the impeachment trial procedure is removal ‘based on legal violations rather than political reasons.’
D: A decision of 파면 under the impeachment trial procedure deprives a high-ranking public official of the executive branch or the judiciary who is the respondent of 공직, and this constitutes a 제한 on the right to hold public office.
E: Removal by the Constitutional Court’s 탄핵결정 does not amount to an unjust deprivation of 공직, provided that its 요건 and 절차 are observed, and it does not undermine the balance under the principle of 권력분립원칙.

label: A
question: Which of the following correctly combines the statements that are correct (○) and incorrect (×) regarding 선거제도 and 선거권? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.) ㄱ. The provision of the ｢공직선거법｣ that, for an elector who cannot mark the ballot due to a physical disability, allows voting assistance only when two voting assistants accompany the elector if the assistant is not a family member, sets an exception to the principle of 비밀선거, but it does not infringe 선거권 because it maintains vote secrecy by preventing, through 형사처벌, the voting assistant from violating the secrecy of the elector's vote. ㄴ. The former ｢공직선거법｣ provision that criminally punishes individually face-to-face and oral 선거운동 before the campaign period infringes the freedom of 정치적 표현. ㄷ. The ｢공직선거법｣ provision that, in a 지역구국회의원선거, determines as the elected person the one who obtains a majority of valid votes in the relevant 국회의원지역구 by adopting a 소선거구 다수대표제, excludes other 선거제도 and therefore infringes 평등권 and 선거권. ㄹ. In a local government head election, since the opportunity to attend the interview and 토론회 that each level of the 선거방송토론위원회 is required to hold must be given equally to all candidates, the ｢공직선거법｣ provision that restricts invitation eligibility infringes 평등권 in relation to the 원칙 of equal opportunity for candidates' 선거운동.

label: B
question: Which of the following statements regarding 대한민국 국적 is not correct? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례)
A: A person who becomes a 복수국적자 before reaching 20 years of age shall choose one nationality pursuant to the procedures prescribed by the ｢국적법｣ by the time he or she reaches 22 years of age, and a person who becomes a 복수국적자 after reaching 20 years of age shall choose one nationality within 2 years from that time. However, this shall not include a 복수국적자 who, pursuant to the same Act, has pledged to the 법무부장관 that he or she will not exercise a foreign nationality in the Republic of Korea.
B: A national of the Republic of Korea who acquires the spouse’s foreign nationality by marriage to an 외국인 shall, within 6 months from the time of acquiring that foreign nationality, notify the 법무부장관 that he or she does not intend to retain 대한민국 국적, and if the 법무부장관 recognizes this, he or she shall lose Korean nationality from the time of such 신고.
C: The provision of the Nationality Act stating that the Minister of Justice may 취소 the permission or determination granted to a person who has obtained permission for naturalization, 국적회복허가, permission to renounce nationality, or a determination of retention of nationality by false or other 부정한 means does not infringe the freedom of residence and movement or the right to pursue happiness insofar as it concerns revocation of 국적회복허가
D: A dual national shall choose one nationality within 3 months from the time he or she is incorporated into the military service preparatory status pursuant to Article 8 of the Military Service Act, and the ｢Nationality Act｣ provision that prohibits filing a report of loss of nationality after that period and before the military service obligation has been extinguished infringes the freedom to renounce nationality.
E: In a provision of the Nationality Act, the requirement that a person be “품행이 단정할 것” means being endowed with 품성과 행실 such that there is no impediment to accepting a naturalization applicant as a new member of the Republic of Korea, and thus does not violate the principle of 명확성원칙.

label: E
question: Which of the following statements concerning the constitutional principle of 책임주의 is not correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.)
A: A provision of the former ｢선박안전법｣ that says, where a captain employed by the shipowner commits a criminal act in relation to the shipowner’s business, the same 벌금형 shall also be imposed on the shipowner, violates the 책임주의원칙, because it imposes criminal punishment on the shipowner merely on the ground that the captain employed by the shipowner committed a 범죄행위 in relation to his duties, without at all providing for the shipowner’s 독자적인 책임 for the consequences of the act committed by the captain.
B: A provision of the ｢근로기준법｣ that, where a construction subcontractor who has not registered as a construction business fails to pay wages to workers, imposes on the immediate upper-tier contractor the obligation to pay wages jointly and severally with the subcontractor and punishes the immediate upper-tier contractor if it fails to perform that obligation, cannot be regarded as violating the principle of self-responsibility.
C: A provision of the former Act on Contracts to Which the State Is a Party that requires the head of each central administrative agency to restrict the qualification for participation in bidding, within the extent prescribed by Presidential Decree and not exceeding 2 years, for a person etc. who is likely to undermine the fair execution of competition or the proper performance of a contract does not violate the principle of self-responsibility, because it enables the disqualified contractor to escape the sanction disposition by proving, among other things, that the act serving as the cause of the sanction disposition cannot be attributed to him or her
D: A provision of the National Health Insurance Act that allows the National Health Insurance Service to collect all or part of an amount equivalent to the benefit costs from a medical care institution that has received insurance benefit costs by 사위 기타 부당한 방법 does not run counter to the 책임주의 원칙, because even if the medical care institution has fulfilled its duty of care to 관리 · 감독 its employees, the insurance benefit costs have once 귀속되었고 to that institution, and once that medical care institution has received insurance benefit costs by 사위 기타 부당한 방법, it has an obligation to return 부당이득
E: A provision of the Act on the Management of Mountainous Districts that directly punishes a corporation, together with employees, etc., for certain criminal acts committed by employees, etc. employed by the corporation cannot readily be regarded as violating the principle of responsibility because it punishes the corporation’s negligence in failing to fulfill its own 지휘·감독의무

label: B
question: Which of the following statements concerning the principle prohibiting 소급입법 is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.)
A: A provision of the former ｢수도권 대기환경개선에 관한 특별법｣ requires an owner who is operating a specific diesel vehicle equipped with an emission reduction device to return the device when, after the amendment of the provision, a separate factual requirement of ‘폐차나 수출 등을 위한 자동차등록의 말소’ is satisfied, and this constitutes non-genuine retroactive legislation.
B: A provision of the ｢상가건물 임대차보호법｣ that extended the period for a commercial building tenant to exercise the 계약갱신요구권 from 5 years to 10 years, and a supplementary provision of the same Act that provides this amended provision applies to leases renewed after the enforcement of the amended Act even if the lease was concluded before that enforcement, constitute 진정소급입법 and violate the 소급입법금지원칙.
C: A supplementary provision of the former Government Employees Pension Act, except in cases of ‘과실로 인한 경우’ that are unrelated to official duties and ‘소속상관의 정당한 직무상의 명령에 따르다가 과실로 인한 경우’, provides that if a public official, during service, is sentenced to imprisonment without labor or heavier punishment for a cause arising during service, retirement benefits, etc. shall be reduced, and that the amended provision applies from the following year, does not constitute 진정소급입법.
D: Among the ordinances of the United States Army Military Government in Korea promulgated on 1945. 9. 25. and 1945. 12. 6., 각각 the provision that rendered wholly void all transactions concluded with respect to property owned by Japanese nationals after 1945. 8. 9., and the provision that caused the property subject thereto to belong wholly to the United States Army Military Government in Korea retroactively as of 1945. 9. 25., both fall within 소급입법금지원칙에 대한 예외 and thus do not violate the Constitution.
E: The supplementary provision of the Criminal Act, which applies retroactively to the detriment of a person sentenced to a fine of at least 100 million won by making the lower limit of the term of detention in a workhouse more severe, from the first indictment filed after the effective date, violates the principle of 형벌불소급원칙.

label: C
question: Which of the following cases should all be contested as a party suit under the Administrative Litigation Act? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) ㄱ. A person who applied for the payment of compensation under the Act on the Restoration of Honor and Compensation for Persons Related to the Democratization Movement disputes the Deliberation Committee’s decision on compensation payment ㄴ. Under the former Fire Service Officers Act, a local fire official claims against the local government to which he or she belongs the payment of overtime allowance whose existence and scope are directly determined by the provisions of statutes and regulations ㄷ. A member of an association who seeks to dispute the validity of an association general meeting resolution on a proposed management and disposition plan under the Act on the Maintenance and Improvement of Urban Areas and Dwelling Conditions for Residents files a lawsuit against a housing reconstruction and improvement project association before approval of the management and disposition plan ㄹ. A business operator liable for value-added tax claims against the State the payment of the amount of value-added tax refund ㅁ. On the premise that a tax assessment disposition is null and void ab initio, a claim is made for the return of taxes already paid
A: ㄱ, ㄴ
B: ㄷ, ㄹ
C: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ
D: ㄴ, ㄹ, ㅁ
E: ㄷ, ㄹ, ㅁ

label: D
question: Which of the following statements concerning 행정대집행 and 이행강제금 are correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.) ㄱ. Where a 법률 recognizes 대집행 and 이행강제금 as means of enforcement, the 행정청 may use 대집행 and 이행강제금 selectively, and so long as it chooses and uses them through 합리적인 재량, it cannot be regarded as constituting 중첩적인 제재. ㄴ. Under the ｢건축법｣, the 허가권자 shall set a 상당한 이행기한 necessary for compliance with the 시정명령 for a 건축주등 who has failed to comply with the 시정명령 within the 시정기간, and if the 시정명령 is not complied with by that deadline, it shall impose an 이행강제금. ㄷ. An 행정청 may repeatedly impose an 이행강제금 until the 의무자 performs the 행정상 의무, but once the 의무자 performs the 의무, it must immediately cease imposing new 이행강제금, and it cannot collect any already imposed 이행강제금. ㄹ. Under the ｢공익사업을 위한 토지 등의 취득 및 보상에 관한 법률｣, the obligation of a 토지소유자 to deliver the land to the 사업시행자 by the commencement date of 수용 or 사용 is not subject to 대집행 under the ｢행정대집행법｣.
A: ㄱ, ㄴ
B: ㄱ, ㄷ
C: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ
D: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ
E: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ

label: D
question: Which of the following correctly combines the statements that are true (○) and those that are false (×) regarding administrative subjects and administrative agencies in administrative-law relations? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents) ㄱ. Under ｢도시 및 주거환경정비법｣, a housing reconstruction and maintenance project association, if it becomes established as a corporation by registration after obtaining authorization for establishment from the competent 행정청, has the status of an administrative subject that, within the scope of implementing the housing reconstruction project, performs certain 행정작용 in accordance with 법령. ㄴ. Seoul Housing and Communities Corporation, as a public corporation established by Seoul Metropolitan City through a 100% capital contribution pursuant to ｢지방공기업법｣, may be regarded as an administrative agency to which Seoul Metropolitan City has delegated the authority to carry out Seoul Metropolitan City's 개발사업 through its act of establishment and related acts. ㄷ. The granting or revocation of a trainer's or jockey's license by the Korea Racing Authority is the exercise of authority as an administrative agency entrusted by the State or another 행정기관. ㄹ. A local association of judicial scriveners is a 공법인 whose establishment and membership in the judicial scrivener association are compulsory by law in order to perform supervisory affairs for judicial scriveners, and insofar as it concerns approval for hiring a judicial scrivener's clerk, it should be regarded as the subject of 공권력 행사. ㅁ. Korea Land Corporation is a person empowered to carry out substitute execution by virtue of the entrustment under the Act on the Acquisition of and Compensation for Land, etc. for Public Works Projects, the former Korea Land Corporation Act, and the Enforcement Decree of that Act, and it should be regarded as having the status of an administrative subject to whom the rights, duties, and liabilities arising from carrying out substitute execution by public officials accrue, rather than as a public official under Article 2 of the State Compensation Act as an organ of a local government, etc.

label: A
question: Which of the following statements concerning ｢행정소송법｣상 집행정지 are all incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.) ㄱ. Even if a 본안소송인 취소소송 has been filed, and even if it is dismissed because the 행위 that is the subject matter of the suit is not a 처분, a 집행정지 is permitted in light of the purpose of the 집행정지 제도 based on 긴급한 필요, etc. ㄴ. Among the requirements for 집행정지, the burden of 주장 and 소명 with respect to the possibility of seriously affecting 공공복리 lies with the 신청인 for the 집행정지결정. ㄷ. Unless there are 특별한 사정, the ground for revoking a 집행정지결정 must have arisen after the 집행정지결정 became 확정. ㄹ. If it has been confirmed by a 본안 확정판결 that the 제재처분 is 적법, then it should not result in the 상대방 of the 제재처분 being subjected to less 제재 than in the case where 집행정지가 not effected through 잠정적 집행정지.
A: ㄱ, ㄴ
B: ㄱ, ㄷ
C: ㄴ, ㄷ
D: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ
E: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ

label: C
question: Which of the following statements concerning ｢국회법｣ is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.)
A: When seeking the consent of the National Assembly in order to arrest or detain a member of the National Assembly, the judge of the competent court shall, before issuing the warrant, submit the request for arrest consent to the Government, and the Government, after receiving it, shall without delay attach a copy thereof and request the National Assembly to consent to the arrest.
B: A member of the National Assembly may be a member of two or more 상임위원회, and each 교섭단체 대표의원 shall become a member of the National Assembly Steering Committee. Provided, however, that the Speaker of the National Assembly may not be a member of a 상임위원회.
C: A standing committee member of the National Assembly shall not engage in profit-making activities related to the duties of the 소관 상임위원회 under his or her jurisdiction. Provided, however, that this shall not apply where, after 심사 by the 국회 윤리심사자문위원회, permission has been granted by the 윤리심사자문위원회 위원장.
D: Since the proviso to Article 50(1) of the Constitution, which provides that the meetings of the National Assembly may not be 공개 when a majority of the members present agree or when the Speaker deems it necessary for the security of the State, also applies to the National Assembly subcommittees, the provision of the National Assembly Act that allows a subcommittee meeting to be closed by resolution of the National Assembly subcommittee cannot be said to be an unconstitutional provision violating the principle against excessive restriction.
E: When a member of the National Assembly introduces a motion demanding the release of a member who has been 체포 or 구금된, a request with the reasons thereto, jointly signed by at least one-fourth of the total number of members of the National Assembly, shall be submitted to the Speaker of the National Assembly.

label: A
question: Which of the following statements concerning ｢국가배상법｣ Article 5 is not correct? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.)
A: The term ‘공공의 영조물’ means tangible objects or material facilities devoted by the State or a local government to a specific public purpose, and it includes cases where the State or a local government manages them based on ownership, leasehold rights, or other authority, but it does not include cases where they are actually managed.
B: The term ‘영조물의 설치 또는 관리의 하자’ means that a public structure devoted to a public purpose is in a state that does not possess the safety it ordinarily should have according to its intended use.
C: The term ‘ defect in the installation or management of a public structure ’ also includes cases where, in the use of a public structure for a public purpose, the 이용상태 and degree of use exceed a certain 한도 and thereby cause damage to a third party beyond the limit that is expected to be 수인할 under 사회통념.
D: If, after the installation of a road, a defect arises in its safety for passage, which is its original purpose, due to the conduct of a third party, the mere fact that the road has such a defect should not be used hastily to recognize a defect in the preservation of the road, and the existence or absence of a defect should be determined by individually and concretely examining whether, despite the possibility of removing such a defect and restoring it to its original condition by comprehensively considering all circumstances such as the road’s structure, 장소적 환경, and 이용상황, it was left unattended.
E: Flooding of a river caused by rainfall with a 600-year or 1,000-year recurrence interval, exceeding the design flood level established on the basis of rainfall with a 100-year recurrence interval, is an 불가항력적인 disaster lacking foreseeability and 회피가능성, and liability cannot be imposed on the 관리청 of the public structure.

label: A
question: Which of the following statements about the following case are not correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) 甲 startup enterprise, pursuant to the ｢중소기업창업 지원법｣, seeks to apply to A시장 for approval of its factory establishment plan. Article 47 of the same Act provides that, when A시장 approves the factory establishment plan, as to a river occupancy permit under ｢하천법｣ Article 33, matters on which A시장 has consulted with the river occupancy permit authority shall be deemed to have obtained the permit. ㄱ. In order for 甲 to be deemed to have been granted a river occupancy permit, when applying for the above approval of the factory establishment plan, 甲 must submit the documents necessary for the river occupancy permit by the deadline separately prescribed by the river occupancy permit authority. ㄴ. As to the matters on which consultation has been reached between A시장 and the river occupancy permit authority, it is deemed that the river occupancy permit was granted at the time the consultation was concluded. ㄷ. The river occupancy permit authority, when requested to consult by A시장, shall not respond to the consultation in violation of the River Act and its subordinate statutes, and with respect to procedures such as deliberation and hearing of opinions necessary for a river occupancy permit, such procedures are followed only where there is an express statutory provision that those procedures are also to be followed in cases of deemed authorization or permission. ㄹ. If a river occupancy permit is deemed to have been granted, the river occupancy permit authority shall take necessary measures, including management and supervision, under the relevant statutes, as if it had directly granted the river occupancy permit.
A: ㄱ, ㄴ
B: ㄱ, ㄷ
C: ㄱ, ㄹ
D: ㄴ, ㄷ
E: ㄷ, ㄹ

label: C
question: Which of the following statements concerning administrative planning is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)
A: If an administrative entity, in formulating and deciding an administrative plan, omits a matter that ought properly to have been included among the considerations in balancing interests, then 그 행정계획결정은 an abuse or excess of discretion이다.
B: Under the former ｢도시계획법｣, a resident who owns land etc. within an urban planning area has a statutory or 조리상 right to request that the plan-drafting authority make an urban plan 입안.
C: Under the ｢산업입지 및 개발에 관한 법률｣, a person who, as the landowner of land within an industrial complex under an 산업단지개발계획, intends to install facilities conforming to the 산업단지개발계획 and move in, has no 법규상 또는 조리상 right to request the 산업단지지정권자 to amend the 산업단지개발계획.
D: A management disposition plan that a housing reconstruction improvement project association establishes pursuant to the ｢도시 및 주거환경정비법｣ constitutes a binding administrative plan, 즉 구속적 행정계획이다.
E: Under the former ｢국토이용관리법｣, where refusing a 국토이용계획변경신청 made by a person in a 법률상 지위 to file, within a certain future period, an application for a certain 행정처분 by equipping the 시설 etc. prescribed by the relevant statutes, practically results in a refusal of the 행정처분 itself, the 신청인 is recognized as having the right to apply for a change in the 국토이용계획.

label: B
question: Which of the following statements concerning the case are correct? If there is a dispute, follow the 판례. The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport approved a 사업인정 under the Act on the Acquisition of and Compensation for Land, etc. for Public Works Projects, hereinafter the 토지보상법, for a project to develop sports facilities within an urban park using as the site a large tract of land owned by 甲 located within the jurisdiction of A Metropolitan City, which A Metropolitan City was promoting, and since consultation with 甲 did not reach agreement, A Metropolitan City, as the project implementer, went through a 수용재결 by the Central Land Expropriation Committee. ㄱ. Even if there is a defect amounting to a 취소사유 in the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport’s 사업인정 under the 토지보상법, 甲 cannot file an administrative lawsuit seeking revocation of the 수용재결 on the ground that the 사업인정 was unlawful and the 제소기간 has expired. ㄴ. 甲 may file an 이의신청 with the Central Land Expropriation Committee within 30 days from the date on which 甲 received the authenticated copy of the 수용재결서, and when the Central Land Expropriation Committee finds that the 수용재결 is unlawful or improper, it may cancel all or part of it or order A Metropolitan City to change the 보상액. ㄷ. If 甲 has gone through the 이의신청 procedure but wishes to challenge again, 甲 may file an administrative lawsuit against the Central Land Expropriation Committee’s 이의재결 within 90 days from the date on which 甲 received the written decision. ㄹ. If 甲 files an administrative lawsuit against the 수용재결 without going through the 이의신청 procedure, 甲 must file the lawsuit within 60 days from the date on which 甲 received the authenticated copy of the 재결서. ㅁ. In an administrative lawsuit concerning increase or decrease of compensation money, when the person filing the lawsuit is 甲, A Metropolitan City shall be the defendant, and when the person filing the lawsuit is A Metropolitan City, 甲 shall be the defendant.
A: ㄱ, ㄴ
B: ㄱ, ㅁ
C: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ
D: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅁ
E: ㄴ, ㄹ, ㅁ

label: E
question: Which of the following statements is correct based on the facts below? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) ◦ 甲, as a person operating a lodging business under the ｢공중위생관리법｣, received on 2022. 1. 5. from 乙, the competent gu-chongjang, a disposition suspending business for 3 months hereinafter referred to as ‘the disposition at issue’ and filed a lawsuit seeking revocation of the disposition hereinafter referred to as ‘the action at issue’. ◦ The action at issue was closed for oral argument in the appellate instance on 2023. 12. 7. ◦ A reason: 甲 arranged prostitution for lodgers the original ground for the disposition dated 2022. 1. 5. ◦ B reason: 甲 arranged obscene acts for lodgers. ◦ The A reason and the B reason concern matters that occurred at the time of the disposition at issue and have the same basic factual relation.
A: Since the time for determining whether the disposition at issue is unlawful is 처분시, the court may determine the 위법 여부 of this case disposition only on the basis of materials that the administrative agency knew at the time of the disposition, and, unlike this, may not synthesize all materials submitted up to the close of fact-finding proceedings, 즉 사실심 변론종결시까지 제출된 모든 자료, to identify the 객관적 사실 that existed at the time of the disposition and determine the 위법 여부 of the disposition on the basis of those facts.
B: Even after 2023. 12. 7., so long as it is before the 판결선고, B may change the ground for the 이 사건 처분 from the A 사유 to the B 사유.
C: Even if B changes only the statutory basis for the disposition without changing the A reason that 乙 stated at the time of this 사건 처분, this should be regarded as a change of 처분사유, and the same applies even where changing the 근거 법령 for the disposition is tantamount to making a 별개의 처분.
D: Whether 甲 has standing as plaintiff is determined as of the close of oral argument in the fact-finding instance, so if, as of 2023. 12. 7., 甲 was recognized as having 원고적격, then even if 甲 later lost the 법률상 이익 to seek 취소 of the disposition at issue in the final appeal proceedings, the action does not become 부적법한 소. If 甲 was recognized as having 법률상 이익 at the close of oral argument in the fact-finding instance, then even if that 법률상 이익 does not survive in the final appeal proceedings, the action does not become 부적법한 소.
E: Although the disposition at issue was revoked by the court’s final and conclusive judgment because A 사유 was not recognized, making a disposition with the same content on the basis of B 사유 by 乙 conflicts with the binding force of that final and conclusive judgment.

label: C
question: Which of the following statements concerning the case below are correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) A광역시 Council adopted a proposed amendment to the ｢A광역시 행정재산 관리 운영 조례｣ that allows tenants who have been granted a use permit for 행정재산 owned by A광역시 to transfer, be transferred, or sublease that administrative property pursuant to ｢공유재산 및 물품 관리법｣, hereinafter referred to as the “공유재산법”. The Minister of the Interior and Safety instructed the Mayor of A광역시 to request reconsideration on the ground that the above amendment violates the 공유재산법. ㄱ. Under the 공유재산법, a person who has been granted a use permit for 행정재산 shall not allow another person to use or profit from that 행정재산, so the above amendment, which permits tenants to transfer, be transferred, or sublease the 행정재산 for which they have received a use permit, violates higher-ranking law. ㄴ. A resident of A광역시 may lawfully bring a lawsuit against the Mayor of A광역시 seeking a declaration of invalidity of the ordinance bill resolution. ㄷ. If the Mayor of A광역시 fails to comply with the Minister of the Interior and Safety’s instruction to request reconsideration, the Minister of the Interior and Safety may bring an action in the Supreme Court against the A광역시 Council seeking a declaration of invalidity of the ordinance bill resolution. ㄹ. If the Mayor of A광역시 requests reconsideration from the A광역시 Council, but the A광역시 Council re-adopts the bill in its original form, even if part of the above amendment violates the 공유재산법 and its effect is therefore not recognized, the entire effect of the resolution on the reconsidered amendment is not denied.
A: ㄴ
B: ㄱ, ㄴ
C: ㄱ, ㄷ
D: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ
E: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㄹ

label: E
question: Which of the following correctly combines the statements about defective administrative acts that are correct (○) and incorrect (×)? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) ㄱ. Even if the administrative agency that issued the administrative act had no particular defect at the time of issuance, and even if there is no separate legal basis under the individual statute for withdrawal, if there is a significant public interest necessity after issuance, it may, after balancing public and private interests, withdraw the administrative act prospectively. ㄴ. As a matter of principle, an administrative agency may cancel all or part of a defective administrative act retroactively, but if there is justifiable reason, such as where the party’s reliance deserves protection, it may cancel it prospectively. ㄷ. If the defect in the beneficial administrative disposition to be canceled is attributable to the party’s application act by concealment of facts or other fraudulent means, the party cannot invoke the reliance interest regarding the disposition, but if the administrative agency fails to consider this, it constitutes a deviation from or abuse of discretionary power. ㄹ. Curing a defect in an administrative act is, in principle, not permitted from the standpoint of the nature of the administrative act or the rule of law, but exceptionally, in order to avoid needless repetition of administrative acts and for the legal stability of the parties, not only substantive defects but also procedural defects may be cured.

label: B
question: Which of the following statements concerning 정보공개 under the Act on the Disclosure of Information by Public Agencies, hereinafter referred to as the “Information Disclosure Act,” is not correct? If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.
A: Even taking into account that state funding for private universities is limited, temporary, and localized, it cannot be said that 정보공개법 시행령에서 사립대학교를 정보공개의무를 지는 public institution 하나로 listed as one of the 공공기관 subject to the duty of disclosure is contrary to the constitutional principle of guaranteeing university autonomy or exceeds the scope of delegation under the parent Act, namely the 정보공개법.
B: In a lawsuit seeking revocation of a disposition refusing disclosure of information, if a public institution submits the requested information as evidence etc. to the court and causes a copy to be delivered or served on the requester through the court, so that the information is ultimately disclosed to the requester, this may be regarded as disclosure under the Information Disclosure Act.
C: A third party who has been notified that information disclosure 관련 사실 has been requested about him or her may, within 3 days from the date of receipt of that notice, request the relevant public institution not to disclose it, and even if such nondisclosure request has been made, when the public institution makes a disclosure decision, it must, without delay, notify in writing by clearly stating the reasons for the disclosure decision and the date of disclosure 실시일.
D: Since a requester has a 법령상 신청권 to apply for disclosure by designating a specific 공개방법, if a public institution decides to disclose by a method other than the method applied for by the requester, this constitutes a 일부 거부처분 with respect to the part concerning the 정보공개방법 among the 정보공개 청구, and the requester may challenge it by an 항고소송.
E: If a person who has requested 정보공개 and received notice of the decision on whether to disclose the information again requests disclosure of the relevant information without 정당한 사유, the 공공기관 that received the 정보공개 청구 may close the request after comprehensively considering the nature of the information subject to the disclosure request, the substantive similarity and 관련성 to the prior request, and the circumstances making it unavoidable to give the same response as to the prior request, and must inform the requester of the fact that the request has been 종결 처리.

label: B
question: Which of the following statements concerning the effects arising from a change in an administrative disposition are correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents..) ㄱ. If a business change permit is granted in a way that substantially changes the essential part of a 집단에너지사업허가, the original 집단에너지사업허가 loses its effect unless there are special circumstances. ㄴ. Where the prior disposition remains in force within the scope not changed by the subsequent disposition, and the subsequent disposition has effect within the scope that changes part of the content of the prior disposition, a revocation of the subsequent disposition may be sought on the ground of a 취소사유 existing only in the prior disposition. ㄷ. If there is a 경정처분 that increases the 과세표준 and 세액 of the original 조세부과처분, the original disposition is absorbed into the 경정처분 and thus loses its independent existence value. ㄹ. Where, after an original 과징금 부과처분, a disposition is made reducing the amount of the administrative penalty, the 감액처분 is not an independent 과징금 부과처분 separate from the original disposition, but in substance is merely a disposition that brings about the favorable result of partial 취소 of the original 과징금, and therefore is not the subject of an independent 항고소송. ㅁ. Where a 영업정지처분 is changed in a way favorable to the business operator, the original 영업정지처분 is absorbed into the changed disposition and loses its independent existence value.
A: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ
B: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㄹ
C: ㄱ, ㄹ, ㅁ
D: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ
E: ㄴ, ㄹ, ㅁ

label: D
question: Which of the following statements concerning 행정입법 is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.)
A: Where the legislature, with respect to matters delegated by statute, sets out the general outline and then 다시 within that scope delegates specific matters to subordinate statutes, subdelegation is permitted.
B: When an official notice has general and 추상적 character, it will fall under a statutory rule or 행정규칙; however, when it has the character of directly 규율ing, by itself and without mediation of any other 집행행위, the specific rights and duties of the 국민 or legal relations, it falls under an 행정처분.
C: Without legislative delegation, it is contrary to the principle of 조세법률주의 to provide, by 행정입법 such as orders or rules, matters concerning 과세요건, or to establish 해석규정 that analogize or expand the contents prescribed by law.
D: Examining the meaning of Article 40 and Articles 75 and 95 of the Constitution, even if authorization by National Assembly legislation delegates to an administrative agency and sets a specific scope by statute or otherwise, the relevant 행정기관 does not have independent authority to create law, so the form of delegated legislation recognized by the Constitution should be regarded as limited.
E: The Act on the Acquisition of and Compensation for Land, etc. for Public Works Projects는 협의취득의 compensation amount calculation에 관한 구체적 standards를 Enforcement Rule에 위임하고, 그 delegation 범위 내에서 해당 Enforcement Rule은, where there are buildings, etc. on the land, the land shall be appraised on the assumption that there are no buildings, etc.라고 규정하며, such Enforcement Rule은 위 Act의 provisions와 결합하여 external binding force를 가진다

label: C
question: Which of the following statements concerning constitutional complaints and administrative litigation is 옳지 않은 것? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례에 의함)
A: Even if an administrative rule, as a 준칙 for the exercise of discretionary power, is repeatedly implemented according to its terms and thereby forms an administrative 관행, the 행정기관, in its relationship with the other party, becomes subject to 자기구속 to follow that rule, and accordingly such an administrative rule constitutes the exercise of 공권력 with 대외적 구속력 and is subject to a 헌법소원.
B: In a detention review case, when the suspect’s defense counsel applied for inspection and copying of the complaint and the suspect interrogation record among the investigative records, and the chief of the police station made an information non-disclosure decision, if the counsel filed a constitutional complaint without bringing administrative litigation and sought a ruling that the said non-disclosure decision is unconstitutional, the subsidiarity principle, which is a filing requirement for a constitutional complaint, is satisfied.
C: Since 행정입법부작위 may be challenged by an action to confirm illegality of omission under the Administrative Litigation Act, a petition for constitutional adjudication concerning 행정입법부작위 is an unlawful petition that violates the principle of 보충성.
D: Since a Veterans Affairs Office chief’s decision that a person is not 해당 to 국가유공자 constitutes a disposition, there are relief procedures of administrative appeal and administrative litigation against it, and if a constitutional complaint review is filed without going through those procedures, the petition is unlawful as it was filed without exhausting all relief procedures under other statutes.
E: If a person filed an administrative litigation seeking revocation of a tax assessment disposition and then withdrew the action or the withdrawal was deemed to have occurred, a petition for constitutional adjudication seeking revocation of the tax assessment disposition cannot be regarded as having gone through 적법한 구제절차 under other statutes and is therefore 부적법하다.

label: B
question: Which of the following statements concerning 행정행위의 부관 are incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.) ㄱ. Even where, due to 사정변경, the purpose of the relevant 행정처분 cannot be achieved unless a new 부관 is attached or the existing 부관 is modified, if there is no 동의 of the party concerned, attaching a new 부관 or modifying the existing 부관 is not permitted. ㄴ. If a 부담 is lawful based on the 법령 in force at the time of the 처분, then even if, after the 처분, the 법령 that served as the basis for the main 행정처분 underlying the 부담 is amended so that the 행정청 can no longer attach 부관, it does not immediately become 위법 or lose its 효력. ㄷ. Among the contents of a 부관, the part concerning a 부제소특약 stating that no 행정소송 will be filed thereafter is permitted under the principle of 계약자유. ㄹ. If a 부관 that is a 부담 attached to an 행정처분 is 무효, and the person who received the 처분 performs a 사법상 법률행위 such as a 매매 in performance of the 부담, then absent special circumstances, the 부담 merely functioned as the 동기 for causing the 법률행위; therefore, apart from whether it can serve as a 취소사유 for the 법률행위, it does not naturally render the 법률행위 itself 무효. ㅁ. If a 부담 becomes 확정 due to the 도과 of the 제소기간 and acquires 불가쟁력, the validity of a 사법상 법률행위 such as a 매매 performed as performance of that 부담 also cannot be 다툴 수 없다.
A: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ
B: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅁ
C: ㄱ, ㄹ, ㅁ
D: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ
E: ㄷ, ㄹ, ㅁ

label: A
question: Which of the following explanations concerning 법치행정 under the rule of law is not correct? (If there is a dispute, 판례에 의함.)
A: Where a statute delegates matters of 자치법적 사항 to the articles of association of a 공법적 단체, the constitutional prohibition of 포괄적인 위임입법 under Article 75 of the Constitution applies in principle, and even where delegation is made, if the matter relates to the 국민의 권리 · 의무, at least the 기본적이고 본질적인 사항 concerning the rights and duties of the people must be determined by the 국회.
B: The modern principle of legal reservation is understood as embodying not only the requirement that administrative action merely have a 법률상 근거, but also the requirement that, in areas of fundamental and 중요한 significance to the national community and its members, the 입법자, as the 국민의 representative, must itself decide the 본질적 사항.
C: A notice of exclusion from lawful union status is a grave 침익적 disposition that deprives a duly established 노동조합 of its legal status, and as a matter that in principle must be prescribed by the legislator, the 국민의 representative, in a formal statute, it should be 규정되어야 하며, to prescribe it by administrative legislation, there must necessarily be an 명시적 and 구체적 delegation by statute.
D: Where, as with 법인세 and comprehensive income tax, the taxpayer is imposed not only the duty to pay tax but also the duty to calculate and report the 과세표준 and 세액 on its own, the 기본적인 사항 necessary to fulfill the 신고의무, and the 불이익 the taxpayer will suffer in the event of non-performance of the 신고의무, as the 기본적 and 본질적 content constituting the tax liability, must be prescribed by 법률.
E: Cadets of the Army 3rd Military Academy may have their fundamental rights 제한 more than ordinary citizens, but even in such a case, the constitutional principles governing restrictions on fundamental rights, such as 법률유보원칙 and 과잉금지원칙, must be observed.

label: C
question: Which of the following statements concerning minors are correct? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.) ㄱ. When the court appoints a special representative as the legal representative of a minor pursuant to 「민법」 Article 921, it is, as a rule, for the court to specify the content of the juristic act to be handled by that special representative and state it in the 심판 주문. ㄴ. Where a legal representative has permitted a minor to engage in a specific 영업, the legal representative may not revoke that permission. ㄷ. If, at the time of the juristic act, a minor merely told the other party that he or she was an adult and did not actively use 속임수, the minor may rescind that juristic act. ㄹ. Where a minor's guardian is appointed as the legal representative of a minor, multiple minors의 후견인을 appoint for the minor's 이익. ㅁ. Where a minor is subjected to 성폭력, the statute of limitations for a damages claim arising therefrom does not run until the minor attains 성년.
A: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㅁ
B: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㄹ
C: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅁ
D: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ
E: ㄴ, ㄹ, ㅁ

label: E
question: A loan금 claim of KRW 50,000,000 that 甲 has against 乙 has become extinct by the 소멸시효. Which of the following 설명 is not correct? (Each 지문 is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the 판례.)
A: If B, without knowing that the statute of limitations had been completed, paid A KRW 50,000,000 as 변제 of the above debt, B cannot demand its 반환 from A.
B: 丙이 甲의 乙에 대한 위 채권을 담보하기 위해 소멸시효 완성 전에 자기 소유의 X 토지에 저당권을 설정해 준 경우, 丙은 위 채권의 소멸시효 완성을 주장할 수 있다.
C: B's general creditor C may, to the extent necessary to preserve his own claim, exercise subrogation in B's stead and 주장할 수 있다 the completion of the statute of limitations for the above claim of A against B.
D: If 甲's above claim against 乙 could already have been 상계 against 乙's claim against 甲 before the 소멸시효 on that above claim had been 완성, 甲 may 상계 乙's claim with the above claim.
E: If 甲 filed an action against 乙 for performance of the debt after the completion of the statute of limitations, but 乙 did not assert by the time the fact-finding proceedings were closed that the 소멸시효 had been completed, the court shall consider the completion of the 소멸시효 ex officio.

label: B
question:
甲 entrusted 乙 with the authority to sell 甲’s own X 토지 at an appropriate price and also granted 乙 대리권 with respect thereto. Among the following explanations, which are correct? Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the 판례.

ㄱ. If 丁, knowing that 乙 as 甲’s 대리인 had concluded a 매매계약 with 丙 concerning X 토지 and had received the 중도금, actively requested 乙 to sell, and 乙 then, as 甲’s 대리인, sold X 토지 again to 丁 and even completed 소유권이전등기, the 매매계약 between 甲 and 丁 is 무효, even if 甲 was unaware of these facts.
ㄴ. If 乙, as 甲’s 대리인, while concluding a 매매계약 with 丙 concerning X 토지, committed 위법한 강박 against 丙, 丙 may 취소 the 매매계약 with 甲 only if 甲 knew or could have known of these facts.
ㄷ. If 乙, as 甲’s 대리인, concluded a 매매계약 with 丙 concerning X 토지, and 丙 failed to pay the 잔금 on the agreed date, then if 乙 gave 丙 이행의 최고 by setting a 상당한 기간 and 丙 still failed to pay the 잔금 within that period, 乙 may 해제 the above 매매계약.
ㄹ. If 乙, as 甲’s 대리인, concluded a contract designating himself as the 매수인 of X 토지 without 甲’s 허락, the contract is 무효, absent special circumstances.
A: ㄱ, ㄷ
B: ㄱ, ㄹ
C: ㄴ, ㄷ
D: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ
E: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ

label: E
question: Which of the following statements concerning the 「민법」상 법인의 기관 under the Civil Act is correct? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.)
A: Even if an 이사가 has expressed an intention to 사임, if the 법인 does not give 승낙, the 효력 of the resignation does not arise.
B: If there is a request by an interested person or the prosecutor concerning a matter in which the interests of the juristic person and the director are 상반되는, the court shall appoint an 임시이사.
C: Since an auditor is a necessary standing organ, 감사의 성명과 주소 are mandatory matters in the articles of incorporation, 즉 정관의 필요적 기재 사항이다.
D: An acting officer may, with permission from the competent authority, perform 행위 that do not fall within the 법인의 통상사무.
E: Even if the juridical person has prescribed in the articles of incorporation the grounds and procedures for dismissing a director, and the grounds for dismissal have in fact occurred, and even if the trust relationship between the juridical person and the director has not yet reached the point where it is no longer easy to maintain, the juridical person may dismiss the director in accordance with the procedures prescribed in the articles of incorporation.

label: D
question:
Party A entrusted A with the task of providing 甲’s X land as collateral and procuring a loan of KRW 200,000,000, and also conferred agency authority in relation thereto. A, after receiving from 甲 an identification card, a seal stamp, etc., and forging documents, entered into a sales contract with 乙 to sell X land to 乙 for KRW 300,000,000, claiming to be 甲’s agent. Which of the following correctly combines the statements that are correct (○) and incorrect (X) with respect to this matter? (Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)

ㄱ. If 乙, who did not know that A lacked authority of representation at the time of concluding the contract, expressed to 甲 the intention to withdraw from the contract before 甲’s ratification, the sales contract becomes definitively void, and 甲 cannot ratify A’s unauthorized act.
ㄴ. If 甲 expresses to 乙 an intention to ratify while changing the purchase price to KRW 400,000,000, the contract between 甲 and 乙 is, in the absence of special circumstances, valid as a contract with a purchase price of KRW 400,000,000.
ㄷ. If there are reasonable grounds for 乙 to believe that A had authority of representation, 甲 is liable to 乙 for performance of the contract. In determining whether such reasonable grounds exist, not only the circumstances at the time of the act of representation but also subsequent circumstances shall be comprehensively considered.
ㄹ. If A bears the liability of an unauthorized agent under Article 135(1) of the Civil Act, A is liable to 乙, at 乙’s option, either to perform the contract or to compensate for damages.

label: B
question:
A contract of sale with a 소유권유보 agreement concerning chattel X owned by Seller A and Buyer B was concluded, and pursuant thereto A delivered the chattel X to B. Which of the following statements concerning this is correct? Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the precedents

ㄱ. If B pays the full purchase price to A, ownership of the chattel X is transferred to B immediately without any separate 의사표시
ㄴ. If, while one-half of the purchase price has been paid, the chattel X is 부합 into the Y building owned by Principal C by B, the 수급인, and if C was unaware, without 과실, of the fact of the 소유권유보 agreement between A and B, then A cannot make a 보상청구 against C
ㄷ. If, while one-half of the purchase price has been paid, B disposes of the chattel X to D, who knows of this fact, and thereafter A learns of B’s 무단 처분 and 추인 of the act of disposition, then D acquires ownership of the chattel X from the time A ratifies it
A: ㄱ
B: ㄱ, ㄴ
C: ㄱ, ㄷ
D: ㄴ, ㄷ
E: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ

label: D
question:
On 2023. 4. 1., 甲 entered into a sales contract with 乙 concerning land X owned by 甲. Under this contract, 甲 and 乙 agreed that, on 2023. 8. 31., they would perform delivery of X 토지 and the procedure for 소유권이전등기 in exchange for payment of the full 매매대금. Which of the following statements concerning this are incorrect? (Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)

ㄱ. If 乙 paid the 매매대금 to 甲 on 2023. 8. 31., but the sales contract between 甲 and 乙 is 무효, then, absent special circumstances, the 소멸시효 for 乙's claim against 甲 for restitution of unjust enrichment equivalent to the 매매대금 runs from the time 乙 paid the 매매대금.
ㄴ. Even if 乙 had not paid the 매매대금 by 2023. 8. 31., as long as the 동시이행의 항변권 is recognized against 甲, the 소멸시효 on 甲's claim against 乙 for the 매매대금 does not run.
ㄷ. If 甲 delivered X 토지 to 乙 and completed the 소유권이전등기 on 2023. 8. 31., but 乙 did not pay the 매매대금, and thereafter 甲 applied for a 가압류 of 乙's claim against 丙 in order to secure 甲's claim for the 매매대금 of X 토지, and the order was served on 丙 on 2023. 10. 1. but 乙 was not notified of the 가압류, the 소멸시효 on 甲's claim against 乙 for the 매매대금 is not interrupted.
ㄹ. If 甲 delivered X 토지 to 乙 and completed the 소유권이전등기 on 2023. 8. 31., but 乙 did not pay the 매매대금, and thereafter 甲's 채권자 A brought an action against 乙 seeking payment of the 매매대금 by 대위하여 甲, the 소멸시효 on 甲's claim against 乙 for the 매매대금 is not interrupted.
A: ㄱ
B: ㄴ, ㄷ
C: ㄷ, ㄹ
D: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ
E: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ

label: A
question:
Ahn builds the X building on the Y land owned by C and acquires it by 원시취득, then sells and delivers the X building to B in a 미등기 무허가 state, and the ownership transfer registration in B’s name for the X building has not yet been completed. Which of the following explanations are all correct? Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the 판례.

ㄱ. If B, after paying the 매매대금 in full to A, sells the X building to D and delivers it, and A exercises a 물권적 반환청구권 against D, D may assert against A his own 점유·사용권.
ㄴ. If B has paid the 매매대금 in full to A, B is recognized as having a 법률상 지위 with respect to the X building as a 소유권에 준하는 관습상의 물권 or as 사실상의 소유권.
ㄷ. If B has paid the 매매대금 in full to A, and B already has a 변제기 도래한 대여금 채권 against C, and C, because A has no 사용권 to the Y land, has brought against A a 부당이득반환청구 equivalent to 차임 for the Y land, A may set off the said claim of B, only to the extent of B’s 부담부분, by treating it as the 자동채권.
A: ㄱ
B: ㄴ
C: ㄱ, ㄷ
D: ㄴ, ㄷ
E: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ

label: B
question:
Which of the following correctly combines the statements that are correct (○) and incorrect (X) regarding 경정등기? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents)
ㄱ. If an unlawful 경정등기 that does not preserve the 동일성 of the 등기명의인 has been made, but it ultimately comes to express the legal relationship of the 명의인 after the correction and thus conforms to the 실체관계, then that 경정등기 is valid, but the right of the pre-correction 등기명의인 that actually existed before the correction does not retroactively extinguish.
ㄴ. Where the 부기등기 of 등기명의인 경정 is made in a way that impairs the 동일성 of the 등기명의인 and does not express the actual 소유관계, a person who claims performance of the procedure for 말소등기 of such 경정등기 must prove that he or she is the original 등기명의인 of the 부동산 and the 진실한 소유자.
ㄷ. Where the 등기관 discovers an error in an existing 등기, the registrar must correct it without delay, and in such a case, if there exists an 등기 that is incompatible with the corrected 등기 in the 등기부, the consent of the 등기명의인 of that 등기 must be obtained.
ㄹ. Where, with respect to 공유부동산, a 소유권보존등기 has been made in the name of a sole owner, and the 진정한 권리자 seeks by an action partial 말소 of that registration, the court cannot order cancellation only for the relevant share, so it must order a 경정등기.

label: A
question: Which of the following statements concerning a title trust to which the 「부동산 실권리자명의 등기에 관한 법률」 applies is correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)
A: In a three-party title trust by registration, where the title trustee disposes at will of the title-trusted real estate and a third party acquires ownership, if the legal relationship between the seller and the title truster arising from the seller's duty to register transfer of ownership becoming impossible to perform, and the legal relationship between the title trustee and the seller arising from the title trustee's infringement of the seller's ownership, are each separately and individually adjusted by distinguishing them, this may run counter to the purpose of the unjust enrichment restitution system
B: In a three-party title trust by registration, if the title truster, without subrogating the seller, directly claims registration of transfer of ownership against the title trustee on the ground of 부당이득반환, the registration of transfer of ownership completed accordingly in the name of the title truster is 무효.
C: In a contract title trust, where the seller did not know about the 명의신탁약정, if the title trustee agreed, in lieu of returning the purchase funds to the title truster, to transfer the title-trusted real estate itself and, on that basis, completed the 소유권이전등기 in the name of a third party designated by the title trustee, then the registration of ownership transfer in that third party’s name is valid.
D: In a contract title trust, where the seller did not know of the title trust agreement when entering into the sale contract with the title trustee but learned of it when registration of transfer of ownership was completed in the name of the title trustee, the sale contract between the seller and the title trustee becomes 소급적으로 무효가 된다.
E: In a contract title trust, where the seller knew about the 명의신탁약정, the sale contract concluded between the seller and the title trustee is 원시적 무효, and ownership of the relevant real estate remains vested in the seller; therefore, absent 특별한 사정, the title truster may claim 소유권이전등기 from the seller.

label: D
question:
A had a monetary claim for 100 million won against B, and B sold X real property, his only asset, to C and completed the ownership transfer registration in C’s name. Thereafter, A filed a lawsuit against C seeking 사해행위취소 and 원상회복 with respect to the sales contract for X real property. Which of the following is the correct combination of the statements that are correct (○) and incorrect (X)? Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the precedents.

ㄱ. Where a final and conclusive judgment is rendered in A’s favor in a lawsuit against C for 사해행위취소 and 원상회복, and A’s monetary claim against B is extinguished before the ownership transfer registration is restored to B, C may not seek exclusion of the enforceability of the said final judgment by filing an action of objection to claim enforcement.
ㄴ. Where A obtained a final and conclusive judgment against C ordering cancellation of the ownership transfer registration as 원상회복 following 사해행위취소, but for some reason cancelling the registration in C’s name becomes impossible, A may again claim against C that C perform the procedure for ownership transfer directly to B as 원상회복.
ㄷ. Where, after a final and conclusive judgment in favor of A in an action against C for 사해행위취소 and 원상회복, the title is restored to B and B thereafter sells X real property again to D and completes the ownership transfer registration, E, who acquired a monetary claim against B after B had sold X real property to C, may not seek cancellation of the ownership transfer registration in D’s name.
ㄹ. Even if A, a general creditor of C, attached X real property upon completion of the ownership transfer registration in C’s name and received a distribution in the auction proceedings for X real property, if A subsequently obtains a final and conclusive judgment against C for 가치배상 as 원상회복 following 사해행위취소, A must return the distributed amount to A as unjust enrichment within the scope of the amount of value compensation.
D: ㄱ(X), ㄴ(X), ㄷ(X), ㄹ(X)

label: E
question:
Among the statements concerning graves, which of the following are correct? Do not consider the Act on Funeral Services, etc. and, if there is a dispute, follow the precedents

ㄱ. If the person having the right to protect and manage a grave dies and his or her lineal descendants become co-heirs, and there is no agreement among them on the succession to that right, it is consistent with customary law to regard the eldest among the closest lineal descendants as succeeding to it unless there are special circumstances
ㄴ. Where a right to a grave base is established by the landowner’s consent, even if the landowner and the person having the right to protect and manage the grave agreed at the time of establishment on whether the duty to pay rent exists or on its scope, the effect of that agreement does not extend to a person who purchased the land including the grave base through a voluntary auction proceeding
ㄷ. The right to a grave base is a customary proprietary right that allows one to use land owned by another within the scope necessary to achieve the purpose of protecting the grave and performing ancestral rites, and it can exclude interference not only by third parties but also by the landowner
ㄹ. Even if the person having the right to protect and manage a grave installs the grave on another’s land without the landowner’s consent, that person may acquire the right to a grave base by prescription
A: ㄱ, ㄷ
B: ㄱ, ㄹ
C: ㄴ, ㄷ
D: ㄴ, ㄹ
E: ㄷ, ㄹ

label: D
question:
Which of the following statements regarding 계약인수 are correct? If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.

ㄱ. In 계약인수, the 대항요건 required in individual 채권양도 to protect the 채무자 is not separately required, and this rule likewise applies to 계약인수 accompanying 영업양도 under the 「상법」.
ㄴ. Where an apartment pre-sale purchaser who had a 손해배상청구권 arising from a tort of 허위·과장광고 under the 「표시·광고의 공정화에 관한 법률」 transfers the status of 수분양자 to a third party, the 양수인 may, absent special circumstances, exercise that 손해배상청구권 without a separate 채권양도 procedure.
ㄷ. Where, after the seller’s 매매대금 채권 against the buyer has been 압류된, a 계약인수 transferring the seller’s position is made, even if the 계약관계 between the seller and the buyer is extinguished, the 양수인 acquires the 매매대금 채권 in a state subject to the 제한 arising from the 압류.
A: ㄱ
B: ㄷ
C: ㄱ, ㄴ
D: ㄱ, ㄷ
E: ㄴ, ㄷ

label: B
question:
A entered into a construction contract with B concerning X house owned by B, and agreed that the construction price would be paid in a lump sum upon completion. Even though A completed the construction, B did not pay the construction price and demanded delivery of X house, and A is residing in X house while exercising a lawful 유치권. The Y land, which is the site of X house, is owned by D. Which of the following statements are correct? Each statement is independent, and if there is a dispute, follow the precedents.

ㄱ. If A incurred 유익비 with respect to X house, A may claim against B reimbursement, at B’s option, of either the amount expended or the 증가액, only if the increase in value of X house remains 현존.
ㄴ. A does not bear toward D an obligation to return unjust enrichment equivalent to 차임 arising from the use and 수익 of Y land during the period A resided in X house.
ㄷ. If X house is sold in an auction proceeding based on A’s 유치권, the 유치권 does not 소멸, just as in the case where X house is sold in an auction proceeding filed by creditor B of B.
ㄹ. Where C purchases X house in an auction proceeding initiated by creditor B of B, it is permissible for creditor A of A to apply for an attachment and 추심명령 with respect to the claim that A is to receive payment from C simultaneously with delivering X house to C.
A: ㄱ
B: ㄱ, ㄴ
C: ㄷ, ㄹ
D: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ
E: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ

label: D
question: Which of the following statements regarding a 보증채무 is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.)
A: Even if one guarantees the principal obligation while the extinctive prescription period for the principal obligation, which falls under the short-term extinctive prescription under each item of Article 163 of the Civil Act, has been extended to 10 years by a final judgment against the principal obligor, unless special circumstances exist, the extinctive prescription period for the surety obligation is determined separately according to the nature of the surety obligation.
B: It is, in principle, only the bill obligation arising from that bill guarantee that a person who expressly provides an 어음보증 on a promissory note issued by another person bears.
C: Where the surety of one among several joint tortfeasors has 변제 the damages liability of the guaranteed person, the surety may exercise a 구상권 against the other joint tortfeasors, other than the guaranteed person, only to the extent of each party’s 부담부분.
D: Where a surety has guaranteed an indeterminate obligation under the principal contract arising from a continuing contractual relationship, the surety obligation는 principal contract상의 obligation과 함께 fixed되고, 그 latter가 fixed되는 때에 확정되며, surety contract의 종료 시점과는 관계가 없다.
E: An agreement to assign only the 보증채권 separately from the principal claim is without effect.

label: C
question: Which of the following statements regarding real property의 합유 is correct? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.)
A: A lawsuit in which one of the co-owners in common of real property for which 합유등기 has been completed seeks performance of the procedure for 소유권이전등기 on the ground of termination of a 명의신탁 does not constitute an indispensable joint action
