The fact that a foreign national who applied for 난민인정 at Incheon International Airport but received a 난민인정심사불회부결정 was confined for about five months in the Incheon International Airport 송환대기실 and was prevented from entering the 환승구역 constitutes ‘구속’ as provided in the main text of Article 12(4) of the Constitution, and the refusal of a request for counsel 접견 during such 구속 infringes the right to assistance of counsel
ㄹ. Under the 「외국인근로자의 고용 등에 관한 법률」, the employer of a business or workplace that employs foreign workers must subscribe to insurance or a trust with the foreign worker as the insured for payment of 퇴직금 upon the foreign worker’s 출국, and because this 출국만기보험금 has the nature of 퇴직금 and matters concerning the timing of its payment are therefore a matter of 근로조건, foreign workers are also recognized as subjects of 기본권
ㅁ. The 「긴급재난지원금 가구 구성 및 이의신청 처리기준(2차)」, established to support citizens who suffered economic harm from the spread of COVID-19, included “영주권자 및 결혼이민자” within the category of “외국인만으로 구성된 가구” eligible for the 긴급재난지원금, while excluding “난민인정자”; this is discrimination without a rational basis and therefore infringes the right to equality of 난민인정자

label: A
question:
Which of the following correctly combines the statements that are correct (○) and incorrect (X) regarding marriage and family life? If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.

ㄱ. The parents’ right not to be interfered with by the State in accessing information about the sex of a fetus who will become a future member of the family is protected by the 일반적 인격권 derived from Article 10 of the Constitution.
ㄴ. A provision of the 「가족관계의 등록 등에 관한 법률」 that does not allow the biological father to file the birth registration of a child born between a married woman and a man other than her husband directly restricts the 생부의 양육권 with respect to a child born outside marriage.
ㄷ. The guarantee of marriage and 가족생활 prescribed in Article 36(1) of the Constitution means that, negatively, it protects the individual’s 주관적 방어권 against unjust infringement by State power by prohibiting State power from infringing upon the private sphere of marriage and family, and, positively, it means not only that the State must protect marriage and family from third parties, etc., but also that it imposes on the State the task of realizing a 혼인·가족제도 established and maintained on the basis of human dignity and 양성의 평등.
ㄹ. Since Articles 34 and 36 of the Constitution impose on the State the task of protecting 가족생활 and striving to improve the welfare of juveniles, even the interpretation of these constitutional provisions alone gives rise to a legislative duty to enact specific systems for effectively securing the performance of 양육비 obligations, such as a 양육비 대지급제.
ㅁ. The “출생등록될 권리,” immediately upon being born, is a right to have basic information relating to a child’s birth registered so that the State may manage such information at the “출생 후 아동이 보호를 받을 수 있을 최대한 빠른 시점,” and is an independent fundamental right not expressly provided for in the Constitution that has both the character of a 자유권 and the character of a 사회적 기본권 guaranteeing a child’s healthy growth and development.

label: D
question: Which of the following statements concerning the 신뢰보호원칙 is correct? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.)
A: Even if a statute is 위헌, until the Constitutional Court renders a 위헌결정 with respect to that law, its 합헌성 is presumed; therefore, the same level of protection as for a 신뢰이익 based on a 합헌적인 법률, namely the State’s 헌법에서 유래하는 보호의무, is required.
B: While amending the law to exclude children of persons decorated for meritorious service in the defense of the nation from the category subject to bonus points in recruitment examinations conducted by employment-support implementing institutions, the supplementary provision of the Act on the Honorable Treatment and Support of Persons, etc. of Distinguished Service to the State, which did not provide transitional measures for a person who had long formed the expectation that he or she would become a child of a person decorated for meritorious service in the defense of the nation in the near future and thereby receive bonus points in a recruitment examination, violates the principle of 신뢰보호원칙.
C: The 3-year grace period prescribed in the supplementary provision of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Resource Circulation of Electrical and Electronic Equipment and Vehicles, which required even a person who had registered a waste-material recycling business under the former statutes to satisfy the registration standards within 3 years, is excessively short to adequately cope with changes in circumstances caused by the amendment of the statute and therefore violates the principle of 신뢰보호원칙.
D: Even if the former 「댐건설 및 주변지역지원 등에 관한 법률」 provision, which says that when there is an order to cancel or change a dam use right the State shall return part of the charges or payments paid by the dam use right holder, and that the amount to be returned may not exceed the amount after deducting the depreciation amount prescribed by Presidential Decree, is applied to a dam use right holder who had already acquired and was exercising a dam use right, it does not violate the principle of protection of trust because the public-interest value of the rational development and use of water resources through multipurpose dams is very great compared with the dam use right holder’s trust interest in the continuance of the dam use right.
E: Since a medical practitioner’s trust in the former legal order that he or she could operate multiple medical institutions is a 헌법상 보호가치 있는 trust, if the relevant provision of the Medical Service Act was later amended to provide that a medical practitioner may not, under 어떠한 명목으로도, operate more than one medical institution, it violates the 신뢰보호원칙.

label: C
question:
Which of the following is the correct combination of the statements that are correct (○) and incorrect (X) regarding the operation of the National Assembly and its parliamentary procedure? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.)

ㄱ. The National Assembly’s 의결방식, which realizes the principle of majority rule, is based, absent any special provision in the Constitution or statutes, on the 일반정족수 requiring the presence of a majority of the 재적의원 and the approval of a majority of the 출석의원, and this can be regarded as an absolute constitutional principle.
ㄴ. An 임시회 of the National Assembly is convened at the request of the President or of at least one-third of the total membership of the National Assembly, and in such case the 기간 and the reasons for the 집회요구 must be specified.
ㄷ. While the Constitution provides the principle that meetings of the National Assembly are 공개, it contains an exception that they may be held in 비공개 when there is approval by a majority of the members present or when the 의장 deems it necessary for the 국가의 안전보장.
ㄹ. When it is necessary to continue 지출 beyond one 회계연도, the Government must obtain a resolution of the National Assembly by setting a 연한 and treating it as 계속비.
ㅁ. The Constitution provides that "부결된 안건" may not be again 발의 or 제출 during the same 회기, thereby excluding obstruction of proceedings by a 소수파 and promoting the smooth operation of meetings.

label: B
question:
Which of the following correctly combines the statements that are correct (○) and incorrect (X) concerning the courts? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)

ㄱ. To guarantee the right to receive a trial by a judge means to guarantee the right to receive a trial in which a judge determines the facts and interprets and applies the law, and if such guarantee is not properly fulfilled, it infringes the essential content of the constitutionally guaranteed right to receive a trial.
ㄴ. As a general rule, the hearing and judgment of a trial should be 공개 to the public, but when there is a risk of impairing 국가안전보장 or 안녕질서, or of harming 선량한 풍속, it may be kept nonpublic by a court decision.
ㄷ. The Constitution provides that the Supreme Court may enact rules concerning procedures for lawsuits, internal court discipline, and the administration of court affairs to the extent that they do not conflict with statutes. This means that, for the matters enumerated in that provision, the Supreme Court may determine them by rules so long as they do not conflict with statutes, and even in that case, express authorization by statute is required.
ㄹ. Although the 양형기준 of the Sentencing Commission do not have legal binding force, if a court renders a judgment departing from the sentencing guidelines, the reasons for the sentence must be stated in the written judgment, and the same applies when adjudicating pursuant to summary procedure or summary trial procedure.
ㅁ. Because the Constitution designates the Supreme Court as the 최고법원, the right to receive a trial by judges provided by the Constitution and statutes under the law can be said to mean the right to receive appellate review in all cases.

label: E
question: Which of the following statements concerning delegated legislation is not correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.)
A: Where a statute delegates the power to prescribe specific matters to the articles of incorporation of a public-law institution that is not part of, or does not belong to, the executive branch, there is no room to impair the principle of 권력분립; accordingly, the prohibition on 포괄위임입법 under Articles 75 and 95 of the Constitution does not, in principle, apply.
B: Although Article 95 of the Constitution provides the basis for delegation to 부령 and, unlike Article 75, does not use the phrase “구체적으로 범위를 정하여,” the constitutional limitations imposed on 대통령령 by delegation under a 법률 naturally also apply to 부령 under delegation under a 법률.
C: The Act on the Repatriation and Treatment, etc. of Prisoners of War of the Republic of Korea Armed Forces merely provides that registered prisoners of war, etc. may be accorded 예우 in accordance with Presidential Decree, and contains no provisions whatsoever regarding the content or method of such 예우; therefore, it cannot be regarded as enforceable solely on the basis of the provisions of the superior law without the enactment of a Presidential Decree, and thus the President has a duty to enact or amend a Presidential Decree concerning the 예우 of registered prisoners of war, etc.
D: The forms of delegated legislation recognized by the Constitution should be regarded as illustrative, and even if a statute delegates certain 사항 to administrative rules, those 행정규칙 may regulate only the delegated matters; therefore, this does not conflict with the principle of legislation by the National Assembly.
E: Because the doctrine of delegated legislation is based on the 헌법의 근본원리인 separation of powers and parliamentarianism 내지 rule of law, there is a direct relationship between whether the content prescribed in a 대통령령 enacted by the executive branch is 정당한 것인지 여부 and the 적법성 of the delegation.

label: A
question:
Which of the following correctly combines the statements that are correct (○) and incorrect (X) regarding property rights? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.)

ㄱ. Under the 「국토의 계획 및 이용에 관한 법률」, provisions that designate districts necessary to maintain and manage the aesthetics of 문화재 and buildings with high cultural preservation value, and that restrict the use of land not conforming to the purpose of such designation, are provisions concerning the content and limits of property rights under Article 23(1) and (2) of the Constitution, where the legislature generally and abstractly determines the rights and duties concerning 토지재산권, and are provisions that concretize the social restrictions on property rights.
ㄴ. The school site charge under the former 「학교용지 확보 등에 관한 특례법」, imposed on the development 사업자 rather than the purchaser, does not infringe the development project operator’s property rights because it appropriately balances the public interest in guaranteeing equal educational opportunities and the private interest in the operator’s 재산적 이익.
ㄷ. Under the 「주택법」, a provision that allows a private project operator who has obtained approval of the 사업계획 and secured 사용권원 to at least 95 percent of the housing construction site area to make a market-value 매도청구 against all owners of the land for which 사용권원 has not been secured does not infringe property rights.
ㄹ. A provision of the former 「공직선거법」 that requires a person whose election has been invalidated due to an election crime to return the 기탁금 already returned and the election expenses reimbursed does not infringe the property rights of the person whose election has been invalidated.
ㅁ. Among the 관습법 concerning the 분묘기지권, the part stating that, in the absence of special circumstances such as an agreement between the parties regarding the 존속기간 of the grave-site right, the 분묘기지권 continues to exist for so long as the grave itself continues to exist, as long as the right-holder continues to guard and maintain the grave, does not infringe the landowner’s property rights.
E: ⑤ ㄱ(X), ㄴ(○), ㄷ(X), ㄹ(X), ㅁ(X)

label: C
question:
Which of the following correctly combines the statements that are true (○) and those that are false (X)? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents)

ㄱ. 지방자치단체의 autonomous affairs에 대한 indiscriminate 감사권 exercise는 헌법상 보장된 local self-government right를 침해할 가능성이 크므로, as a general rule, 감사 과정에서 사전에 감사대상으로 특정되지 아니한 matter에 관하여 illegal fact가 발견되었다고 하더라도, expanding or adding the audit object is not permitted.
ㄴ. Under the Constitution, a local government’s 지방자치권 also concerns the distribution and operation of the state governing organization, and insofar as it is authority that takes part in a portion of state power, fundamental and essential matters concerning the organization of a local government, its 자치기능, and the autonomy of its autonomous affairs must be directly prescribed by statute.
ㄷ. It cannot be said that the constitutionally institutionally guaranteed autonomy includes the authority, in performing autonomous affairs, not to receive orders or instructions concerning 합목적성 from another administrative subject.
ㄹ. The Constitution provides that “matters concerning the method of appointing the head of a local government shall be determined by statute,” but the principle that the head of a local government, who is the representative of the local government, must be elected through an election based on the voluntary support of residents is a principle naturally derived from the essence of the 지방자치제도.
ㅁ. The Constitution guarantees the ordinance-making power of local governments, and the Local Autonomy Act makes clear that, where there is delegation by an individual statute, it is possible to restrict the rights of residents or impose obligations on residents by 조례 as well; therefore, if there is statutory delegation, an ordinance may also determine matters reserved for legislation.

label: C
question: Which of the following explanations of the right to be heard in judicial proceedings is not correct? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례)
A: The provision of the Criminal Act that, with respect to the offense of 권리행사방해죄 between 직계혈족, 배우자, 동거친족, 동거가족, or 그 배우자, makes the judge unable to consider any circumstances at all and uniformly requires a 형면제 판결, insofar as it prevents the criminal victim from requesting that the judge exercise 적절한 형벌권 and is 현저히 불합리 or unfair in departing from legislative discretion, infringes the criminal victim's 재판절차진술권.
B: The concept of a criminal victim prescribed in Article 27(5) of the Constitution does not necessarily mean only a person who can exercise 권리행사 within the formal criminal procedure, but is a broad concept that includes not only a victim whose protected 법익 has been infringed directly but also a victim whose protected 법익 has been infringed indirectly, as long as the person has suffered an infringement of a legal interest due to a criminal act. However, because a criminal victim should in principle be a person directly related to the criminal case at issue, it should not be understood by limiting it to the concept of a victim based on the protected 법익 of the criminal facts themselves, nor should it be determined by comprehensively considering the purpose of 형사소송 and the content of the criminal victim's rights, but should be understood to mean a person who, even if not interpreted under 형사실체법 as the subject enjoying the direct protected 법익, suffers a legal disadvantage due to the criminal act at issue.
C: When making a decision on a petition for adjudication, the provision of the Criminal Procedure Act that leaves to the judge's discretion whether to hold oral argument infringes the victim's right to be heard in judicial proceedings because the disadvantage suffered by the petitioner for adjudication can be seen as greater than the public interest in promoting 사회 안정 by promptly and smoothly proceeding with the petition-for-adjudication procedure and thereby determining the legal relations between the concerned parties.
D: The reservation of law prescribed in Article 27(5) of the Constitution concerning the right to be heard in judicial proceedings, unlike the 법률유보 for liberty-type fundamental rights whose purpose is to 제한 fundamental rights by law, corresponds to the so-called 기본권형성적 법률유보, which is intended to 법률로써 구체화 the meaning and content of the constitutional norm that guarantees the right to be heard in judicial proceedings as a fundamental right.
E: The Fair Trade Commission has a duty, in a case where, in light of the legal purpose pursued by the Monopoly Regulation and Fair Trade Act, the 행위의 위법성과 가벌성이 grave and the 피해의 정도 is 현저하여, such that it is objectively reasonable to deem that the realization of the 법 목적 would be impossible unless 형벌 is applied, to file a complaint; and the non-exercise of the 고발권 in violation of such a 작위의무 is manifestly arbitrary and infringes the victim's 재판절차진술권.

label: B
question:
Among the explanations concerning 선거, which of the following are 옳은 것인가? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.)

ㄱ. 누구든지 during the 선거기간, for the purpose of influencing an election, cannot hold ‘그 밖의 집회나 모임’, and the 「공직선거법」 provision punishing a person who violates this does not infringe the freedom of 정치적 expression.
ㄴ. The 「공직선거법」 provision that punishes a person who, for the purpose of causing a candidate to be elected, elected, or not elected, publicly states facts and 비방s a person who seeks to become a candidate does not violate the 명확성원칙 under 죄형법정주의, but it violates the 과잉금지원칙 and infringes the freedom of 정치적 expression.
ㄷ. The 「공직선거법」 provision that restricts the 선거권 of a person who has been sentenced to imprisonment for 1 year or more and whose execution has not yet been completed infringes the 선거권 because, regardless of the type of crime such as 과실범 or 고의범, and regardless of the content of the legal interest infringed, it does not take into account whether 가석방, which is a discretionary administrative disposition made during the execution of the sentence, has been granted.
ㄹ. Under the 「공직선거법」, prohibiting all election campaigning by 지방공사 상근직원 significantly restricts the freedom of election campaigning of 지방공사 상근직원, and compared with the extent of the restriction, it does not greatly contribute to securing fairness and 형평성 in elections, and therefore infringes the freedom of election campaigning of 지방공사 상근직원.
ㅁ. In the 중앙회장선거 of Nonghyup Central Federation, which fundamentally has the character of a 사법인, electing the president or engaging in election campaigning is included within the scope of the 선거권 protected by the Constitution.
A: ㄱ, ㄴ
B: ㄴ, ㄹ
C: ㄴ, ㅁ
D: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㄹ
E: ㄷ, ㄹ, ㅁ

label: B
question: Which of the following statements concerning administrative procedure and public기관의 정보공개 are correct? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.) ㄱ. An administrative disposition may also be made against the State, and in that case too the provisions of the 「행정절차법」 concerning prior notice, 의견청취, and 이유 제시 apply 그대로. ㄴ. Even if, by 종합적으로 considering the contents stated in the disposition document, the relevant 법령, and the overall process leading to the disposition, the party at the time of the disposition could sufficiently understand on what 근거 and for what 이유 the disposition was made, and thus had no particular obstacle in proceeding to 행정구제절차 in opposition thereto, if the disposition document did not specifically state the 근거 and 이유 for the disposition, the disposition is 위법하다. ㄷ. In an action to revoke a disposition refusing 정보공개 filed by a requester for information disclosure, even if the requester was served with a copy of the requested information submitted as 증거 to the court by the relevant 공공기관 and, as a result, the relevant public institution came to disclose the information to the requester in effect, the 법률상 이익 in seeking 취소 of the 비공개결정 concerning that information is not 소멸된다. ㄹ. A military servicemember 甲, who received a 징계처분, requested disclosure of the names and positions of the 징계위원회 members in order to confirm a procedural 하자 in the composition of the disciplinary committee, but the request was denied and 甲 filed an action for 취소 thereof. If, in the 징계항고 proceedings brought by 甲, 甲 learned that there was a 하자 in the composition of the 징계위원회, and if the relevant 징계처분 was 취소 on the ground of that 하자, then 甲's 법률상 이익 in seeking disclosure of the information in the above 취소소송 is 소멸한다.
A: ㄱ, ㄴ
B: ㄱ, ㄷ
C: ㄴ, ㄹ
D: ㄷ, ㄹ
E: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㄹ

label: A
question: Which of the following statements concerning 행정행위 is not correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.)
A: If, under the former Public Hygiene Control Act and its subordinate statutes, a public hygiene business was 양도ㆍ양수 and the transferee thereafter gave the administrative agency notification of the opening of a new place of business, a business suspension disposition cannot be imposed on the transferee on the ground of the 위법 of the suspension of the public hygiene business concerning the transferor.
B: A building permit has an objective character, and therefore, when granting such permit, the administrative agency conducts only a formal 심사 with respect to personal 요소, such as who the 건축주 is.
C: A business suspension disposition imposed on a medical care institution under the National Health Insurance Act on the ground that the medical care institution caused the insurer to bear the cost of medical care benefits by fraud or other 부당한 방법 has the character of an object-related disposition.
D: An authorization disposition for the establishment of a housing reconstruction association made by an administrative agency on the basis of the Act on the Maintenance and Improvement of Urban Areas and Dwelling Conditions for Residents and other related statutes has the character of a 설권적 disposition that, when the statutory requirements are satisfied, confers on the applicant the status of an administrative entity with the authority to carry out a housing reconstruction project.
E: The determination of the business type of an individual workplace made by the Korea Workers' Compensation & Welfare Service against an employer must be regarded as a confirmatory administrative act, 즉 행정청이 구체적 사실에 관해 법집행으로 공권력을 행사하는 행위라고 보아야 한다.

label: A
question:
Regarding 다음 사례에 관한 설명 중 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은? (If there is a dispute, 판례에 의함) 甲은 A시 B구 소재 점포에 관하여 종전 영업자, that is, X로부터 영업자지위승계를 받아 2021. 11. 9. 신고하였는데, B구 구청장 乙은 X가 2021. 8. 26. 유흥접객원을 고용하여 유흥접객행위를 하였다는 이유로 2022. 12. 26. 甲에 대하여 3월의 영업정지처분을 하였다. 이에 대하여 甲이 취소심판을 청구함에 따라, 행정심판위원회는 2023. 3. 6. 甲에 대하여 3월의 영업정지처분을 2월의 영업정지처분에 갈음하는 560만 원의 과징금부과처분으로 변경하라는 취지의 일부인용재결을 하였고, 그 취지에 따라 乙은 2023. 3. 13. 과징금부과처분을 하였다. 甲은 乙의 처분에 대하여 취소소송을 제기하여 다투려고 한다.
ㄱ. 甲의 2021. 11. 9.자 영업자지위승계신고를 乙이 수리하면 X의 기존 영업수행권은 extinguished 되고 甲에게 new right to conduct the business가 설정되는, 식품위생영업자의 지위변경이라는 공법상 법률효과가 발생한다.
ㄴ. 乙이 2022. 12. 26. 甲에게 영업정지처분을 하기 위해서는 X에 대해 「행정절차법」상의 사전 통지 and 의견제출 절차를 거쳐야 한다.
ㄷ. 행정심판위원회의 2023. 3. 6.자 재결에 대해 乙이 따르지 않을 경우 행정심판위원회가 「행정심판법」 제50조에 의하여 directly 甲에게 과징금부과처분을 하는 것은 허용되지 않는다.
ㄹ. 甲은 2023. 3. 13.자 과징금부과처분을 대상으로 취소소송을 제기하여야 한다.
A: ㄱ, ㄷ
B: ㄱ, ㄹ
C: ㄴ, ㄹ
D: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ
E: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ

label: B
question: Which of the following statements concerning 통치행위 is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.)
A: Even if 서훈취소 is an act performed by the President as Head of State, it cannot be regarded as an act of such a high political nature that the court should exercise judicial restraint.
B: The holding of the inter-Korean summit and, in the course of that holding, the act of remitting money to the North Korean side under the name of 사업권의 대가, without reporting to the Minister of Finance and Economy or obtaining approval for a 협력사업 from the Minister of Unification, cannot be subject to 사법심사.
C: Since the exercise of public power directly related to the restriction of the 국민의 기본권 must be decided and executed in accordance with the Constitution and law even if it is an act requiring highly 정치적 고려, the measure of a complete suspension of the Kaesong Industrial Complex can be subject to a 헌법소원심판.
D: An Emergency Financial and Economic Order that has the force of law is directly 관련되므로 with the infringement of the 국민의 기본권, and therefore it can be the 심판대상 by the Constitutional Court.
E: A decision to dispatch the 국군 of the Republic of Korea to a foreign country, if it is made in compliance with the 절차 prescribed by the Constitution and the law, should have the judgments of the President and the 국회 respected, and adjudication solely on 사법적 기준 should be 자제되어야 한다.

label: A
question:
Which of the following statements concerning the case are all correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) 구 폐기물처리시설 설치촉진 및 주변지역지원 등에 관한 법령에 의하면, where the 지방자치단체의 장이 설치하고자 하는 폐기물처리시설의 경우 and the 입지선정지역 is 1개 시·군·구인 때, the composition of the 입지선정위원회 must include experts selected by the 시장·군수·구청장 and recommended by resident representatives. However, A도 B군 군수 甲 arbitrarily constituted the site-selection committee without including experts selected by the 군수 and recommended by 주민대표, while making a 폐기물입지선정결정, and then made an 입지결정처분 through the 위원회의 의결. Thereafter, 甲 applied to A도 도지사 乙 for approval to install the 폐기물처리시설 pursuant to the 구 폐기물관리법령, and 乙 rendered a disposition approving this application.

ㄱ. 甲의 입지결정처분 is not 당연무효, but it has 취소사유로서의 위법이 있다.
ㄴ. The 하자 in 甲의 입지결정처분 can be 치유 by 甲 before the filing of an 행정소송 challenging it.
ㄷ. The 후행처분, namely 乙의 폐기물처리시설 설치승인처분, which was made on the basis of 甲의 입지결정처분, also becomes 위법하게 된다.
A: ㄷ
B: ㄱ, ㄴ
C: ㄱ, ㄷ
D: ㄴ, ㄷ
E: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ

label: B
question: Which of the following explanations concerning 공법상 contracts is not correct? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.)
A: Under the 「행정기본법」, an administrative agency may conclude a 공법상 contract, where necessary to achieve an 행정목적, to the extent that it does not violate 법령등, and in such case it shall prepare a 계약서 that clearly states the purpose and contents of the contract.
B: A contract concluded pursuant to the 「국가를 당사자로 하는 계약에 관한 법률」 is a public-law contract, and therefore the provisions on bidding procedures and standards for determining the successful bidder under that Act and its Enforcement Decree cannot be said to be merely internal regulations of the State.
C: Even if the termination of the employment contract of a public health physician, who is a 전문직공무원, is an adverse disposition that deprives him or her of status by the competent 도지사의 unilateral 의사표시, it cannot immediately be determined that such 의사표시 is an 행정처분 made by the competent 도지사 as an 행정청 in the exercise of 공권력.
D: Because the termination of the employment contract of a fixed-term public official is a declaration of intent made by the State or a local government as one party to the employment contract relationship in an equal position, it is not required, as with an administrative disposition, to state the grounds and reasons pursuant to the 「행정절차법」.
E: The cancellation by the Industrial Complex Management Corporation of a contract for change of occupancy under the former 「Act on the Activation of Industrial Clusters and Factory Establishment」 is an administrative disposition subject to an appeal litigation, because the Industrial Complex Management Corporation, which was entrusted with management 업무 by the manager, an administrative agency, causes certain 법률상 효과 to arise for the tenant companies from a superior 지위.

label: E
question:
Which of the following statements concerning administrative legislation are correct? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례.)

ㄱ. The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport훈령, ‘개발행위허가운영지침,’ has 대외적 구속력 as a detailed review criterion for development permit standards established under the 「국토의 계획 및 이용에 관한 법률 시행령」.
ㄴ. Just as whether an administrative agency followed 행정규칙 that sets pre-announced disposition criteria does not become a decisive standard for determining the legality of a disposition, whether the agency applied disposition criteria that were not pre-announced also cannot become a decisive standard for determining the legality of a disposition.
ㄷ. Since the delegation basis, 「산업재해보상보험법 시행령」 [별표 3], which sets forth ‘업무상 질병에 대한 구체적인 인정 기준,’ is merely 예시적 규정, a 고시 issued by the Ministry of Employment and Labor pursuant to that delegation cannot be regarded as having externally binding force against the public and the courts.
ㄹ. Article 18(1) of the ‘금융기관 검사 및 제재에 관한 규정,’ promulgated by the Financial Services Commission under the 「금융위원회의 설치 등에 관한 법률」, specifically sets matters that are to become the content of 법령 pursuant to delegation under the Act, and so long as it does not exceed the delegation limit, it has the effect of a 법규명령 with 대외적 구속력 when combined with the Act.
A: ㄴ, ㄷ
B: ㄴ, ㄹ
C: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ
D: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㄹ
E: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ

label: C
question:
Which of the following statements concerning the following case are correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.)

A owns land X, and property tax on land Y, which is adjacent to land X and is clearly registered under B’s name in the land register, was imposed on A on February 1, 2024. A, who did not accurately remember the location of his own land, did not pay the tax and received a demand for payment under the 「지방세징수법」 on April 1, 2024, and after receiving further demands on May 1, 2024 and June 3, 2024, paid the tax on June 17, 2024. A, having come to know that he was not the person liable to pay the 재산세, seeks relief through 쟁송.

ㄱ. 「지방세법」에 따른 재산세 부과처분에 관한 조세심판사항에는 「행정절차법」이 적용되지 아니한다.
ㄴ. Under the 「지방세징수법」, if a taxpayer is in 체납 of 재산세, the head of a 지방자치단체 may request the competent 주무관청 in charge of a business requiring 허가등 not to grant such 허가등 to that taxpayer.
ㄷ. If a demand for payment is challenged through 쟁송절차, the subject of the challenge is the final demand dated 2024. 6. 3.
ㄹ. The imposition of 재산세 on A on February 1, 2024 constitutes 당연무효, because it imposed a 납부의무 on a person who is not the 의무자.
A: ㄱ, ㄴ
B: ㄴ, ㄷ
C: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄹ
D: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㄹ

label: A
question:
Which of the following correctly combines the true statements (○) and false statements (X) concerning the 법률상 이익 under Article 12 of the 행정소송법? If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.

ㄱ. Where a third party other than the direct 상대방 of a 처분 merely has an indirect, factual, or economic 이해관계 in that 처분, plaintiff standing to seek its 취소 is not recognized.
ㄴ. Even if a 처분 approving the establishment of a factory within a 개발제한구역 was litigation-cancelled because it was 위법, if the factory construction permit 처분 based on that approval still remains in force, nearby residents still have a 법률상 이익 to seek 취소 of the factory construction permit 처분.
ㄷ. Where Incorporated Foundation A Research Foundation sent a 통보 to the President of B University, terminating the BK21 협약, which is a 국가연구개발사업, on the ground of improper expenditure of 연구개발비 and ordering a three-year participation restriction in the 국가연구개발사업 for research team leader A, A has a 법률상 이익 to dispute the validity of the above agreement-termination 통보.
ㄹ. In a case where a decision and public notice of a 도시관리계획변경 were made to lift some settlements within a 개발제한구역 from the 개발제한구역, the owner of land within the 개발제한구역 omitted from the areas subject to lifting has a 법률상 이익 to seek 취소 of the above decision and public notice.
E: ㄱ(X), ㄴ(X), ㄷ(X), ㄹ(X)

label: E
question: Which of the following statements concerning the following case is incorrect? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.) On 2009. 6. 1., 甲 교회 applied to the head of A시 B구청장 for a 도로점용허가 with respect to the underground portion of a road owned by B구, for the purpose of using it as part of the site for 교회 시설 to be constructed in the underground space during the process of newly constructing the 교회 building at that time. Accordingly, on 2010. 4. 6., the head of B구청장 issued a 도로점용허가 처분 (hereinafter, “the disposition at issue”) allowing 甲 교회 to occupy the underground portion of part of the above road (hereinafter, “the road at issue”) from 2010. 4. 9. to 2019. 12. 31., and 甲 교회, after the disposition at issue, obtained a building permit for the newly built 교회 building including the underground portion of the road at issue and installed 시설 such as a chapel from the first basement level to the fifth basement level. Accordingly, a resident of B구 seeks to challenge the disposition at issue through a 주민소송 under the Local Autonomy Act.
A: Any resident of B District who has filed a 주민감사청구 may bring a 주민소송, and a filing by one person is also possible.
B: In the case of a residents’ lawsuit, which has the character of 객관소송, the illegality of the disputed 처분 should be construed in the same way as the general ‘처분의 위법성’ in appeal litigation.
C: As for 주민소송, the Administrative Litigation Act applies except as otherwise provided in the Local Autonomy Act, so a 사정판결 is also permitted in a residents’ lawsuit.
D: In a 주민소송 seeking confirmation of the nullity of the disposition at issue, unlike in a nullity-confirmation action that is an appeal litigation, it is subject to the 제소기간 under the Local Autonomy Act.
E: If it is confirmed in the case that there are circumstances showing that the effect of the 건축허가 issued on the basis of the 이 사건 처분 cannot be directly challenged by a resident, then the 소의 이익 to challenge the 이 사건 처분 through a 주민소송 is denied.

label: C
question:
Which of the following correctly combines the statements that are correct (○) and incorrect (✕) concerning the principle of trust protection under administrative law? If there is a dispute, follow the precedents

ㄱ. For the principle of trust protection to apply, there must be no attributable fault on the part of the individual in trusting that the administrative agency’s 견해표명 was justified, and here the presence or absence of 귀책사유 must be determined with respect to all relevant persons, including the addressee of the 견해표명 and any 수임인 who was entrusted with certain acts by that person
ㄴ. Even if the administrative agency had an opportunity to exercise its 권한, if it has not exercised that authority for a long period and there are 정당한 사유 for the public to believe that the authority will not be exercised, it shall not exercise that authority, and the same applies even where there is a risk of substantially harming the interests of a third party
ㄷ. Even where the legislature’s 광범위한 재량 is recognized in amending statutes, if the party’s 신뢰 in the continued existence of the statute is 합리적이고도 정당하며 the loss caused by the amendment is so 극심 that the 공익적 목적 sought by the new statute cannot justify the destruction of such trust, the legislature must take 적절한 조치 to protect the party’s trust, such as providing 경과규정
ㄹ. Even if a resident registration number and the corresponding resident registration card were assigned by an administrative agency, pursuant to a birth registration, to 甲, who was born to a Korean-national father and a People’s Republic of China-national mother who were not legally married, once the 가족관계등록부 was cancelled by the administrative agency as a birth registration of a child born out of wedlock to a foreign mother, the Minister of Justice’s determination that 甲 does not possess Korean nationality, on the ground that 甲 is not a holder of Korean nationality, can be justified
ㅁ. If, after an administrative agency has expressed a 공적인 견해, the circumstances change, it is difficult to regard that official view as still being a 신뢰의 대상 for the individual, so absent special circumstances, the administrative agency may issue a 처분 contrary to that 견해표명

label: A
question:
Which combination correctly matches the following explanations concerning 국가배상책임 as correct (○) and incorrect (X)? (If there is a dispute, follow 판례)

ㄱ. When an officer or employee of a 공법인, in the course of executing public administrative affairs 위탁받은 by the State, violates 법령 intentionally or through 과실 and thereby causes 손해 to another person, that officer or employee qualifies as a 공무원 under Article 2 of the 「국가배상법」, so liability for compensation arises only where there is 고의 or 중과실.
ㄴ. The proviso to Article 2(1) of the 「국가배상법」 concerning 군인·군무원 and others applies, regardless of whether the person has actually exercised the right or is exercising the right, so long as another 법령 provides a 보상제도 and, the 요건 prescribed in that statute having been satisfied, the right to receive compensation has arisen for the persons listed in the said proviso.
ㄷ. Where the State or a 지방자치단체, in the course of carrying out 행정절차, committed a 위법 by failing to guarantee procedural rights such as 주민들의 의견제출, and thereafter corrected this and carried out the procedure again, if there are 특별한 사정 from which it may be deemed that even such measures still leave 정신적 고통 resulting from the 침해 of the 주민들의 절차적 권리, the State or the 지방자치단체 is liable to compensate for the damage caused by such mental suffering, and at this time the burden of 주장 and 입증 as to the existence of special circumstances lies with the 주민들 claiming such compensation.
ㄹ. A public structure cannot be said to have 하자 merely because it does not possess a high degree of 안전성 sufficient to maintain a state of 완전무결 in its 설치 and 관리; it is sufficient if it possesses 상대적인 안전성 expected from the 상식적이고 질서 있는 use of the public structure by users.

label: D
question: Which of the following statements concerning administrative plans is 옳지 않은 것은? (If there is a dispute, 판례에 의함.)
A: Even if land that was designated as an urban planning facility (공원) continued to be used as 농경지 according to its land category, if a person who acquired the ownership after the designation is also in a situation where the land can 계속 be used as 농경지, and even if its use and profit are 사실상 impossible, if the right to demand purchase under 법령 can be exercised, it cannot be concluded that the designation of the park area excessively infringed the private interests of the landowner.
B: Where a reconstruction association privately concludes with an individual member, who is part of the 전체 조합원, an agreement concerning 신축상가입주 related to reconstruction, in light of the nature of the management and disposition plan as a 구속적 행정계획 and the public-law 재량권 that the reconstruction association possesses as an 행정주체, the reconstruction association is not directly bound by that 사법상 agreement.
C: In a revocation action brought against a newly established 도시관리계획 formulated by an administrative agency after a judgment annulling a disposition that rejected a proposal by 주민 등 to formulate a city management plan has become final and conclusive, even if the content of the 도시관리계획 does not violate the 기속력 of the revocation judgment, the court must separately examine and determine whether it deviates from the limits of 계획재량.
D: Where the person authorized to change an industrial complex development plan changes the 산업단지개발계획 so that a specific 폐기물처리업체 can expand its 폐기물소각시설, under the 형평의 원칙, the person authorized to change must also change the 산업단지개발계획 so that nearby 동종 업체들도 the same 혜택을 enjoy.
E: Where a local government, without undergoing an 객관적인 review concerning 경관 훼손, issues a 불승인처분 against A's 고층아파트 신축 사업 계획 on the grounds of the surrounding 경관 and other factors, there is room to recognize the local government's 국가배상책임.

label: A
question:
Which of the following correctly combines the statements that are true (○) and those that are false (X) regarding the following case? (If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.) 甲 intended to collect mukcho from the X River flowing through A City. Accordingly, 甲 applied to 乙, the Mayor of A City and the administrative authority for the X River, for a river occupation permit under the River Act and its subordinate statutes. However, even after receiving 甲’s application, 乙 has not responded in any way for a considerable period of time. 甲 now seeks to file an action for confirmation of the illegality of omission against 乙.

ㄱ. 甲’s administrative litigation seeking the performance or confirmation of the duty to grant a 하천점용허가 against 乙 cannot be allowed.
ㄴ. If, while the 부작위위법확인소송 filed by 甲 is pending, 乙 issues a disposition rejecting 甲’s application for a 하천점용허가, the action for 부작위위법확인 loses its 소의 이익 and becomes inadmissible.
ㄷ. If 甲 filed an action for 부작위위법확인 after exhausting the pretrial procedure, but later, on the view that 乙 had made a refusal disposition, 甲 changed the claim by exchange to a refusal-disposition cancellation lawsuit and then additionally joined an action for 부작위위법확인, the original action for 부작위위법확인 was filed within the lawful filing period, so even though the procedure went through exchange change to a refusal-disposition cancellation lawsuit and additional joinder to that lawsuit, it should still be regarded as having complied with the filing period.
ㄹ. If 甲’s claim for confirmation of illegality of omission is upheld and that judgment becomes final, Article 30 of the Administrative Litigation Act, which provides the binding force of cancellation judgments and the like, applies mutatis mutandis, so 乙 must grant the 하천점용허가 as applied for by 甲.

label: C
question:
Which of the following statements concerning 행정소송 are correct? If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.

ㄱ. In a case where the 교육감 issued to the 이사장 and 학교장 of a 사립학교법인 a 시정명령 stating that the 유사경력 호봉환산 for their 소속 직원 had been 과다하게 반영되었다, so 급여 환수명령 would be made for the employees whose 호봉 had been 과다하게 산정되었고, and that if this was not complied with 보조금 지원 would be 중단된다고 하면서, and further ordered that 호봉 재획정 be processed on the basis of the corrected 호봉 and the 조치결과 be submitted, this is a case where the 사립학교 직원들이 by those orders issued to their respective 사립학교법인 suffered 침해 of interests protected by law.
ㄴ. Since a 소 변경 from 민사소송 to 항고소송 is permitted, there is no reason to construe that there is no 청구기초의 동일성 merely because 공법상 당사자소송 and 민사소송 are different 소송절차, and thus to disallow a 소 변경 between the two.
ㄷ. Where a judgment canceling a 거부처분 has become 확정, if the reason for cancellation was illegality in the procedure or 방법 of the 행정처분, the 행정청 that made the disposition may, in accordance with the 취지 of the 확정판결, 보완 the 위법사유 and again issue a 거부처분 with respect to the previous 신청.
ㄹ. When filing an 행정소송 seeking 취소 in the sense of declaring an 행정처분 당연무효, it is not necessary to satisfy the 제소요건 for a 취소소송, such as compliance with the 제소기간.
A: ㄱ, ㄷ
B: ㄴ, ㄹ
C: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ
D: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ
E: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ

label: E
question: Which of the following statements concerning 행정법상 신고 is not correct? (If there is a dispute, follow the 판례.)
A: Where a report for temporary use of a mountainous area is filed for the purpose of opening a temporary road and satisfies the requirements prescribed by statutes, unless there is a defect in the report form or attached documents, or the report was filed by false or other 부정한 means, the administrative agency must accept the report and cannot refuse to accept the report on grounds other than the reasons prescribed by 법령.
B: Where a building owner who intends to commence construction of a building for which permission was obtained or a report was filed has filed the construction plan report(착공신고) pursuant to the statutes, and the administrative agency has returned it(반려), the building owner may challenge this return(반려) by an administrative appeal litigation(항고소송).
C: In a building report under the Building Act where another license is deemed by law to have been granted, the administrative agency may refuse acceptance of the report if the report does not satisfy the 허가기준 prescribed by other statutes.
D: If a person initially reported that an outdoor assembly would be held, but contrary to the 신고 내용 no outdoor assembly was actually held and only an indoor assembly, whose 범위 and 동일성 are recognized as the same as that of the reported outdoor assembly, was held in a building adjacent to the reported place, the person shall not be 처벌되지 않는다 for deviating from the 신고범위.
E: In a report that requires acceptance, even if the report act itself is invalid because of reasons such as report form forgery, if the administrative agency accepts the report, that acceptance act is merely unlawful and cannot be said to be void ab initio.

label: D
question:
Minister 乙, who is the appointing authority, imposed a 직위해제처분 on public official 甲 belonging to the ministry pursuant to the 「국가공무원법」, which provides that a person “against whom a disciplinary resolution corresponding to 파면·해임·강등 또는 정직 is being requested” may be denied a position. After 甲’s 직위해제 period had expired, 乙 again imposed a 직권면직처분 on 甲. Which of the following statements about this matter are correct? If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.

ㄱ. Because a 직위해제 under the 「국가공무원법」 is an 침익적 처분 that directly and indirectly produces adverse effects on the public official in various respects such as 보수, 승진, and 승급, the same procedural safeguards as those required for 징계 as a punitive sanction are required.
ㄴ. A 직위해제처분 cannot be justified merely on the formal ground that a request for a 징계의결 corresponding to 파면·해임·강등 또는 정직 has been made; a high degree of probability that such disciplinary action will be imposed must be recognized.
ㄷ. If 甲 did not file a 소청심사청구 against the 직위해제처분, 甲 cannot, in a lawsuit seeking revocation of the later 직권면직처분, assert the illegality of the 직권면직처분 by relying on a 취소사유, rather than a 당연무효 사유, of the 직위해제처분.
ㄹ. If 乙 imposed a 직위해제처분 on 甲 based on new 직위해제사유, it is reasonable to regard the prior 직위해제처분 as having been 묵시적으로 철회되었다.
A: ㄱ, ㄷ
B: ㄴ, ㄹ
C: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ
D: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ
E: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ, ㄹ

label: D
question:
An administrative agency A issued to 甲 a corrective order under the 「Building Act」 because a building owned by 甲 was in violation of laws and regulations, and if 甲 does not perform the obligations set forth in the corrective order, it intends to impose an enforcement fine. Which of the following correctly combines the statements that are correct (○) and incorrect (X)? If there is a dispute, follow the precedents.

ㄱ. Even if administrative agency A neglects the imposition and collection of the enforcement fine against 甲, this is an act that is not directly related to finance and accounting, so it does not fall within matters subject to a resident suit.
ㄴ. If an enforcement fine is imposed on 甲 after 甲's death, the duty to pay is succeeded to by 甲's heirs.
ㄷ. Even if 甲 performed the obligations set forth in the corrective order before administrative agency A imposed the enforcement fine, if 甲 performed those obligations after the period specified in the corrective order had elapsed, administrative agency A may impose the enforcement fine on 甲.
ㄹ. If 甲, as a proper method of performing the obligations in line with the purpose of the corrective order, made a report to administrative agency A, but administrative agency A unlawfully rejected it so that the rejection disposition cannot escape revocation, then absent special circumstances, administrative agency A cannot impose the enforcement fine on 甲 on the ground of non-performance of the corrective order.
E: ㄱ(X), ㄴ(X), ㄷ(X), ㄹ(X)

label: B
question:
Which of the following statements concerning 재산권 and 손실보상 are correct? If there is a dispute, follow 판례.

ㄱ. Even if the 사업시행자 includes nonresident owners, beyond the scope of 이주대책 대상자 prescribed by 법령, within the scope of persons eligible for relocation measures, the 이주대책 provided to nonresident owners who are not 이주대책대상자 under 법령 is not a 법령상 의무 but is 시혜적이다.
ㄴ. The “정당한 보상” prescribed in Article 23(3) of the 헌법 means that the objective property value of the 피수용재산 must be fully compensated, so calculating 손실보상액 by excluding 개발이익 arising from the implementation of the relevant 공익사업 runs counter to the 원리 of 정당보상.
ㄷ. Article 23(3) of the 헌법 does not limit the subject of 재산권 수용, so if it is not an issue that the 국가 expropriates land in a project recognized as having 공공필요, it cannot be said that the 판단 on 공공필요 in that project is essentially different merely because a private person holds 수용권 in the same project.
ㄹ. In calculating the 수용보상액 for land subject to 공법상 제한, if such limitations were imposed not for the direct purpose of implementing the relevant 공공사업, the land must be appraised as restricted, but if those limitations were imposed after the implementation of the relevant 공공사업, it must be appraised as if not subject to such 제한.
A: ㄱ, ㄴ
B: ㄱ, ㄷ
C: ㄴ, ㄷ
D: ㄴ, ㄹ
E: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㄹ
